evidence.wikiExcerpt: Fires a volley of 6 high-speed arrows Arrows start off small and grow in size with continuous fire Arrow damage, spread and knockback scale with arrow size The Arbalest is a craftable Hardmode repeater. When used, it fires four volleys of unevenly spread arrows. The arrows initially start at 50% of their original size, damage, and knockback, but with each use, the arrows eventually reach a cap of 150% of their original stats, along with gaining an increased spread. After the cap is reached, the next use resets all three stats back to 50%.

combatV37.title: 쌍둥이 · 레티나이저
combatV37.text: 리벤전스/데스 모드에서는 한 눈이 2페이즈에 먼저 진입하면 다른 눈이 같은 단계에 도달할 때까지 피해가 극히 작아집니다. 두 눈의 체력을 함께 낮추세요. 위키는 다른 눈이 처치되면 3페이즈로 전환할 수 있다고 설명합니다. 한쪽 처치 이후 다른 눈이 계속 무적이고 체력바까지 없다면 이 설명만으로 정상 기믹이라고 단정할 수 없습니다.
combatV37.sourceType: current indexed wiki excerpt, not exact-version implementation

tooltip: 치명타 발생 시 치명타 확률에 비례하여 위력이 증가하는 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Bane]을 적에게 부여합니다
치명타를 맞은 적은 자신이 걸린 디버프 중 플레이어의 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Bane]보다 위력이 약한 모든 디버프를 주변 적들에게 전염시킵니다
intro: The Abaddon is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Red Devils. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has. Additionally, critical strikes will spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 6 enemies within a 50-tile range.

tooltip: 사용 시 남은 모든 소환수 슬롯을 소모합니다
반드시 단축바에 올려둔 상태로 사용해야 합니다
소모한 소환수 슬롯 수에 비례하여 위력과 크기가 증가합니다
이 무기를 들고 있으면 점프 속도가 10% 증가합니다
하늘에서 떨어진 혐오스러운 이 유물은 조용히 비극의 노래를 부릅니다...
wikiTooltip: Consumes all of the remaining minion slots on use
Must be used from the hotbar
Increased power and size based on the number of minion slots used
Holding this weapon grants 10% increased jump speed
Cast down from the heavens in disgust, this relic sings a song of quiet tragedy...
intro: The Abandoned Slime Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Astral Slimes after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. When used, it summons a rocky Astral Jelly slime minion. The slime attacks nearby enemies by jumping towards them to deal damage and occasionally firing an even ring of 8 lasers or a spread of 5 lasers towards its target. The slime will periodically teleport while attacking enemies, creating a visual eruption of particles while doing so. If the player strays too far away from the slime, it will equip an armored jetpack and fly to catch up with them. When the slime is summoned, it will immediately occupy all of the player's remaining minion slots. For each minion slot it occupies, its damage and size are increased by 20%. Additionally, holding this weapon increases the player's jump speed by 10%.

tooltip: 구형 울프럼 갑옷 모델을 닮은 낡고 녹슨 헬멧
소지 시 사용자를 울프럼 로봇으로 변신시킵니다
일반 투구처럼 머리 슬롯에 착용할 수도 있습니다
[c/83B87E:'이 다소 조잡한 갑옷은 주로 부품 수집가나 약탈자들이 착용했습니다.]
[c/83B87E:다재다능하고 흔한 특성 덕분에 거래 시 화폐로 사용되기도 했습니다.']
wikiTooltip: A worn and rusty helmet resembling older models of wulfrum armor
Transforms the holder into a wulfrum robot
Can also be worn in the helmet slot as a regular helm
intro: The Abandoned Wulfrum Helmet is a vanity accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Amplifiers. If worn in the helmet slot, the helmet is equipped normally. If equipped as a vanity accessory, the player transforms into a robot identical to the form the player possesses while using Wulfrum armor's activated ability.

tooltip: '전염성 나노 바이러스가 인식할 수 있는 주파수를 방출하는 라디오'
wikiTooltip: Summons the Plaguebringer Goliath when used in the Jungle
Enrages outside the Jungle
Not consumable
'Radio capable of emitting a frequency recognized by the Plague nanovirus.'
intro: The Abombination is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Plaguebringer Goliath. It can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle, and can only be crafted after decrypting the Encrypted Schematic (Jungle) at The Codebreaker.

tooltip: 칼날로 직접 공격시 서리 폭발을 일으킵니다
'대 마법사의 얼음 마법이 부여된 고대의 검'
wikiTooltip: Shoots dark ice crystals
The blade creates frost explosions on direct hits
Ancient blade imbued with the Archmage of Ice's magic
intro: The Absolute Zero is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It is sold by the Archmage for 60 gold coins after defeating all three minibosses in the Frost Moon event. When swung, it fires a dark ice crystal that explodes upon impact with an enemy or tile, dealing damage in an area of effect. Striking an enemy directly with the blade also creates large frost explosions. Both the blade and its projectiles inflict the Frostbite and Frozen debuffs.

tooltip: 회전하는 심연의 검을 던져 적을 베며 타일에 닿으면 물의 힘을 방출합니다
튕긴 검은 적을 향해 날아가며 2배의 피해를 입힙니다
wikiTooltip: Tosses a spinning abyssal sword that slices through enemies and releases water energy upon hitting a tile
The sword will fly towards enemies after a ricochet, dealing 2x damage
intro: The Abyss Blade is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon that is the direct upgrade to the Depth Crusher. When used, it throws a gravity-affected spinning abyssal sword that pierces infinitely. Upon colliding with a tile, the sword rapidly launches itself towards a nearby enemy and deals 200% damage, and spawns 6 homing water energy particles which each deal 30% damage. Both the launched sword and water energy particles can pass through tiles and do not pierce.
Abyss Gravel is a block that generates naturally in the second layer of the Abyss. It can be mined with a Nightmare Pickaxe or a Deathbringer Pickaxe. It emits water particles when mined.

Abyss Gravel Walls are background walls that are naturally generated in the Abyss. Naturally-generated walls cannot be destroyed or collected and spawn water in front of them whenever a nearby tile updates. Safe versions of Abyss Gravel Walls can be crafted from Abyss Gravel, which have the same appearance but do not release water.

tooltip: 착용 시 심연에서 생물이 플레이어를 감지하는 능력이 약간 감소합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a pet Eidolon Snail to follow you
Slightly reduces creatures' ability to detect you in the abyss while equipped
intro: The Abyss Shell Fossil is a pet summoning item that is dropped by Eidolon Wyrm and Primordial Wyrm and can also be found as an ambient fossil tile in the 4th layer of the Abyss. It summons an Eidolon Snail to follow the player. While summoned, it reduces enemy detection in the Abyss. If the player is far away, the snail will tuck itself inside its shell and fly towards the player and attempt to stay behind them at all times.

tooltip: 적 사이를 불규칙적으로 튕기는 번개를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires an erratic lightning bolt that arcs and bounces between enemies
intro: The Abyss Shocker is a Pre-Hardmode magic gun that is dropped by Box Jellyfish and Mirage Jellies after Skeletron has been defeated. It also has a chance to be inside the Abyss Shrine's Void Chest. When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels erratically and homes in on enemies. The lightning bolt pierces four times and inflicts the Static Discharge debuff.

Ancient Treasure Chests are chests found only in the Abyss that contain rare and unique items. Each Ancient Treasure Chest will contain one unique item along with other standard loot. While they are placed during world creation, they are initially covered in vines and can only be opened after Skeletron has been defeated.

tooltip: 심연에서 산소가 소진되었을 때 받는 피해량이 감소합니다
수영이 가능해지고 수중 호흡 시간이 크게 증가합니다
수중에서 빛을 발산하며 얼음 위에서의 기동력이 증가합니다
심연에서 어느 정도의 빛을 발산하고 산소 소모량을 크게 줄여줍니다

Grants the ability to swim and greatly extends underwater breathing
Provides light underwater and extra mobility on ice
Provides a moderate amount of light and reduces breath loss in the abyss
intro: The Abyssal Diving Gear is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Arctic Diving Gear and Depths Charm. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Reduces the damage the player takes when out of breath in the Abyss by 30 damage per second

tooltip: 수중에서 최대 이동 속도와 가속도가 증가하지만 물 밖에서는 감소합니다
수영이 가능해지고 수중 호흡 시간 증가, 수중 발광 및 얼음 위 기동력이 향상됩니다
심연에서 어느 정도의 빛을 발산하고 산소 소모량과 익사 피해를 줄여줍니다
심연 생물에게 발각될 확률이 감소하고 심연의 방어력 감소 효과 완화 및 액체에서 더 빨리 가라앉습니다
유황 바다의 독성과 [cbuff:CalamityMod/CrushDepth]에 인한 산소 소모량 증가에 면역이 됩니다
[cbuff:CalamityMod/HadopelagicPressure]에 인한 산소 소모량 증가에 저항력을 얻습니다
wikiTooltip: Transforms the holder into an armored diver:
Increases max movement speed and acceleration while underwater, but reduces it outside of water
Grants the ability to swim, extends underwater breathing, emits light underwater, and improves mobility on ice
Provides a moderate amount of light, reduces breath loss, and reduces damage caused by drowning in the abyss
Abyss creatures are less likely to see you, mitigates the abyss' defense reduction, and lets you sink faster in liquids
intro: The Abyssal Diving Suit is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it provides several benefits for swimming. It provides water breathing while underwater, and it combines and enhances the effects of the Abyssal Diving Gear and Anechoic Plating, while also granting immunity to the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.
Additionally, while the player is underwater, their movement speed and acceleration are increased by 5%. However, while on land, their movement speed is reduced by 60%.

tooltip: 적들이 사용자를 표적으로 삼을 확률이 감소하며 이는 심연에서도 적용됩니다
제자리에 서 있을 때 스텔스 생성 속도 +25%, 이동 중 +12%
회피 시 스텔스 게이지를 회복하며 주변 적에게 피해를 입히고 기절시키는 루메닐 구름을 방출합니다
wikiTooltip: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss
Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving
Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks
Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies
'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'
intro: The Abyssal Mirror is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:
-450 aggro and -35% Abyss enemy detection radius

wikiTooltip: Casts a slow-moving ball of dark energy
intro: The Abyssal Tome is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by The Slime God. When used, it fires a slow-moving purple glob that passes through tiles and is not affected by gravity and will slowly decelerate before stopping in place. After hitting an enemy twice or after 5 seconds from being shot, it will explode, dealing damage in a small radius.
Abyssal Treasure is a grab bag obtained from breaking Abyssal Pots. It contains several potions, as well as items that facilitate exploring the Abyss.
The Abyssal Warhammer is a craftable Hardmode hammer.

wikiTooltip: 'Great for hugging people'

wikiTooltip: Releases three streams of irradiated acid
intro: The Acid Gun is a craftable Pre-Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires a volley of three acid streams that dissipate on collision with tiles or after piercing once. The acid streams inflict the Irradiated debuff.
Acidwood is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by cutting down Acidwood Trees in the Sulphurous Sea biome. It is used to craft several weapons themed around the Acid Rain, as well as the Sulphurous armor.
The Acidwood Bow is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bow.
The Acidwood Hammer is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hammer.
The Acidwood Sword is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword.
Acidwood Wall is a background wall crafted with Acidwood.

tooltip: 낚시 중 이동하면 캐릭터 대신 찌가 움직입니다
시간이 지남에 따라 수면 위로 링이 나타납니다
찌가 다시 물에 착수하면 걸린 아이템을 자동으로 낚아 올립니다
wikiTooltip: Increases fishing power by 10
Provides a fishing minigame
Moving while fishing instead moves your bobbers
Rings appear over time above the water's surface
Touching a ring hooks an item onto the bobber
Bobbers will automatically reel in hooked items upon landing back in the water
intro: The Acrobatic Bobber is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory. While equipped, in addition to increasing the player's fishing power by 10, bobbers emit a green pulse ring in a random spot up to 17.68 tiles away from the bobber every 2.5-10 seconds while fishing conditions are valid. Each ring lasts until the next one spawns. Pressing movement keys moves the bobbers instead of the player. The player instantly performs a catch when a bobber intersects an active ring, halving the time to spawn the next ring.
Activated Auric Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block.

tooltip: 양극성의 레이저 2개를 충전하고 발사합니다. 다른 극성으로 공격할 때 공격력이 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: Charges and fires 2 beams of opposite polarities. Hitting with the opposite polarity increases the damage
intro: The Adamantite Particle Accelerator is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it fires a thick pink laser beam shortly followed by a thick blue laser beam. When an enemy is struck with the beam, it will apply a 20% damage increase to the next hit with the beam of the opposite color.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 중력을 무시하며 적중 시 하늘에서 번개 소나기를 내립니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes ignore gravity and rain down lightning on enemy hits
intro: The Adamantite Throwing Axe is a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. When used, it throws an adamantite axe that pierces twice and travels a short distance before being affected by gravity and losing 25% of the weapon's damage per hit.

Performing a stealth strike with an Adamantite Throwing Axe will cause the axe to deal +20% damage, have +30% velocity, ignore gravity, and spawn 4 homing lightning bolts from the sky. Each lightning bolt loses 20% of the weapon's damage per hit.

tooltip: 지하세계의 설계도를 해독할 수 있게 해줍니다
해독 시 새로운 아이템의 제작법을 배울 수 있습니다
칼날로 적을 공격시 대지 폭발을 일으킵니다
wikiTooltip: Striking an enemy with the blade causes an earthen eruption

intro: The Aerial Hamaxe is a craftable Pre-Hardmode hamaxe.

tooltip: 주변 적에게 레이저를 발사하는 비행 원반을 투척합니다
레이저는 적에게 직접 피해를 주지 않지만, 중첩되는 레이저 화상 효과를 적용합니다
충분한 양의 레이저에 맞거나 일정 시간이 지나면 레이저 화상이 직접 피해를 입힙니다

wikiTooltip: Releases a flying disk that fires lasers at nearby enemies
Lasers do not directly damage enemies, but instead apply a stacking laser burn effect
Once hit by enough lasers or sufficient time has passed, laser burn will deal direct damage
The disk gains acceleration as it returns to the player
Stealth strikes toss two disks that can fire at multiple different targets from farther range
intro: The P-LSR: Aerial Tracker is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang. When thrown, the disk detects the nearest enemy and fires lasers towards them, accelerating further the longer it is out. These lasers do not directly damage enemies, and instead accumulate laser burn for each time they hit an enemy, equal to 20% of the disk's damage, which deals direct damage after enough time has passed or enough lasers have hit the enemy.
Performing a stealth strike with the P-LSR: Aerial Tracker throws two disks at once and causes the resulting disk to be able to track and target two enemies at once.
Aerialite Bars are Pre-Hardmode bars made with 3 Aerialite Ore at a Furnace. They are used to craft various sky-themed items.
Aerialite Brick is a craftable brick crafted with Aerialite Ore and Stone Blocks.
Aerialite Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Aerialite Brick.

Aerialite Ore is a Pre-Hardmode ore which generates as Disenchanted Aerialite Ore on Floating Islands upon world generation. Upon defeating The Hive Mind or The Perforators, the ore is re-enchanted, and its pickaxe requirement drops to Pre-Hardmode standards. It is used to craft Aerialite Bars at a Furnace. It requires at least a Nightmare Pickaxe or a Deathbringer Pickaxe to mine. It is also dropped by Aero Slimes.

Disenchanted Aerialite Ore is a Pre-Hardmode ore which generates inside of Clouds on Floating Islands upon world generation. Upon defeating The Hive Mind or The Perforators, the ore loses its disenchantment and becomes Aerialite Ore with a significantly lower pickaxe requirement of 65. If not enchanted, it can still be mined, but requires at least a Cobalt Pickaxe or a Palladium Pickaxe.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 창공의 슬라임
비행하거나 활공하지 않을 때 공중에서 비행 시간을 천천히 회복합니다
wikiTooltip: Grants 0.83 additional seconds of flight time
You slowly recover flight time while in the air while not flying or gliding
'One of the ancient relics'
intro: The Aero Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Wyvern. When equipped, it increases flight time by a flat 50 frames, and regenerates 1 frame of flight time every 4 frames while not flying or gliding. The flight recovery is disabled while the Featherfall buff is active.

Increases maximum mana by 40

10% increased melee damage
10% increased ranged damage

wikiTooltip: This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
intro: The Aestheticus is a craftable Pre-Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it swings in a similar manner to broadswords. It fires a homing crystal that splits into 4 more homing crystals which explode on collision. Both the main and split crystals inflict the Vaporfied debuff. If inflicted on an enemy, it makes the hit target lose 15 health per second and reduces their movement speed by 5% per frame. If inflicted on a player, it makes them lose 4 health per second, negates their natural life regen and reduces their movement speed by 2% per frame. The weapon's damage scale with the average of the current damage stats from all classes.

All converted arrows deal 135% base damage.

Upon successfully summoning the boss, one Ashes of Calamity is removed from the player's inventory if the player does not have a Ceremonial Urn, and the sky darkens, summoning Calamitas shortly after.

If the Altar of the Accursed is hovered over while the Ruler or Mechanical Ruler toggles are enabled, a purely visual red box will appear around the Altar displaying the arena borders for the Supreme Witch, Calamitas fight. This visual lasts for 15 seconds before disappearing.

The beam deals 200% of the weapon's damage, pierces infinitely and passes through tiles. If Musket Balls or Hallow-Point Rounds are used as ammo, the beam deals 350% of the weapon's damage.

The Animosity is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Calamitas Clone. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it fires a narrow spread of 6 bullets that inflicts the Brimstone Flames debuff regardless of what ammo type was used. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), it fires a brimstone round with 900% damage, 200% velocity, and 1.35x the critical strike chance, at the cost of halving the rate of fire. The round inflicts the Brimstone Flames and Marked for Death debuffs. On collision with enemies or tiles, the round explodes into shortly lingering skull clouds which are purely visual.

Holding right click will use its zoom ability, which scrolls the viewing area of the screen in the direction of the cursor in a fashion similarly to the Sniper Rifle. Bullets fired from this weapon inflict the Marked for Death debuff, and reduce enemy defense by 25.

Sand clouds do not deal damage, but cause enemies in contact with them to deal 0.9x contact damage, lasting for 0.5 seconds once enemies exit the clouds' range.

intro: The P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. It spends 4 minion slots to summon an arsenal shrimp minion that floats around the player. When an enemy is nearby, it will launch a burst of homing plasma missiles. It does not directly deal contact damage.

Right-clicking while holding any summon weapon will cause the shrimp minion to launch a targeted missile barrage at the cursor, which leaves a lingering plasma explosion if it hits a tile. When launching the attack, the shrimp will fire the missiles upwards in a spread, before they drop down to the cursor after a short while. The missile barrage has a 7.5 second cooldown.

The arrows initially start at 50% of their original size, damage, and knockback, but with each use, the arrows eventually reach a cap of 150% of their original stats, along with gaining an increased spread. After the cap is reached, the next use resets all three stats back to 50%.

intro: The Arc Nova Diffuser is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. While holding, the player channels a glowing green orb at the tip of the gun and loads one unstable energy bolt every 0.22 seconds. The bolt initially deals 50% damage and fires at a rate of 4 bolts per second, and scales up to 100% damage and 9 bolts per second over 2.6 seconds of channeling.

After channeling for 2.6 seconds, the orb emits its first pulse, increasing the amount of loaded bolts to 20. Releasing prior to the second pulse causes a semi-accurate barrage of loaded energy bolts to fire at a rate of 12 bolts per second. Energy bolts can pierce indefinitely and pass through tiles.

intro: The Arch Amaryllis is a craftable Hardmode wand that is a direct upgrade to the Gleaming Magnolia. When used, it fires a magenta flower that quickly decelerates before eventually stopping. After 2 seconds have passed or upon contact with enemies or tiles, it splits into 8 petals that home in on the closest enemy. The petals start homing in after half a second, and last 2 seconds before dissipating. The petals will not deal damage until they start homing in.

When used, it converts Musket Balls into bubbly streams of water that pierce once and inflict the Riptide and Wet debuffs. It also fires a short-range water ring regardless of ammo used, which deals 50% of the weapon's damage and pierces once. The weapon has a 33% chance to not consume ammo.

Ice claws inflict the Frostbite and Frozen debuffs.

It initially deals no damage until a full shape with the trail is completed. All enemies within the completed shape emit rainbow dust and get damaged for 1x if the shape is completed instantly, and up to 18x if the shape takes 3 seconds or longer to draw. Hitting multiple enemies with the star simultaneously reduces its damage by 50% per hit.

Each blood orb collected reduces Potion Sickness by 0.25 seconds if the debuff is applied to the player. If not, the blood orbs increase the player's natural life regeneration.

wikiTooltip: Used for special crafting
intro: The Ashen Altar is a crafting station that is used to craft the Ancient and Ashen furniture sets themed around the Brimstone Crag. It is also able to create a Music Box.
Ashen Chests are chests that are found only in the Brimstone Crag. Each Ashen Chest will contain one special item along with other standard loot.
Ashen Horns are a post-Moon Lord vanity item that can only be worn in the helmet slot. They are dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas at a 14.29% chance along with the Calamitous set.
Ashen Slab is a craftable block crafted from Smooth Brimstone Slag.
Ashen Slab Wall is a background wall crafted with Ashen Slabs.

intro: The Ashen Stalactite is a Pre-Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Fire Imps in The Underworld or found in an Ashen Chest in the Brimstone Crag. It automatically throws a gravity-affected stalactite that does not pierce and breaks into cosmetic dust shortly after.
Performing a stealth strike with the Ashen Stalactite instead throws a larger stalagmite which travels slower, has a longer lifespan, and breaks into piercing, damaging dust.

intro: Ashes of Annihilation are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. They are used to craft Shadowspec Bars among other items, and the Ceremonial Urn, a non-consumable item used to summon Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

Ashes of Calamity are Hardmode crafting materials that drop solely from Calamitas Clone. They are used in the crafting of the Flask of Brimstone, Sigil of Calamitas, Brimflame armor, several weapons and pieces of the Sacrilegious furniture set. They can also be used to summon the Supreme Witch, Calamitas boss when interacting (right-click) with the Altar of the Accursed.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 아스트라글로머레이트

intro: Astral Bars are Hardmode bars made with 2 Astral Ore and 3 Starblight Soot per bar. They are primarily used to create Astral-themed gear and are additionally used to craft upgrades to weapons, such as the Radiant Star. As well as being used to craft weapons, Astral Bars are used to craft the Ethereal Core, a consumable that can permanently raise the player's maximum mana.

intro: The Astral Beacon is a Hardmode furniture item that can be crafted or found naturally on a pillar of Astral Monolith after the Astral Infection has generated. When right-clicked, it is used to summon Astrum Deus while a Titan Heart or Starcore is in the player's inventory. Upon successfully summoning the boss, one Titan Heart is removed from the player's inventory if the player does not have a Starcore, and two stars rise up from the beacon, summoning Astrum Deus shortly after.

tooltip: 머스킷 총알을 [cbuff:CalamityMod/AstralInfectionDebuff]를 부여하는 유도 아스트랄 탄환으로 변환합니다
intro: The Astral Blaster is a craftable Hardmode gun. When Musket Balls are used for ammo, bullets fired become astral rounds that home in on enemies and inflict the Astral Infection debuff.

intro: Astral Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted from Astral Ore and Astral Stone.
Astral Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Astral Brick.

intro: The Astral Chunk is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Astrum Aureus. It can only be used in the Astral Infection, and can only be crafted after decrypting the Encrypted Schematic (Planetoid) at The Codebreaker.
Astral Clay is a Hardmode block that replaces Clay Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. It is used in the crafting of various vanilla furniture items and the Wandering Jingasa.

The Astral Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Astral Infection. The crate contains several items based originally in the Astral Infection. Its Pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Monolith Crate.
Astral Dirt is a Hardmode block which replaces Dirt Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. It will spontaneously create Astral Grass and Astral Grass Seeds can be planted on it.
Astral Dirt Walls are background walls that replace Dirt Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

wikiTooltip: Places grass on astral dirt
intro: Astral Grass Seeds are Hardmode seeds that are dropped by harvesting wild grass in the Astral Infection at a 5% chance. They can only be planted on Astral Dirt. Once planted, Astral Grass will begin to spread to nearby Astral Dirt blocks.
Astral Grass Walls are background walls that replace Grass Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

The Astral Hamaxe is a craftable Hardmode hamaxe. Despite being available pre-Moon Lord, it has greater hammer power than the Lunar Hamaxes, but falls one block short of their range. It emits faint purple particles when swung.

intro: Astral Ice is a Hardmode block which replaces Ice Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.
Astral Ice Walls are background walls that replace Ice Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

tooltip: 사용 시 마나 메스꺼움 디버프를 부여합니다

intro: The Astral Injection is a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Astral Injection buff, which provides +60 mana regen per second and being inflicted with the Mana Sickness debuff.

wikiTooltip: 10% increased damage
15% increased movement speed

intro: Astral Monolith is a Hardmode block which replaces Wood in the Astral Infection biome and can be obtained by cutting down Monoliths.
Astral Monolith Wall is a background wall crafted with Astral Monolith.

Astral Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates in the Astral Infection after the Wall of Flesh or Astrum Aureus have been defeated. When the Astral Infection meteor lands and the biome is generated, all existing ore within the infected area is converted into Astral Ore.

Astral Ore requires a pickaxe with a pickaxe power of 210% or greater to mine. However, Astrum Deus must be defeated in order to obtain Astral Ore when mining them. Additionally, after Astrum Deus' defeat, Astral Slimes will begin to drop Astral Ore.

The Astral Pickaxe is a craftable Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Lihzahrd Brick and Scoria Ore. It has a range bonus of 3 tiles and has a higher than average critical strike chance. It releases light emitting particles when swung and inflicts the Astral Infection debuff.

tooltip: 공격 시 [cbuff:CalamityMod/AstralInfectionDebuff] 디버프를 입히는 아스트랄의 별 무리를 소환합니다
intro: The Astral Pike is a craftable Hardmode spear. It emits dust when swung, which produces light. When hitting enemies, three astral stars move in a diagonal pattern towards the player, homing into nearby enemies, and dealing 33% of the spear's damage. The stars can move and home through tiles.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 아스트랄 탐사정
근처에 주민이 2명 이상 있을 시 다른 파일런으로 텔레포트할 수 있다
알맞은 바이옴에 하나씩만 설치할 수 있다

intro: Astral Sand is a Hardmode block which replaces Sand Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. Like Sand Blocks and their counterparts, Astral Sand is affected by gravity and can deal damage to any player or enemy it falls on. If the player is submerged in Astral Sand, they are inflicted with the Suffocation debuff.
Astral Sandstone is a Hardmode block which replaces Sandstone Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.
Astral Sandstone Walls are background walls that replace Sandstone Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

tooltip: [cbuff:CalamityMod/AstralInfectionDebuff] 디버프를 입히며 시간이 지나며 점점 빠르게 회전하는 낫을 발사합니다
intro: The Astral Scythe is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Mantises after defeating Astrum Aureus. When swung, it fires a spinning scythe ring projectile that accelerates over time and deals 100% base damage. The scythe ring can pierce up to 7 times but cannot pass through tiles. Both the scythe and the scythe ring inflict the Astral Infection debuff.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 아스트랄 슬라임

intro: Astral Snow is a Hardmode block which replaces Snow Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.
Astral Snow Walls are background wall that replace Snow Walls in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

wikiTooltip: Used by the Clentaminator
Spreads the Astral Infection
intro: Astral Solution is a Hardmode solution that is sold by the Steampunker when not in a Don't dig up or Get fixed boi world. It is usable with the Clentaminator and Terraformer. It converts certain blocks and walls into their Astral Infection variants.

tooltip: 하늘에서 충돌 시 넓은 범위에 영향을 주는 거대한 수정을 소환하며 [cbuff:CalamityMod/AstralInfectionDebuff]를 부여합니다
intro: The Astral Staff is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it rains down an astral crystal from the sky that shatters after piercing an enemy once or hitting a tile. Upon shattering, it emits a petal-shaped explosion that damages enemies in an area of effect.
Astral Stone is a Hardmode block which replaces Stone Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.
Astral Stone Wall is a background wall that replace Stone Wall in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 성간거미
적을 추적하는 아스트랄 거미 송곳니를 부채꼴 모양으로 발사하여 [cbuff:CalamityMod/AstralInfectionDebuff]를 부여합니다
intro: The Astralachnea Staff is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Astralachneas after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. It fires 3-4 homing astral fangs that inflict the Astral Infection debuff on their target. The player can tighten the spread of the projectiles by aiming the cursor further away. The fangs will not pass through blocks.

tooltip: 모든 화살을 불길이 이는 아스트랄 화살로 변환됩니다
wikiTooltip: All arrows are converted to Astreal Arrows that emit flames as they travel
intro: The Astreal Defeat is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. It autofires streams of Astreal Arrows at four semi-randomized paths, ranging from straight forward to varying levels of curving downward, with a tendency to curve to the right as well, while only consuming arrows at the end of the stream. The arrows will begin to spawn spirit flames shortly after they're fired, which home in on nearby enemies and deal 50% of the weapon's base damage. Astreal Arrows inflict the Shadowflame debuff for 6 seconds upon striking an enemy.

wikiTooltip: Summons an astrophage to follow you around
intro: The Astrophage is a pet summoning item that is obtained from Astral and Monolith Crates. It summons an Astrophage to follow the player around. If the player is far away, it will teleport to keep up with them.

wikiTooltip: Equanimity
intro: Ataraxia is a post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswings. When swung, Ataraxia fires three rocket-like projectiles, two small and one large, towards the cursor. The larger projectile explodes on impact with a tile or enemy. The smaller projectiles split into several needles on impact, which fly a short distance from the impact point and rapidly damage enemies. When the blade itself strikes a foe, it creates a flower-shaped explosion which deals 70% of the weapon's damage to all enemies in a 12.5-tile radius.
Ataraxia, along with all of its projectiles and their explosions, inflict the Shadowflame debuff onto enemies.

wikiTooltip: Casts aquatic spears that split as they travel
intro: The Atlantis is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. When used, it fires aquatic spears which pierce 3 times and lose 20% damage per hit. Aquatic spears travel through tiles, in a distinct pattern consisting of 1 halberd in a straight line, then 2 spears connected in the shape of a V, heading outwards from the player in a straight line.

When in Overdrive the cannon uses its full power to bring down any foe
When held, the cannon will always be in Overdrive
'It's surprisingly easy to pick up'
intro: Atlas Munitions Beacon is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XM-05 Thanatos has been defeated last. When used, a drop pod falls from the sky down towards the cursor's position. Upon landing on a solid tile or platform, a visual screenshake will occur and the drop pod deploys a turret with a hold-able autocannon. After the turret is deployed, the top cover part of the drop pod will blast off into the sky. While on the turret, the autocannon fires blue lasers towards nearby enemies. If the enemy is within a 45-tile radius, the autocannon instead fires three overdriven red lasers at a slower rate. Overdriven lasers emit small visual sparkles on hit, move faster, and deal 18% more damage. While in overdrive, the autocannon heats up after 100 continuous shots, signaled by a gradual increase in steam and redness, eventually causing it to stop attacking for three seconds. The autocannon also passively cools down as it stops attacking even if heat is not full. The turret can attack enemies through tiles, but its lasers cannot pass through them.

tooltip: 자기장 에너지 칼날을 방출하는 손목 장착형 장치입니다
오른쪽 클릭 시 커서 위치에 짧은 자기장 인력을 생성하고 다음 참격을 강화합니다

[c/1FFBFF:위력을 포기하지 않으면서도 양손을 자유롭게 사용할 수 있다는 점은 대단히 인체공학적이었습니다.']
wikiTooltip: A wrist mounted device which emits a magnetic energy blade
intro: The P-GSS: Auger is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates energy slashes directed towards the cursor. Right-clicking spawns a magnetic field at the cursor which pulls in enemies. After using the right-click, the next slash is empowered, dealing 250% base damage and being guaranteed to critically strike, converting critical strike chance into extra damage. The right-click has a 13.33 second cooldown which is made shorter by melee speed boosts.

tooltip: 적을 꿰뚫는 속성 촉수들을 일제히 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Casts a burst of elemental tentacles to spear your enemies
intro: The Augur of the Void is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome and the direct upgrade to the Shadowflame Hex Doll and Eldritch Tome. When used, it constantly releases bursts of rainbow tentacles attached to the spell tome, which do not pierce, can travel through blocks, and inflict the Elemental Mix debuff on hit.

tooltip: 적의 보호 수치를 감소시키는 빛나는 고속 탄환을 발사합니다
제자리에 가만히 서 있으면 피해량 보너스가 최대 25%까지 증가합니다

Standing still for 5 or more seconds while using the scope ability will summon an aurora
The aurora reduces the damage of the next projectile hit by 100
This effect lasts up to 20 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown
intro: The Auralis is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is the direct upgrade to the Sniper Rifle. When used, it fires a high-velocity blue-green dust round which pierces up to four targets and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. Holding down right click will use its zoom ability, which scrolls the viewing area of the screen in the direction of the cursor, similarly to how the Sniper Rifle's zoom functions.

The player builds up damage when they are standing still, up to a maximum of 25% increase to damage after 5 seconds. If the player uses a scope effect whilst having the maximum damage boost, they will form a blue-green aura akin to the Profaned Moonlight Dye for 20 seconds with a 30-second cooldown. While the aura is active, the next projectile that hits the player will deal 100 less damage and will remove the aura. The damage boost and aura are reverted if the player moves.

tooltip: 위 키를 눌러 더 빠르게 상승

Flight time: 2 seconds
'Mach speed with style!'

tooltip: 마법 강화 및 마나 재생 버프를 부여합니다
wikiTooltip: Grants the Magic Power and Mana Regeneration buffs
intro: The Aureus Cell is a Hardmode potion that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. Upon consumption, it grants the Mana Regeneration and Magic Power buffs for 8 minutes. It is used in the crafting of various Astral Infection-themed items and the Auralis.
Auric Absorber is a craftable post-Moon Lord block.

tooltip: 금속 자체에서 무한한 힘이 뿜어져 나오고 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Boundless power emanates from the metal
intro: Auric Bars are post-Moon Lord bars that are made with Auric Ore and a Yharon Soul Fragment. They are used in creating some of the most powerful items the Calamity Mod has to offer, as well as Shadowspec Bars, which are used in the crafting of developer-tier items.

wikiTooltip: Explodes when stepped on...
intro: The Auric Land Mine is a craftable post-Moon Lord furniture item. Once placed, it is able to be activated through contact with any player, most projectiles, NPC, or wire. Once activated, it removes player immunity frames and creates an enormous lightning explosion which deals 40,000 damage, inflicts extreme knockback, and causes the screen to violently shake.

wikiTooltip: Infused with long lost draconic energies
intro: Auric Ore is a post-Moon Lord ore that generates in the Cavern layer after Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth has been defeated. Its main use is to craft Auric Bars, which are then used in creating some of the most powerful gear in the mod. It requires at least a Blossom Pickaxe to mine.

If the player touches the ore while not equipping either a full set of Auric Tesla armor or the Seraph Tracers, they will suffer Auric Rejection. This causes all Auric Ore on screen to flash bright blue, dealing 300 damage to the player and knocking them backwards at 40 (150 tiles/second) velocity on contact. Wearing a knockback immunity accessory will halve this value. Auric Ore can also damage and knockback NPCs and Super Dummies, dealing 5% of their maximum health as damage. If any target touches the ore, they will be inflicted with the Auric Rebuke debuff.
Auric Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block. It is used in the crafting of Auric-themed furniture and Exo-Auric Panels.

tooltip: 암호 해독기에 설치하여 장치를 완성할 수 있습니다
암호 해독기를 완성하면 원래 제작자와 접촉할 수 있습니다

wikiTooltip: Repels players that come in contact with it
intro: Auric Repulser Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block. Similarly to Auric Ore, it can repel players that touch it. This repel has the same strength (40 velocity or 150 tiles/second), but it does no damage and always repels the player regardless of equipment.

intro: The Auric Toilet is a craftable post-Moon Lord toilet crafted from several post-Moon Lord chairs and Auric Bars at a Cosmic Anvil.

If the player sits on the toilet while not equipping either a full set of Auric Tesla armor or the Seraph Tracers, they will suffer Auric Rejection. This deals 300 damage to the player and knocks them backwards at a velocity of 150 tiles per second on contact. Wearing a knockback immunity accessory will halve this value. In addition to this, the player will be inflicted with the Auric Rebuke debuff.

tooltip: 별 모양의 궤적을 그리며 [cbuff:CalamityMod/AstralInfectionDebuff]를 부여하는 성운 줄기를 뿜어냅니다
wikiTooltip: Uses gel for ammo
intro: The Aurora Blazer is a Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. It uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires astral flames that travel in a star-shaped pattern, inflicting the Astral Infection debuff on hit. These flames additionally lose 20% damage per hit until they are turned. After the flames travel for 0.4 seconds or 45 tiles, they adjust their direction to that of the player's.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 오로라 정령
잠시 날아간 뒤 분열하는 별을 던집니다

wikiTooltip: Launches a star that splits after a short period of time
Split stars home in on nearby enemies after a few seconds
Stealth strikes summon a meteor upon enemy impact
intro: The Auroradical Throw is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it throws an astral star that splits into 5 stars in a pentagon shape after traveling a moderate distance. The split stars travel away from the split impact for 2 seconds before homing in on nearby enemies. The split stars circle around the enemy for a brief moment before ramming into them to deal damage. The main star pierces infinitely, while the split stars do not pierce. Main and split stars inflict the Astral Infection debuff and go through tiles.
Performing a stealth strike with the Auroradical Throw causes each homing star to spawn a meteor from the sky to rain down on enemy hits, which deals 125% damage.

tooltip: 적 적중 시 주변을 궤도 비행하는 얼음 폭탄을 생성합니다
2초 후 얼음 폭탄은 중력의 영향을 받는 얼음 파편으로 폭발합니다
wikiTooltip: Hitting enemies spawns orbiting ice bombs
After 2 seconds, ice bombs explode into gravity-affected ice shards
intro: The Avalanche is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Cryogen. Upon hitting enemies, it spawns 4 ice bombs that orbit around the struck enemy. The ice bombs pass through tiles and explode into 4 gravity affected ice shards on enemy hits or after 3 seconds. The ice bombs deal 50% knockback, and the ice shards deal 50% base damage. Only 16 ice bombs can exist at a time.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 새끼 대형 해파리

wikiTooltip: Can be fired out of cannons
intro: The Baby Cannonball Jellyfish is a critter that spawns in the 1st layer of the Abyss. It remains still underwater and on land similarly to a Baby Ghost Bell and emits a small amount of turquoise light. When killed, it explodes in a small radius, capable of damaging the player. It can be caught with any type of Bug Net.

Baby Cannonball Jellyfish can be inserted into Cannons and shot outwards as an aggressively homing projectile that passes through tiles and explodes upon impact with enemies. This explosion deals 300 damage and can hit multiple enemies.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 새끼 대공포 게

intro: The Baby Flak Crab is a critter that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea biome or dropped while shaking an Acidwood Tree. Similarly to its adult counterpart, it disguises itself as a geyser. If the player gets too close to one, it will reveal itself and run away until they are far enough from the player. Baby Flak Crabs can be caught with any type of Bug Net, and will rarely drop the Geyser Shell when captured.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 새끼 유령 종

Counts as 3 alcohols for Alcohol Poisoning
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Bacon Oil is a Pre-Hardmode alcohol that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 30 silver coins during moon phases 1-4. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Bacon Oil debuff, which causes the following movement effects on its user:
Retain horizontal movement even while not pressing movement keys. This movement speed scales directly with the player's damage stat.

wikiTooltip: Increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%
Increases melee armor penetration by 5
intro: The Badge of Bravery is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.

Left click to freeze the passage of day and night temporarily
This does not work during celestial anomalies
The time freeze recharges while not in use
intro: The Bakidon is a Hardmode tool that freezes the passage of time for 10 minutes, with a cooldown of 10 minutes after it has expired. Time cannot be frozen during a Blood Moon, Frost Moon, Pumpkin Moon, or Solar Eclipse.

tooltip: 세 번 연속으로 빠르게 휘두르는 불타는 낫입니다
적 적중 시 유도 화염구로 분열되는 불타는 해골을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: A flaming scythe which is rapidly swung around three times in succession
Enemy hits summon flaming skulls that split into homing fire orbs
intro: The Baleful Harvester is a craftable Hardmode special sword. On use, it swings the blade around the player 3 times before a slight pause. Upon striking enemies with the blade, homing pumpkins and fiery orange skulls will spawn off-screen and attack enemies in the same fashion as The Horseman's Blade. Both projectiles deal 150% of the weapon's base damage and 50% knockback and skulls split into 2 homing fire orbs which each deal 50% of the weapon's base damage. The sword, the skulls and their fire orbs inflict the Hellfire debuff.

tooltip: 이 아이템을 활성화하면 장비로 인한 모든 돌진 기능을 비활성화합니다

wikiTooltip: Throws a sticky bomb that explodes into spikes and venomous clouds
intro: The Ballistic Poison Bomb is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws bombs that are affected by gravity. Upon contact with an enemy, it explodes and launches 3 spikes that fly in random directions, while also creating 3-5 poison clouds that pierce 4 times. Collision with a tile will cause the bomb to stick onto the tile for a short period of time, after which, it launches the fragments. The shrapnel will stick to all tiles and enemies and will explode after a short delay. The poison clouds deal 60% of the bomb's damage and the shrapnel deals 100% of the bomb's damage. The bombs, spikes, and clouds inflict the Acid Venom debuff.
Performing a stealth strike with the Ballistic Poison Bomb will cause the bomb to explode into 7-10 poison clouds that inflict Acid Venom for a longer duration.

wikiTooltip: Swings a banshee hook that fires blades and explodes on hit
intro: The Banshee Hook is a post-Moon Lord spear that is dropped by Polterghast. It is swung in front of the player at an odd angle, similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases a line of five projectiles at once, each dealing 85% of the weapon's damage. Hitting an enemy directly with the weapon causes a ghostly explosion, rapidly dealing 25% of the weapon's damage. Its projectiles go through blocks, ignore immunity frames, pierce infinitely, and will slow to a stop some distance away if uninterrupted.

wikiTooltip: Medium improvements to all stats
intro: The Barberry is a Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking regular monolith trees in the Astral Infection. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 5 minutes.
Like all other food items, the Barberry can be placed on a Plate:

tooltip: 공중을 가뿐히 가로지르는 두 발의 수렴형 고속 지느러미 화살을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires two converging high-velocity fin arrows that easily soar through the air
intro: The Barinade is a Pre-Hardmode bow that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it converts all arrows into two fast fin arrows that meet at the cursor and do not pierce.

tooltip: 나무 화살을 폭발하는 3개의 전격 화살로 변환합니다
wikiTooltip: Converts wooden arrows into strings of 3 electric bolt arrows that explode

When Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, arrows are replaced with electric arrows that explode upon impact. Each electric arrow is able to damage an enemy twice, for a total of 6 hits.

intro: The Bobbit Hook is a post-Moon Lord grappling hook that is dropped by Bobbit Worms. It reaches 40 tiles and up to two hooks can be launched, however only one hook can attach to a block or platform at a time. When a hook retracts upon attaching to a tile, it will cause the player to travel at extreme speeds.
It has a pull-in speed of 24 and reelback velocity of 28.

intro: The Bonebreaker is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon that is an upgrade to Bone Javelins. It fires javelins that stick to enemies for a long time, then bursting into damaging rocky shrapnels. Up to six javelin projectiles can be stuck on an enemy at once.

wikiTooltip: Summons aureus bombers to chase down your enemies

intro: The Borealis Bomber is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it summons an Aureus Bomber that does not take up minion slots. It attacks by ramming into enemies within a range of 43 tiles and exploding upon impact, inflicting the Astral Infection debuff. The Aureus Bomber can move through tiles but cannot target enemies through them. If no enemies are nearby, the Aureus Bomber will follow the player and explode on its own after a moderate amount of time.

wikiTooltip: Fires a botanic energy beam
intro: The Botanic Piercer is a craftable Hardmode spear. When swung, it will fire out a green spear beam that pierces once, and can pass through tiles.
The Botanic Planter is a post-Moon Lord furniture item.

Knockback is much stronger during a blood moon
intro: The Bouncing Eyeball is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that drops from Wandering Eye Fish. When used, it throws a bouncing eyeball that pierces two enemies, bounces five times, or lasts 5 seconds before dissipating. Its knockback is increased by 3 during a Blood Moon.

Performing a stealth strike with the Bouncing Eyeball will cause the eyeball thrown to pierce and bounce an unlimited number of times within 5 seconds, makes it travel much faster and unaffected by gravity, and makes it bounce almost directly towards the direction it came from, gently reaching a 45 degree angle, no matter the angle at which it strikes a block. It can damage a single enemy up to 6 times per second.

wikiTooltip: 5% increased jump speed and 20% increased jump height
intro: The Bounding Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 상자 해파리
<스텔스 스트라이크> 더 많이 분열되는 유황다트를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a blade that splits on enemy hits
Stealth strikes split further and cause the player to launch a barrage of brimstone darts
intro: The Brimblade is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a brimstone blade that returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting an enemy. When a blade strikes an enemy, it will split into more blades (up to a maximum of 3), which also return to the player shortly after being released. The split blades deal 30% of the main blade's damage. The amount of brimblades that spawn from the split collision depends on where they hit the enemy from, meaning it is possible for the Brimblade to not spilt at all. The main and split blades inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff and emit a burst of red particles on enemy collision.

Performing a stealth strike with the Brimblade will fire four brimstone darts alongside the Brimblade, and also increases the maximum split blades from 3 to 4. The brimstone darts deal the same amount of damage as the Brimblades, but have halved knockback.

intro: The Brimlance is a Hardmode spear that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. Upon hitting an enemy with the spear, it causes a brimstone explosion along with firing 2 lingering brimstone sparks in random directions. The explosion deals 35% of the weapon's base damage, pierces twice, and lasts for 1 second. Up to 3 explosions can only exist at a time. Brimstone sparks pierce twice and deal 25% of the weapon's base damage, however they will be unable to deal damage once they land on the ground. The spear, explosions, and sparks inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

tooltip: 적을 공격시 유황 볼트를 발사하며 적이 처치되면 더욱 많은 유황 볼트를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a brimstone bolt that explodes into more bolts on hit
intro: The Brimlash is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires out a brimstone bolt that pierces infinitely and splits into 3 homing bolts upon hitting tiles or reaching the end of its range. Both the sword and the bolt inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

wikiTooltip: Summons a brimrose mount
intro: The Brimrose is a craftable post-Moon Lord mount summoning item. When used, it summons a Brimrose mount which acts similarly to the UFO summoned by the Cosmic Car Key, but is much faster and easier to control. The Brimrose is capable of moving at a speed of 62 mph horizontally and can reach 41 while moving vertically.

wikiTooltip: Fires a spread of splitting brimstone beams
intro: The Brimrose Staff is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a single short laser beam that instantly splits into two beams, with the resulting beams also splitting into two more beams. There are a total of four splits, resulting in an immediate flower of 16 beam-endings being created a short distance from the player in the direction fired. The beams inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff, pierce infinitely although each segment will deal 20% less damage per hit if it pierces more than once. The beams will bounce off of tiles, causing subsequent splits to have skewed angles and be shorter in size.
The Brimstone Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in lava in the Brimstone Crag. Its Pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Slag Crate.

tooltip: A glimpse into what could have been...

wikiTooltip: Converts wooden arrows into a spread of 3 brimstone bolts
intro: The Brimstone Fury is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it shoots 3 arrows in a slight spread. If Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, arrows are converted into three fast brimstone laser bolts with a slight spread. The bolts dissipate upon impact with tiles and can pierce twice. Upon hitting an enemy, the bolts inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

intro: The Brimstone Jewel is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item. It is obtained from the Treasure Coffer dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas in Expert Mode. It summons a miniature Supreme Calamitas to follow the player.

The Brimstone Lava Fountain is furniture item that is sold by the Witch Doctor for 4 gold coins. Similarly to water fountains, when activated via right-click or through wiring, it changes the color of all nearby lava to a mode=image pink color like the lava in the Brimstone Crag.

intro: The Brimstone Locus is an item placed in a player's inventory when they open the enchanting interface after talking to the Brimstone Witch for the first time. While it is in the inventory, this item causes items that can be exhumed to be marked with a special effect, appearing as a white aura gathering purple energy. This effect is accompanied by a pulse of the item's sprite once per second.
The following items will be marked by the Locus.

Brimstone Slab is a block that naturally generates in ruined structures of the Brimstone Crag. It can also be crafted with Brimstone Slag at a Heavy Work Bench. It requires at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.
Brimstone Slab Wall is a background wall crafted with Brimstone Slab.

Brimstone Slag is a block that comprises most of the Brimstone Crag biome, and typically surrounds Infernal Suevite. It spawns naturally upon world generation and is also dropped from Despair Stones. It requires at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.
Brimstone Slag Wall is a background wall. It is crafted with Brimstone Slag.

When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), it causes all active brittle stars to stop attacking and orbit around the player. While orbiting, brittle stars deal 200% base damage, do not shatter, and grant the player 3 defense per star.

All bullets are converted into bouncy explosive bullets, which emit a small amount of light and explode on hit or after 3 seconds have passed. These bullets can bounce twice before predictively bouncing towards an enemy.

intro: The Burning Revelation is a post-Moon Lord yoyo that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. While deployed, it constantly builds up charge as it is held out and can pass through tiles. Landing hits increases charge faster and creates explosions whose size scales with charge that deal 50% base damage. When the yoyo reaches full charge, it spawns rings of homing holy stars that scale in size and damage based on how far they travel, going from 12% to 27.6% base damage. Full damage stars spawn additional explosions on hit that deal 28.8% base damage. All of its attacks inflict the Holy Flames debuff.

wikiTooltip: Holding the fireball for too long causes it to burn out
intro: The Burning Sea is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. When used, a brimstone fireball is conjured near the player which grows to a massive size over 4 seconds. This fireball can weakly follow the cursor and hitting multiple enemies simultaneously reduces its damage by 30% per hit.

If the fireball is cast for longer than 9.67 seconds, it will burn-out, inflicting the player with the Brimstone Flames debuff for 2 seconds and preventing the weapon from being used for 2.5 seconds. Burn-out is telegraphed by the fireball turning red and emitting smoke.

Upon hitting an enemy, it shatters into a damaging particle explosion that deals 50% of the weapon's damage. The spiky ball and explosions inflict the Shadowflame debuff.
Performing a stealth strike with the Burning Strife causes the next spiky ball thrown to spawn several shadowflame tentacles on hit.

intro: The Burnt Sienna is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that drops from Tomb Crawlers. When swung, it emits visual light particles. Enemies killed using the weapon will drop three small orbs that each heal the player for 2 HP when picked up.

intro: The Burrower Beacon is a light pet summoning item that summons a friendly Burrower to follow the player around. It can be obtained by killing the Burrower while it is inflicted with an electrical debuff.

The Burrower will periodically move to and illuminate nearby ores, mimicking the behavior of the normal enemy. If it tries to illuminate Auric Ore, it will get shocked and freeze for a short period of time.

intro: The Buzzkill is a craftable Hardmode ranged weapon. When held, it charges up a handheld buzzsaw which deals 100% damage on contact, but hitting multiple enemies simultaneously reduces its damage by 20% per hit. As continuously held, the buzzsaw grows to a medium size after 0.5 seconds and full size after 2 seconds, as well as linearly scaling from 100% to 500% damage and 1 to 5 pierce over 2 seconds. Once released, the saw of the held size is shot out, and is able to bounce off tiles. Each bounce consumes one pierce and the saw lasts 8 seconds before dissipating. All attacks inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff.

intro: Calamity is a post-Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. While an enemy is within range, the aura glows and continuously deals 320 damage at a rate of 12 hits per second, inflicting the Vulnerability Hex debuff. The damage type is determined by the player's strongest class bonuses.

If the cursor is held over an enemy for 2.5 seconds, the Vulnerability Hex debuff upgrades to the True Vulnerability Hex debuff. The True Vulnerability Hex deals 1332 damage per second and causes the enemy to take 1.15x damage from all sources, and 2.5x damage from the cursor itself.

While the effects of the Caribbean Rum debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

It attacks enemies by exploding itself every 2 seconds into 9 damaging chunks which inflict the Irradiated debuff. The toad will have a green outline around itself when it is about to explode.

intro: The Caustic Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a black Caustic Dragon minion that flies behind the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing thorns that pass through tiles and pierce twice.
The minion's strength scales based on how many are currently present. Each additional minion increases the attack speed of all minions, and makes thorns inflict additional debuffs:

wikiTooltip: Causes an acidic downpour in the Sulphurous Sea
intro: The Caustic Tear is a Pre-Hardmode event summoning item that is used to start the Acid Rain event.
Using the Caustic Tear will not start the event if a Lantern Night is occurring.

wikiTooltip: Causes you to suck up all items in the world
intro: The Ceaseless Hunger Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Ceaseless Hunger buff, which causes all items within the world to be sucked up by the player.

tooltip: 닿지 못한 가능성을 엿본 찰나의 순간...
플레이어 주변에 우주의 에너지 불꽃을 일으켜 커다란 폭발을 일으킵니다
wikiTooltip: Spawns cosmic energy stars near the cursor
intro: The Celestial Claymore is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Biome Mimics. On each swing, it will spawn 2 red, blue, or yellow cosmic stars at locations near the cursor's position. The stars hover towards the player, faster if the player is further away, and explodes aesthetically after a few seconds. Each star deals 100% of the weapon's base damage and additionally inflicts a different debuff corresponding to its color:
{| class="terraria lined"

wikiTooltip: Permanently increases the number of accessory slots
This item does nothing in Master Mode
Alien power pulses inside its layers
intro: If the player does not have a sixth accessory slot yet, the Celestial Onion can be used, and it will grant the sixth accessory slot. However, in Expert Mode, the seventh slot will not be granted until after the player has consumed the Demon Heart.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 낫의 궤적에 잔상이 남아 피해를 입힙니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a fast homing scythe
The scythe will bounce after hitting an enemy up to six times
Stealth strikes create damaging afterimages
intro: The Celestial Reaper is a post-Moon Lord rogue weapon that is sold by the Bandit for 3 platinum coins after the Moon Lord has been defeated. When thrown, it will home in on an enemy and will bounce back from the enemy when it hits, allowing it to redirect itself to hit and bounce off of a different enemy, or simply turn around and hit the same enemy again. It will do this up to six times or 10 seconds, slowing down after each hit. After it hits for the sixth time or after the weapon lingers for 10 seconds, it splits into several fast, damaging afterimages, each dealing 50% damage.

Performing a stealth strike with the Celestial Reaper will cause the next scythe to deal 90% damage and leave behind additional damaging afterimages as it travels; these spawn in greater quantities as the main scythe hits more enemies, but deal 22.5% damage.
Celestial Remains are Hardmode blocks which replaces Desert Fossils in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation. Like their counterpart, they can be used in the Extractinator.
Celestial Remains Wall is a background wall that replaces Desert Fossil Wall in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.

tooltip: 적을 타격시 여러개의 낫으로 분열하는 낫을 던집니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 낫이 되돌아온 뒤 방향을 바꿔 적을 추적합니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a high-velocity scythe that splits into multiple phantom scythes on enemy hits
Stealth strikes reverse direction and home in on enemies after returning to the player
intro: The Celestus is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang. When used, it rapidly throws a high velocity scythe that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. Every time it hits an enemy, it releases 8 double-edged phantom blades that travel outward from the point of impact. The phantom blades deal 70% of the weapon's damage, pierce infinitely, and pass through tiles but cannot release more blades.

Performing a stealth strike with the Celestus causes the resulting scythe to rebound inaccurately when returning to the player, homing into the closest enemy but no longer pierces. The scythe will not return to the player for the second time when rebounding.

tooltip: '마녀는 다시는 이런 일이 일어나도록 내버려 두지 않을 것이다'
wikiTooltip: Use at the Altar of the Accursed to summon the Supreme Witch, Calamitas
Not consumable
'The Witch will not allow it to happen once again.'
intro: The Ceremonial Urn is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon Supreme Witch, Calamitas. It can only be used at an Altar of the Accursed.
When the Ceremonial Urn is used, a square arena make of Brimstone Magic will form around the player.

tooltip: 출혈, 불타는 피, 과다출혈, 찢김에 면역이 됩니다
체력 재생 +2, 치유 포션의 재사용 대기시간 25% 감소

이 출혈은 체력 재생을 방해하지 않습니다
치유 포션을 마시면 남은 출혈 피해량의 일부를 제거하며 최대 포션 치유량의 50%까지 제거합니다
출혈 상태에서 이 장신구를 해제하면 남은 피해를 즉시 입습니다
'고작 피 한 방울을 얻으려고 그 난리를...'

+2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%

intro: The Chalice of the Blood God is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+25% maximum health

wikiTooltip: The mere presence of this candle enrages surrounding enemies drastically
intro: The Chaos Candle is a craftable Hardmode furniture item that will emit light and grant the Chaos Candle buff, which boosts all spawn rates by 100% and maximum spawn count by 100%.

tooltip: 마나를 소모하는 아이템을 마나가 부족하더라도 사용할 수 있게 됩니다
마나 소모량이 음수까지 넘어가며 자신과 적에게[cbuff:CalamityMod/ManaBurn]을 부여합니다
