intro: The Chaos Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Calamitas Clone. When equipped, the player gains the ability to use mana even without the required amount, with the mana going into negative values and inflicting both the player and enemies with the Mana Burn debuff.
Negative mana is capped at the player's maximum mana, but negative. When at this value, magic weapons can still be used but will not lower the player's mana any further.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 혼돈의 복어
동력 전지를 사용해서 드레이돈의 아이템을 충전합니다
아이템과 동력전지를 모두 넣어 아이템을 충전 시킵니다
wikiTooltip: Charges Draedon's Arsenal items using Draedon Power Cell
Place both an item and Power Cells into the Charging Station to charge the item
intro: Charging Station is a furniture item used to charge certain weapons. It uses Draedon Power Cells as fuel to grant weapons charge. To charge an item, right-click the station, put the arsenal weapon at the top, and the power cell at the bottom. It can be found inside Arsenal Labs.

tooltip: 유황 개사층에서 사용 시 브림스톤 엘레멘탈을 소환합니다
'그녀의 시선이 닿는 모든 것은 형체도 알아볼 수 없을 만큼 타오를 것이다'
wikiTooltip: Summons the Brimstone Elemental when used in the Brimstone Crags
Enrages outside the Brimstone Crags
Not consumable
'Anything under her gaze shall be scorched beyond recognition.'
intro: The Charred Idol is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Brimstone Elemental. It can only be used in the Brimstone Crag.

tooltip: 이 희귀한 물고기는 매우 값진 상품입니다
wikiTooltip: This elusive fish is a prized commodity
intro: The Charred Lasher is a very rare fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag. Its only use is to be sold for a fair amount of money.

wikiTooltip: Contains a small amount of brimstone
intro: The Charred Relic is a Hardmode pet summoning item that summons a Brimling to follow the player around. It is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Brimstone Elemental in Revengeance Mode.

The Brimling will float behind the player and follow them very closely at all times. If the player manages to outrun her for too long, she will teleport near them and create some red dust in the process.

tooltip: 거대한 화염 폭발을 일으키는 치킨 조명을 발사합니다
intro: The Chicken Cannon is a post-Moon Lord launcher that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it rapidly fires chicken rockets that bounce straight up when hitting the ground before causing a gigantic explosion after a short delay, inflicting the Dragonfire debuff. The explosion lingers for a few seconds and ignores immunity frames.

tooltip: 충전하여 무지갯빛 불꽃과 적을 추척하는 쌍선형 색채 불꽃을 내뿜습니다
wikiTooltip: Charges up to spew rainbow flames and pairs of homing chromatic flares
Uses gel for ammo
50% chance to save ammo
intro: The Chromatic Eruption is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires long bursts of rainbow flames that pierce five times. It additionally fires pairs of homing elemental flares.

tooltip: 주변의 적과 위험 요소를 표시해 주는 고대의 용 조명 펫을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons an ancient dragon light pet that highlights nearby enemies and danger sources
Provides a small amount of light in the abyss
'It glows warmly in your hand'
intro: The Chromatic Orb is a Hardmode light pet summoning item that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it summons an ancient dragon to follow the player around. The player can control the movement of the pet by pressing the direction keys similar to the Wisp in a Bottle. While the pet is active, the player will gain the Hunter and Dangersense effects.

tooltip: <우클릭> 대낫을 휘둘러 주변에 시계 모양의 유도 고드름을 생성합니다
대낫으로 적을 직접 명중시키면 시계를 생성할 수 있습니다
시계를 모으면 이동 속도와 가속도가 5%씩 증가합니다
최대 3회 중첩되며 각 중첩은 5초 후 사라집니다
wikiTooltip: Direct hits with the scythe have a chance to spawn clocks
Collecting the clocks increases movement speed and acceleration by 5% for each clock collected
This stacks up to 3 times and each level wears off after 5 seconds

tooltip: 적중 시 작은 폭발을 일으키며 유황불 피해를 입히는 화살을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Explosive arrows that burst into weak flaming Brimstone Shards
intro: Cinder Arrows are craftable Hardmode arrows. They create a small explosion on hit, dealing 40% damage to all nearby enemies. They also additionally burst into three gravity-affected flaming pieces of shrapnel which do not pierce, deal 6% damage, and inflict Brimstone Flames.

tooltip: 머리 위에 정말 뜨거운 꽃을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a scorching flower over your head
There can only be one flower at a time
intro: The Cinder Blossom Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a spinning scorching flower minion above the player's head that fires a flaming cinder at nearby enemies which pierces twice and passes through tiles. Cinders create a small explosion on enemy hits in the shape of a flower with three, four, or five petals in a randomized manner. Unlike most minions, only one Cinder Blossom can be summoned at a time. The cinders inflict the On Fire! debuff.

wikiTooltip: It resonates with otherworldly energy
intro: Cinderplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Space Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Normality Relocator and Laser Turrets.
Cinderplate Wall is a background wall crafted with Cinderplate.

tooltip: 커서 위치에 카타클리즘 또는 카타스트로피를 소환합니다
당신에게 돌진하기 전에 당신을 잠시 쳐다봅니다
돌진은 적과 당신에게 모두 피해를 입힙니다
wikiTooltip: Summons either Cataclysm or Catastrophe at the mouse position
They will look at you for a moment before charging at you
They can do damage to both you and enemies

tooltip: 3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Greatly increases dash speed
Greatly reduces dash distance
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Cinnamon Roll is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Cinnamon Roll debuff, which increases dash velocity by 100% but significantly reduces dash distance.
While the effects of the Cinnamon Roll debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 적에게 박힌 뒤 앞으로 돌진하며 경로상의 모든 것을 베어버립니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes stick into enemies before launching forward, slicing everything
intro: The Cinquedea is a Pre-Hardmode non-consumable dagger that is sold by the Bandit for 10 gold coins. When used, it throws a dagger that is affected by gravity and pierces once.

Performing a stealth strike with the Cinquedea will cause the next dagger thrown to briefly stick to the enemy before launching forward with infinite pierce. These daggers have an 150% damage modifier and 125% velocity multiplier.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 클래드 크랩
주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 조개
짧은 시간 적을 기절시키는 거대한 조개를 발사합니다
일정 시간이 지나면 중력의 영향을 받아 떨어지며 더 큰 피해를 입힙니다
wikiTooltip: Starts being affected by gravity and does much more damage after being airborne for a while
intro: The Clam Crusher is a Hardmode flail that is dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss in the Sunken Sea. It throws out a giant gravity-affected clam that will inflict the Eutrophication debuff onto enemies. The Clam will deal 4x as much damage if it is first fired into the air, then falls and lands onto an enemy. Once the clam hits a block or an enemy, it will retract back to the player.

tooltip: 머스킷 총알이 적을 추적하는 에너지 볼트로 변환됩니다
wikiTooltip: Converts musket balls into homing energy bolts
Energy bolts briefly stun enemies
intro: The Clamor Rifle is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by the Giant Clam mini boss. It transforms Musket Balls into aquatic energy bolts that will home in on enemies. Upon impact with an enemy or a tile, the aquatic energy bolt will split into three smaller bolts, that will deal 40% of the initial bullet's damage.

tooltip: 탄환은 적에게 명중 시 폭발하며 혈액 구체를 생성합니다
폭발은 적을 찢어발겨 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Laceration] 상태로 만들고 방어력을 크게 감소시킵니다
혈액 구체를 습득하면 가능할 경우 [cbuff:PotionSickness]의 지속 시간을 감소시킵니다
[cbuff:PotionSickness] 상태가 아니라면 체력 재생 능력이 강화됩니다
이 무기의 공격력은 모든 피해량 능력치의 평균값에 비례하여 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a hypercondensed claret round
The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs
The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense
Can only fire once every 10 seconds
This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
intro: The Claret Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds. If the player is not afflicted by Potion Sickness, the orbs increase the player's natural health regeneration. The Claret Cannon can only be fired once every 10 seconds, with its cooldown indicated by a small bar underneath its sprite in the hotbar.

wikiTooltip: Uses gel for ammo
intro: The Cleansing Blaze is a craftable post-Moon Lord flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires a large spread of purple flames that pierce infinitely, pass through tiles, and inflict the God Slayer Inferno debuff on hit.

tooltip: 치유 포션 사용 시 30초 동안 지속되는 푸른 오라를 소환합니다
오라 안으로 들어가면 단 한 번 모든 디버프가 제거됩니다
wikiTooltip: Using a healing potion spawns a blue aura that lasts for 30 seconds
Walking into the aura removes all debuffs one time
intro: The Cleansing Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Blue Jellyfish and Mirage Jellies. While equipped, drinking a healing potion spawns a blue cleansing aura. All debuffs are removed upon entering the aura, and this effect applies once per aura.

tooltip: 정밀볼트를 많이 장전할수록 더 강하게 공격합니다
wikiTooltip: The more precision bolts are loaded, the harder they hit
Shoots 3 shadowflame skulls

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 구름의 정령
주기적으로 스파크를 내뿜어 주변 적을 감전시킵니다
[c/5C95A1:'침몰한 바다 왕국의 주민들은 수중 효율을 위해 도구와 무기들을 개조했다.]
[c/5C95A1:유령 종의 전기적 특성은 죽은 후에도 유용하게 남아있어서 종종 도관으로 사용되었습니다.']
wikiTooltip: Fishes up an electric jellyfish
Periodically sends out sparks to electrocute nearby enemies.
intro: The Cnidarian is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, the user holds out a fishing rod and a jellyfish on a string attaches to the bottom of the user's cursor. Moving the cursor causes the string to swing proportional to the rate of its movement, with the cursor as the pivot point. While enemies are nearby, it will select up to three enemies at random and fire electric sparks. If the jellyfish swings fast enough, it will assign minions to target the struck enemy and play a wet slap sound.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 니드리언

wikiTooltip: The horns lay a curse on those who touch it
intro: The Coastal Demonfish is a fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag with an 8% chance and obtained from Ashen Chests in the Brimstone Crag in stacks of 2-4. It is used in the crafting of the Hadal Stew and Seafood Dinner.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 적을 추적하는 4개의 코발트 에너지 볼트를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes fire four homing cobalt energy bolts
intro: The Cobalt Kunai is a craftable Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a cobalt dagger that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.
Performing a stealth strike with a Cobalt Kunai will instead fire four non-piercing cobalt energy bolts that home in on nearby enemies, ignore gravity and deal 140% of the weapon's damage.

wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth
6% increased rogue crit chance
intro: The Coin of Deceit is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

wikiTooltip: 'N(ice) work'
intro: The Coldheart Icicle is a post-Moon Lord item that is dropped by Supreme Ultramage, Permafrost. When selected, it is held stationary in front of the player and can deal damage to enemies that intersect it while held. More specifically, it deals damage equal to 0.5% of the enemy's maximum health for every frame that it contacts the enemy.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 대왕 오징어
인벤토리에서 이 아이템을 즐겨찾기하면 원하는 재련이 나올 확률이 증가합니다
이 효과는 무기를 재련할 때만 적용됩니다
적을 공격시 하늘에서 유성 무리를 떨어뜨립니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a swarm of meteors from the sky on enemy hits
intro: The Comet Quasher is a craftable Hardmode special sword that autoswings. On use, the sword is swung in a circular motion around the player. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player and rains a barrage of 4 meteors on them that deals 150% base damage. Meteors additionally explode on hit, dealing 75% base damage to all enemies within their radius except the target that is directly hit by the meteor.

tooltip: 마나 수정을 사용하여 마나가 최대치에 도달했을 때만 사용할 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Permanently increases maximum mana by 60
intro: The Comet Shard is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that can only be consumed once, and upon consumption, increases the player's maximum mana by 60. There are two other items that function identically to this: the Ethereal Core and the Phantom Heart. Each of these may only be used once and after that the player must use the other items to increase their maximum mana. With all three consumed, the player's maximum mana is capped at 380.

wikiTooltip: Medium improvements to all stats
'Tastes stellar!'
intro: The Cometfruit is a Hardmode food and fruit item that drops from shaking snowy monolith trees in the Astral Infection. When consumed, it grants the Plenty Satisfied buff for 5 minutes.
Like all other food items, the Cometfruit can be placed on a Plate:

tooltip: 혐오스러운 마법이 담긴 진홍색 볼트를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires powerful scarlet bolts suffused with hateful magics
intro: Condemnation is a post-Moon Lord repeater that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used the player holds the crossbow and charges up, increasing the number of arrows which is also indicated by a ring of dust. The player can load up to a maximum of 9 arrows and stop holding to release arrows with a 50% velocity boost. Each arrow deals 135% damage and spawns two smaller homing arrows every 0.75 seconds for a total of 3 times. Homing arrows deal half as much damage and, like the main arrows, travel through solid tiles.

tooltip: 하늘에서 추가적인 총알을 불러오는 총알을 흩뿌립니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a tight spread of bullets that call more bullets from the sky
intro: The Conference Call is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it shoots a tight spread of four bullets with tripled velocity. If an enemy is nearby, seven bullets are additionally fired from the sky targeting the enemy present. If multiple enemies are present, the seven bullets are equally distributed along the enemies. The bullets from the sky have halved lifespan, tripled velocity, can pass through solid tiles, and deal 80% damage.

tooltip: 폭발하는 곳에 불기둥을 일으키는 성수가 담긴 플라스크를 던집니다
아래 블록이 없다면 기둥이 생성되지 않습니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a holy flask of water that explodes into a sacred flame pillar
The pillar is destroyed if there's no tiles below it
Stealth strikes create three flame pillars instead of one on impact
The bottle is surprisingly dusty
intro: The Consecrated Water is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws a gravity affected holy flask that breaks upon contact with enemies or tiles. Upon breaking, the flask releases a 20-block high flame pillar that damages enemies and dissipates after three seconds.
Performing a stealth strike with the Consecrated Water will cause the next flask thrown to spawn two additional flame pillars to the left and right of the main pillar.

tooltip: 날아가며 폭발성 구체를 남기는 전염병 화살을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires contagion arrows that leave exploding orbs behind as they travel
intro: The Contagion is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer bow. It fires arrows that leave behind a trail of orbs, exploding after a short delay. Holding left-click will cause the bow to "spin-up", increasing the fire rate appreciably.

tooltip: 충돌 시 폭발하는 역겨운 녹색 플라스크를 던집니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes cause sulphuric bubbles to quickly rise from the cloud
intro: The Contaminated Bile is a Pre-Hardmode bomb dropped by Gnashers. It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.
Performing a stealth strike with the Contaminated Bile will cause the irradiated cloud to release rising sulphuric bubbles that deal additional damage.

tooltip: 지옥불 화살, 이코르 화살 중 2개를 추가로 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Wooden arrows are set alight with fire

Fires 2 additional hellfire or ichor arrows
intro: The Continental Greatbow is a craftable Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows. All ammunition is fired in volleys of three, followed by two arrows picked randomly: Ichor Arrows or explosive Hellfire Arrows.

적에게 달라붙었던 산호 덩어리를 획득하면 150의 마나가 회복됩니다
동시에 산호의 공격력 증가와 충전시간 감소를 일정시간 부여합니다
[c/5C95A1:'지식은 중요하며, 멸망한 해저왕국의 서기들은 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 지식은 보존되어야 한다는 것을 잘 알고 있었습니다.]
[c/5C95A1:지식보존을 위해 석판에 기록하여 보관하다보니 해저왕국의 도서관은 매우 매우 거대했습니다.']
wikiTooltip: Casts a shotgun-like blast of coral shards
Keep the attack button held down to narrow the spread
Coral shards ignore 5 points of enemy defense
Fully charging the attack releases a single, bigger chunk of coral that sticks to enemies

intro: The Coral Spout is a craftable Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used, it fires a spread of 5 pink coral spikes that travel a short distance before exploding, dealing damage to enemies. Additionally, it can also be charged up to decrease the spread of the coral spikes. When charged for 1.25 seconds, the coral spike projectiles will be replaced with a light blue coral chunk. Coral chunks deal 700% base damage, travel much farther, and at a higher velocity. When a coral chunk hits an enemy, it will stick to that enemy for 3 seconds before falling off. After falling off of an enemy, coral chunks will linger for 5.5 seconds, and can be recovered by the player to restore 150 mana. All projectiles have an innate 5 armor penetration.
Additionally, recovering a coral chunk will grant the player the Coral Symbiosis buff for 8 seconds, which causes the weapon to charge up 1.25x as fast and deal 2 extra damage.

tooltip: 위장은 자연이 가진 최고의 방어 수단 중 하나입니다

intro: Cores of Calamity are craftable Hardmode crafting materials crafted from Ashes of Calamity, Ectoplasm and three different types of essence at a Hardmode Anvil.

그렇지 않으면 매우 작은 폭발을 일으킵니다
머스킷 총알을 고속 폭발 탄환으로 변환합니다

Otherwise, the grenade emits an extremely weak explosion

'Seems like it has worn down over time'
intro: The Corpus Avertor is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it throws a black knife that spawns smaller homing red knives as it travels. The red knives pass through tiles, deal 40% of the weapon's damage, and heal the player for 5% of their damage dealt. 10% of the player's missing health is added to the weapon's base damage.

tooltip: 나무 화살을 피폭 오라를 남기는 강력한 껍질로 변환합니다
wikiTooltip: Converts wooden arrows into slow, powerful shells that trail an irradiated aura
intro: The Corroded Caustibow is a craftable Hardmode bow. When Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, It fires slow gravity-affected toxic shells that emit a wet aura along its path which deals 15% of the weapon's damage. The toxic shell itself pierces five enemies and breaks upon contact with tiles. The wet aura and toxic shells inflict the Irradiated debuff.

wikiTooltip: It's very sturdy
intro: Corroded Fossils are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by various enemies in the Acid Rain event after the Aquatic Scourge has been defeated, as well as some post-Aquatic Scourge Sulphurous Sea enemies. They are used to craft several weapons themed around the Acid Rain.

tooltip: 모든 공격이 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Irradiated] 디버프를 부여하며 유황 바다의 독성을 완화합니다
wikiTooltip: 5% increased movement speed
50% increased Sickness and Water debuff damage
You burst into radioactive clouds when struck
intro: The Corrosive Spine is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+5% movement speed

intro: The Corruption Effigy is a Pre-Hardmode furniture item that is found in the Lesion Chest within The Corruption shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 gold coins during a First Quarter after the item has been found. When right-clicked, the player will receive a 10% increase to movement speed and critical strike chance but will have their damage reduction reduced by 10%, potentially bringing it below 0%. The buff does not stack with the Crimson Effigy.

tooltip: 순간이동과 돌진을 하는 강력한 까마귀를 소환합니다

intro: The Corvid Harbinger Staff is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Raven Staff. When used, it summons a dark raven minion that flies around and rapidly charges towards enemies, occasionally teleporting near them and leaving a ring of dust before continuing its charge.

tooltip: 별의 붕괴가 일으키는 압력을 견뎌낼 수 있는 이계의 모루입니다
그 이전 단계의 모든 모루와 동일한 기능을 수행합니다

intro: Cosmic Anvil is a post-Moon Lord crafting station that is an upgrade to the Hardmode Anvil. It is used to craft most post-The Devourer of Gods items.

intro: The Cosmic Discharge is a post-Moon Lord flail that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods.

소용돌이는 적을 탐지하면 추적하는 에너지 볼트를 발사합니다

intro: The Cosmic Immaterializer is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons an entity of cosmic energy that fires homing energy bolts and exploding stars at enemies. It requires 10 minion slots to summon 1 energy, and only 1 energy can be active at once.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 적을 관통하고 더 멀리 날아가며 적을 추적하는 5개의 낫이 생성됩니다

intro: The Cosmic Kunai is a post-Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by Signus. When used, it rapidly fires a stream of fast-moving, short-range kunai that pass through tiles, are not affected by gravity, and inflict the Whispering Death debuff. The kunai turn transparent as they travel; however, this does not affect their damage and is only aesthetic. The kunai also very slightly curve towards nearby enemies.

Performing a stealth strike with the Cosmic Kunai will cause 9 cosmic scythes to release around the player alongside the kunai that pierce four times. The scythes each deal 150% damage and inflict the Laceration debuff. The kunai sharply home in on enemies and erupt into an explosion upon contact. If there are no enemies nearby, the scythes will linger in midair for 2.5 seconds before disappearing.

wikiTooltip: Summons the devourer of the cosmos...?
'Sharp objects possibly included'
intro: The Cosmic Plushie is a post-Moon Lord pet summoning item that summons a miniature Devourer of Gods gijinka. It is obtained from the Devourer of Gods' Treasure Bag with a Hardcore character while Death Mode is active.

The Chibii Devourer will follow the player on foot. If the player moves or flies far away, it will create and fly on a miniature Cosmic Guardian to keep pace. Whenever it summons or dispels the worm, the pet will generate a small burst of red light akin to the player summoning or dispelling their own mount. Chibii Devourer emits a bright pink aura trail as it moves.

wikiTooltip: Launches a barrage of rainbows and homing sparkles
intro: The Cosmic Rainbow is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic weapon. When fired, it spawns 3 rainbows in the direction of the cursor in a similar manner as an arrow flying out of a bow. Additionally, 2 more rainbows fall from the sky at random locations within the vicinity of the cursor. These rainbows deal constant damage to any entity that collides with them.

tooltip: 적 적중 시 수많은 칼날이 나타나 적을 지속적으로 타격합니다
더 많은 별을 적중시킬수록 더 많은 칼날이 생성됩니다

Upon hitting an enemy, a barrage of blades will persistently strike
Landing more stars causes more blades to strike
intro: The Cosmic Shiv is a craftable post-Moon Lord shortsword that is the direct upgrade to the Lightspeed. When used, it fires a cosmic star that homes on nearby enemies and does not pierce. Striking up to 3 enemies with the shortsword itself or with the homing star causes the target to be attacked by 4-9 cosmic blades from random directions for the next 4 seconds. Cosmic blades can pierce up to 4 times. Hits from the stars or sword also have a chance to produce a purely visual star-shaped explosion which can vary in shape and size.

50% chance to save ammo

{| class="terraria lined"

intro: The Cosmic Worm is a craftable post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Devourer of Gods. It can be used anywhere at any time.

tooltip: 당신을 위해 싸울 우주의 랜턴을 소환합니다

intro: The Cosmilamp is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Signus. When used, it summons a Cosmilamp minion which hovers above the player and fires homing purple cosmic beams at nearby enemies. Cosmic beams pierce twice and travel through tiles.

intro: Cosmilite Bars are post-Moon Lord bars that are used to craft many pieces of late-game equipment as well as Cosmilite-related items. They are dropped by The Devourer of Gods.
Cosmilite Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Cosmilite Bars. It is also dropped by The Devourer of Gods. It is used in the crafting of Cosmilite furniture set.
Cosmilite Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Cosmilite Brick, which is in turn crafted with Cosmilite Bars.

tooltip: 순수한 우주 에너지에 노출되어 갓 다시 불타오른 잃어버린 유물입니다
<좌클릭>을 유지하여 낮과 밤의 흐름을 대폭 가속합니다

The time freeze lasts forever and works during celestial anomalies

intro: While dashing, the player gains the ability to dodge. This dodge is different from the other dodges as it has a separate cooldown, and its cooldown is always 30 seconds. The player will still be able to dash while the dodge is on cooldown.

오른쪽 클릭 시 모든 방출기를 집중시켜 항상 치명타를 입히는 단거리 손바닥 폭발을 일으킵니다

[c/1FFBFF:이 장갑은 두 가지 요구를 모두 충족하지만, 결코 두 전략 사이의 간극을 메워주지는 못할 것입니다.']
wikiTooltip: A precision welding glove with laser emitters in each fingertip
Palm blasts restore a large amount of mana on hit and have a cooldown which is significantly shorter if they miss
intro: The B-LSR: Countermeasure Mitt is a craftable Hardmode magic weapon. When used, it holds out a glove, which fires laser beams from each of its fingertips. The laser beams condense briefly before opening up into a wide spread.

Right-clicking creates a palm blast from the glove that deals 25x base damage, launches away enemies, restores 250 mana, and always critically strikes, converting critical strike chance into extra damage. The palm blast has a 6.67 second cooldown, which is reduced to 0.67 seconds if the palm blast misses.

tooltip: 동전을 총알로 맞추면 총알이 가장 가까운 적에게 도탄됩니다
최대 4개의 동전을 동시에 던질 수 있으며 총알은 여러 개의 동전에 도탄될 수 있습니다
적에게 도탄되는 총알은 항상 치명타로 적중합니다

intro: The Crackshot Colt is a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it transforms any suitable bullets into Marksman Rounds. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), a Copper Coin is consumed and fired with an upwards curve. Coins are gravity-affected and cannot damage enemies. They can also be recoverable at a 100% chance, unless multiple coins are hit by the same bullet, in which only the first coin hit is recovered. Only 4 thrown coins can be active at a time.
Copper Coins guarantee critical strikes and additively increase the damage of the Marksman Round by 125% on its first hit, and 25% on further hits.

wikiTooltip: Its scales are scorching hot
intro: The Crag Bullhead is a fishing catch caught in lava in the Brimstone Crag. It is used to craft Sashimi.

<스텔스 스트라이크> 적중한 대상에게 박혀 여러 번 폭발합니다
wikiTooltip: Alternates between throwing piercing, rolling disks and explosive disks
Stealth strikes embed into the hit foe, exploding multiple times
intro: The Cranium Smasher is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it alternates between throwing rolling disks and explosive disks. Rolling disks travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity, and will roll on the ground and pierce up to 4 times before dissipating on the fifth. Explosive disks will explode upon contacting an enemy or tile, dealing damage in a small radius.
Performing a stealth strike with the Cranium Smasher will throw a special disk that will stick to enemies, exploding multiple times while attached.

wikiTooltip: 7% increased damage

<좌클릭> 유지 시 철퇴를 주변으로 회전시켜 스타버스트를 생성합니다

intro: The Crescent Moon is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail that autoswings. When used, it spins a flail around the player, throwing out the flail towards the cursor when the attack button is released and creating homing crescent moon projectiles as it travels. While spinning the flail, homing crescents are spawned and the weapon generates Starburst, a unique resource with a cap of 100; the player's current Starburst amount is tracked on the Cooldown Rack and is shared among weapons.

Holding left-click after throwing the flail consumes 20 Starburst to make it explode into a Scorpius constellation instead of spawning homing crescents, dealing 300% base damage and inflicting the Voidfrost debuff.

When right-clicked, the player will receive a 10% damage boost as well as 5 defense but will have their maximum health decreased by 10%. The buff does not stack with the Corruption Effigy.

intro: The Crushsaw Crasher is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped from Catastrophic Construct. When used, the player swings a claw and throws a homing, spinning axe that can pierce one enemy or bounce once before disappearing on its next impact. The axe inflicts Heavy Bleeding upon any enemy it hits. The claw itself also deals contact damage and inflicts Brimstone Flames for a longer duration.
Performing a stealth strike with the Crushsaw Crasher will cause six axes to be thrown instead of one.

Not consumable
'A key for a glacial prison.'
intro: The Cryo Key is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Cryogen. It can only be used in the Snow or Ice biome.

플레이어 주변을 회전하며 접촉한 적에게 피해를 입히고 둔화시키는 얼음 보호막을 생성합니다
wikiTooltip: 50% increased Cold debuff damage

The main and split daggers cannot pierce or pass through tiles. If the main dagger hits an enemy or a tile before splitting, the extra daggers will not appear.

Performing a stealth strike with the Crystalline causes the resulting dagger copies to split into 3 more short-ranged copies. It also causes all daggers to explode into damaging crystal shards when hitting an enemy or tile. Daggers deal 170% of the weapon's damage, while crystals deal 30% damage.

It projects a single thick beam that deals individual damage, splitting and spinning at a fast rate out of the tip of the weapon. Over time, this spin effect slows down. The process for charging Dark Spark to max takes 10 seconds, each beam scaling from 25% to 220% of the weapon's damage. Each beam can hit 4 times per second individually (every 15 game ticks), which is a maximum of 24 possible hits per second. The mana cost will increase massively as the beam diverges.

intro: The Depth Crusher is a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that is dropped by Viperfish. It also has a chance to be inside the Abyss Shrine's Void Chest. When used, it throws a spinning crusher that is affected by gravity and bounces on enemies and tiles upon collision up to a maximum of 3 times before rapidly dropping down. Upon bouncing off a tile, the crusher releases a homing water energy particle which move upwards, and releases 3 water energy when shattering. Each water energy deals 30% damage, lasts 3.33-4.33 seconds, does not pierce but is able to pass through tiles. The crusher itself can pierce infinitely but only deals 20% damage after striking 3 times. The water energy inflicts the Riptide debuff.

Each bubble will aggressively home in onto enemies and will deal 60% of the flask's base damage.
Performing a stealth strike with the Desecrated Water will cause the next flask thrown to release twelve bubbles and all the bubbles inflict the Cursed Inferno and Ichor debuffs.

intro: The Diamond of the Deep is a craftable Hardmode accessory. While equipped it spawns abyssal spirits every 2.5 seconds which follow the player, up to a maximum of 3. The spirits are always spawned in the order of gravel spirit, hadal spirit, void spirit. Abyssal spirits disperse when the player dashes; their next action depends on the player's health:

If above 50% max health, abyssal spirits will attack enemies with a base damage of 400; gravel spirit explodes on hit and inflicts Crush Depth, hadal spirit pierces infinitely and inflicts Hellfire, and void spirit reattacks the same enemy up to 5 times, inflicting Hadopelagic Pressure.

When thrown at nearby enemies, it will fire a nebula laser beam that deal 70% of the weapon's damage.

Performing a stealth strike with the Dimension-Tearing Disk causes the next boomerang thrown to deal 130% damage and not return to the player, but slightly stick to enemies and fire nebula laser beams that deal 20% base damage in random directions before dissipating.

Right-clicking causes the player's Rage upgrades, Adrenaline upgrades and miscellaneous boosters to reset and be vomited out as items: including Mushroom Plasma Root, Infernal Blood, Red Lightning Container, Electrolyte Gel Pack, Starlight Fuel Cell, Ectoheart, Celestial Onion, Demon Heart, Vital Crystal, Aegis Fruit, Arcane Crystal, Ambrosia, Galaxy Pearl, Gummy Worm, Peddler's Satchel, Advanced Combat Techniques, Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two and Artisan Loaf.

intro: The Dormant Brimseeker is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When used, it summons a Brimseeker that charges towards enemies in a straight line to deal damage and it is able to target and attack enemies through tiles.

When used while all minion slots are exhausted, it instead launches a Dormant Brimseeker towards the cursor that emits a large aura of brimstone after stopping. This aura emits swirling non-piercing brimstone fireballs and Brimseekers that enter the aura will attack much faster until the Dormant Brimseeker expires. Only 1 Dormant Brimseeker can be active at a time. The fireballs inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

intro: The Draconic Destruction is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires a high-velocity sword beam that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles, and splits into 8 more sword beams in a circular formation on enemy hits. The split beams move out for a quick moment before erratically flying up and down constantly while spacing away from each other as they travel before dissipating. The sword itself inflicts the Daybroken debuff. The main sword beam inflicts the Dragonfire, Daybroken, Slime, and Oiled debuffs, while the split beams inflict the Dragonfire debuff. The sword beams also ignore NPC immunity frames.

When used and correctly input at the Charging Station, it is able to add 1 unit of charge to chargeable weapons per power cell. It can also be used at an Extractinator to obtain a renewable supply of Dubious Plating and Mysterious Circuitry.
Additionally, Draedon Power Cells are used to decrypt Schematics at the Codebreaker.

Twelve aquatic jets are also spawned in that will travel downwards, dealing damage, ignoring immunity frames, and passing through blocks, with each aquatic jet dealing 25% of the damage of the initial swing.

Every 2 seconds, hits from the baton summon a ring of 10-15 homing fireballs outwards which deal 50% base damage and create a damaging explosion on death. These fireballs will prioritize homing towards the enemy with the highest health. All of its attacks inflict the Dragonfire debuff.

While returning to the player, the boomerang fires blue-pink electric bolts at its closest enemy in a 30-tile radius, increasing in firing rate the faster the boomerang is moving. The electric bolt moves through solid tiles, pierces once, has a small area of effect, and deal 25% of the weapon's damage.

Performing a stealth strike with the Dynamic Pursuer will cause the next boomerang thrown to ricochet towards the closest enemy within a 62.5-tile radius. During the ricochet, it fires electric bolts at its closest enemy. It is able to hit up to four times before returning to the player, spawning a massive plasma explosion on the fourth hit. Additionally, the boomerang also fires two lasers in random directions alongside the electric bolts when returning back to the player. The laser moves through solid tiles, cannot pierce, has a small area of effect, and deal 4.5% of the weapon's damage. Electric bolts deal 3.75% of the weapon's damage. The boomerang and explosion each deal 25% of the weapon's damage.

intro: The Endogenesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. It summons an ascended ice construct that has four different modes:
Endo Cooper will fire five to seven lasers that will infinitely pierce in the direction of nearby enemies.

tooltip: 죽음의 냉기가 주변의 모든 생명력을 빨아들입니다
wikiTooltip: Its deathly chill sucks the life from its surroundings
intro: Endothermic Energy is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that is dropped by most Frost Moon enemies after The Devourer of Gods has been defeated. It is used to craft several late-game items typically themed around cold temperatures, and it is also used in conjunction with Darksun Fragments, Nightmare Fuel, and Necroplasm to make Ascendant Spirit Essence.

wikiTooltip: It pulses with energy
intro: Energy Cores are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Wulfrum enemies when they are supercharged. They are used to craft several Wulfrum related items.

tooltip: 공중을 헤엄치듯 나아가는 플라즈마 탄환을 부채꼴로 발사합니다
플라즈마는 마우스 커서나 그 주변의 적 중 더 가까운 대상을 추적합니다
플라즈마는 적을 관통하지만 첫 적중 이후에는 추적 성능이 사라집니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a spread of living plasma that swims through the air
Plasma will track your cursor or enemies near it, prioritizing which is closest
The plasma pierces, but will stop tracking after hitting the first enemy
intro: The Entropic Claymore is a craftable Hardmode broadsword with a custom swing animation. When swung, it fires a spread of 5 tapeworm projectiles on swing. Tapeworm projectiles deal 50% base damage, have an innate 15 armor penetration, and will home in toward the cursor, or toward enemies within a small range, losing their homing after hitting an enemy once.

tooltip: 당신을 보호하는 칼라미타스와 그녀의 형제들을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a mini Calamitas Clone and her brothers to protect you

tooltip: 타일이나 적을 타격시 역병 추적자를 방출하는 역병 부메랑을 던집니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 부메랑이 날아가면서 지속적으로 역병 추적자를 방출합니다
'이름과 달리 잘못 사용하면 전염병을 일으킬 수 있습니다'
wikiTooltip: Contrary to its name, it will probably cause an epidemic if used incorrectly
intro: The Epidemic Shredder is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a plague disk that pierces five times and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. The disk can bounce on tiles indefinitely until it reaches the player or despawns. The disk also occasionally releases homing plague seekers when it hits a tile or an enemy, dealing 60% of the weapon's damage. The disk and seekers inflict the Plague debuff.
Performing a stealth strike with the Epidemic Shredder will cause the next disk thrown to release plague seekers as it travels.

tooltip: 적 사이를 도탄하며 혼란에 빠트리는 부메랑을 던집니다
적중 시 적을 추적하는 빛의 파편이나 관통하는 어둠의 파편을 소환합니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 도탄될 때 마다 빛과 어둠의 폭발이 번갈아 일어나며 반대 속성 파편의 위력을 강화합니다
wikiTooltip: Enemy hits alternate summoning homing light shards or piercing dark shards
Stealth strikes cause an alternating explosion of light or dark on every ricochet, empowering the opposite color of shard
intro: Equanimity is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a boomerang that has a custom throw animation and can ricochet between enemies. On enemy hits, the boomerang alternates between spawning piercing dark shards and homing light shards. Light and dark shards each deal 80% of the weapon's damage and are affected by gravity.

Performing a stealth strike with the Equanimity will cause the next boomerang thrown to create an explosion on each hit which empowers the opposite color shard: dark shards gain increased pierce, and light shards gain increased homing range.

tooltip: 정수의 낫을 날리며 적이 처치되면 치유의 정령이 나타납니다
wikiTooltip: Shoots an essence scythe that generates healing spirits on enemy kills
intro: The Essence Flayer is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When swung, it fires a spinning purple scythe that functions similarly to the Death Sickle's sickles, traveling a moderate distance before stopping in place. The scythe spins for a few seconds before slowly stopping, becoming slightly transparent and dissipating afterwards. The scythe homes on nearby enemies and deals continuous damage for up to 11 hits before dissipating. The scythe can pierce up to 9 times. When enemies are killed by the scythes, healing essence flames will spawn which home on the player and explode on contact, healing them for 8 health.

wikiTooltip: The essence of cold creatures
intro: Essences of Eleum are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by certain ice-related enemies.

wikiTooltip: The essence of desolate creatures
intro: Essences of Havoc are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by certain enemies related to fire or evil, such as those present in the Brimstone Crag. They are used in the crafting of the spawning items for Calamitas Clone and Brimstone Elemental, Hydrothermic Armor, Core of Calamity, and various other weapons and tools.

tooltip: 하늘과 빛 그리고 폭풍의 생명체들에게서 얻은 정수입니다
wikiTooltip: The essence of sky, light, and storm creatures
intro: Essences of Sunlight are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by certain enemies related to the sky, storms, or the sun.

wikiTooltip: Fires an additional icicle arrow that freezes into a falling icicle
intro: The Eternal Blizzard is a Hardmode repeater that is sold by the Archmage for 60 gold coins after defeating all three minibosses in the Frost Moon event. When used, it fires normal arrows along with an Icicle Arrow that ignores gravity and pierces infinitely, but rapidly decelerates during flight before falling straight down as an icicle that deals 135% damage and pierces once. On collision with enemies, the arrow will immediately fly upwards before freezing and falling.

tooltip: 주변의 적을 저주하여 찬란한 파괴의 연출 속에 가둡니다
wikiTooltip: Hexes a possible nearby enemy, trapping them in a brilliant display of destruction
intro: Eternity is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it will create a large circle, which inside will have five crystals, a beam, and a group of projectiles that create a flower shape while traveling, all of which will be centered around a nearby enemy. The beam will travel in an infinity shape. The crystals will circle the targeted enemy. The flower-shaped projectiles will also harm nearby enemies. If the attack button is held, the beam's path will slowly grow in size as the beam changes to a darker blue color. Eventually, if the attack is held for long enough, the beam will disappear and the crystal circle will collapse in on the target, causing massive flower-shaped explosions that inflict massive damage.

tooltip: 마나 수정을 사용하여 마나가 최대치에 도달했을 때만 사용할 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Permanently increases maximum mana by 60
intro: The Ethereal Core is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that can only be consumed once, and upon consumption, increases the player's maximum mana by 60. There are 2 other items that function identically to this: the Comet Shard and the Phantom Heart. It can only be used once, and after that the player must use one of the remaining items to increase their maximum mana. With all of these, the player's maximum mana is capped at 380.

tooltip: 로그 투사체 적중 시 적을 추적하는 영혼 폭발이 발생합니다
wikiTooltip: Rogue projectiles explode into homing souls on hit
8% increased rogue damage and +5 maximum stealth
intro: The Ethereal Extorter is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 1 platinum coins after Golem has been defeated. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+8% rogue damage

wikiTooltip: Summons a phantom to protect you
intro: The Ethereal Subjugator is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it summons a Phantom minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by releasing 3 ghastly particles that home in on the closest enemy after a short time.

tooltip: 최대 마나 60 증가, 마나 소모율 8% 감소
마법 데미지 15% 증가, 마법 크리티컬 확률 5% 증가
필요할 때 마나 포션을 자동으로 사용합니다
[c/aaaaaa:인벤토리에서 Shift+우클릭으로][i:ManaFlower][c/aaaaaa:마나 꽃 효과를 끄고 켤 수 있습니다]
wikiTooltip: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost
15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance
Increases pickup range for mana stars
You automatically use mana potions when needed
intro: The Ethereal Talisman is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Sigil of Calamitas. It is also the final upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+15% magic damage
The Eutrophic Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sunken Sea. The crate contains several Sunken Sea blocks. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Prism Crate.
Eutrophic Glass is a craftable block that is crafted with Eutrophic Sand at a Furnace.
The Eutrophic Glass Wall is a background wall crafted with Eutrophic Glass.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 부영양화 가오리

intro: Eutrophic Sand is a block that generates in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Navystone.

Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall is a background wall that generates naturally in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Unsafe Navystone Wall. Eutrophic Sand Walls will release water whenever the nearby tiles update. It can be removed using any hammer.
Eutrophic Sand Wall is a background wall crafted with Eutrophic Sand. It will not contribute to the creation of an artificial Sunken Sea biome nor will it release water.
The Eutrophic Shelf is a Pre-Hardmode furniture item. It can only be placed sideways on blocks.

tooltip: 돌진 능력을 부여합니다. 공격을 향해 돌진하면 해당 공격을 회피합니다
회피에 성공하면 다시 회피하기까지 30초를 기다려야 합니다
wikiTooltip: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it
After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again
Has a shorter dash cooldown than most dashes
intro: While dashing, the player gains the ability to dodge. This dodge is different from the other dodges as it has a separate cooldown, and its cooldown is always 30 seconds. The player will still be able to dash while the dodge is on cooldown.

tooltip: 주변의 적을 추적하는 별의 고리를 소환합니다
소환된 별은 적을 공격하여 블랙홀을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a ring of stars to home in on nearby enemies
Stars spawn black holes on enemy hits
'Nothing, not even light, can return'
intro: The Event Horizon is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome and the upgrade to the Star Shower, Nuclear Fury, and Relic of Ruin. When used, it releases a ring of stars around the player that orbit their location at the time it was used and home in on nearby enemies. If no enemies are nearby, the stars expand outwards, go back inwards again and finally drift off. Upon contact with enemies, they transform into stationary, lingering black holes which pierce infinitely, rapidly dealing 150% of the weapon's base damage before disappearing after 1.5 seconds.

tooltip: 알코올 중독 계산 시 술 2잔으로 취급됩니다
3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다

Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Everclear is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Everclear debuff, which provides the following effects:
+25% damage

wikiTooltip: Fires a stream of burning green ichor
intro: The Everglade Spray is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. Like the Golden Shower, it fires a gravity-affected green stream that pierces up to five times before dissipating on the sixth. The stream inflicts the Cursed Inferno and Ichor debuffs.

tooltip: 물 및 질병 관련 디버프 피해량 +50%
전기 및 열기 관련 디버프 피해량 -50%
3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다

50% decreased Electric and Heat debuff damage
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Evergreen Gin is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Evergreen Gin debuff, which increases the damage per second of player-inflicted sickness and water-related debuffs by 50% but decreases the damage per second of player-inflicted electric and heat-related debuffs by 50%.
While the effects of the Evergreen Gin debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

tooltip: 망치로 적을 처치시 능력치 보너스를 획득합니다
능력치 보너스를 최대치까지 획득할 수 있습니다
다른 아이템을 손에 들면 능력치 보너스는 사라집니다
적에게 피격 시마다 능력치 보너스가 1씩 감소합니다
wikiTooltip: Channels a powerful hammer strike with the capability to crush all evil
Striking a tile with the hammer strike will cause an explosion and push you back
'EViL! sMaSH eVIl! SmAsh... ER!'
intro: When inflicted on the player, Smashed Evil behaves as a buff and grants:
20% increased damage

tooltip: 머스킷 총알을 빠르게 날아가는 핏덩어리로 변환합니다
wikiTooltip: Converts musket balls into fast-moving blood clots
intro: The Eviscerator is a Pre-Hardmode gun that is dropped by The Perforators. When Musket Balls are used as ammo, it fires a medium-speed blood clot bullet that does not pierce and inflicts the Burning Blood debuff.

tooltip: 적에게 박혀 불태우고 느리게 만드는 뒤틀린 칼날을 투척합니다
칼날은 한 적에게 최대 4개까지 꽂히며 이후 적중 시 먼저 박혀있던 칼날들을 튕겨냅니다
<우클릭>으로 전용 자세에 돌입하며 이 상태에서 <좌클릭> 시 파괴적인 일격으로 전방을 크게 벱니다
자세를 유지하는 동안 체력과 비행 시간이 빠르게 회복되며 대시 재사용 대기시간이 단축됩니다
파괴적인 일격은 사용 후 재충전 시간이 필요합니다
칼날이 박힌 적을 이 일격으로 공격하면 박혀있던 모든 칼날이 방출되며 즉시 다시 공격할 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Throw a twisted blade that impales, immolates, and slows enemies
Up to four blades can impale an enemy at a time, with further hits launching the previous impaled blades
While in the stance, you gain life and flight time regeneration and your dashes have a shorter cooldown
The devastating slash must recharge after being used
Striking an impaled enemy with the devastating slash launches all blades and readies another slash
Throws a stream of homing blades
Stealth strikes summon a guillotine of blades on hit
Summons a rideable war machine
'A superweapon just right for your stature'
intro: The Exo Armaments Kit is a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item that drops from the Exo Mechs in Master or Revengeance Mode. When used, it summons a rideable Exo Tank which has an extremely high running speed and acceleration. It can also charge enemies and deals 6000 damage upon contact, which can be affected by summon damage bonuses.

While enemies are in front of the player, the minigun and missile launchers will target them. Lasers deal 400 typeless damage and are fired from the minigun every 0.067 seconds, for as long as enemies are within a 36° line of sight with the tank's barrel. Missiles deal 1000 typeless damage and are fired in waves of 3 from the missile launcher every 0.067 seconds in bursts of 8 with a 0.47 second delay between bursts, for as long as enemies are within a 120° line of sight with the tank's barrel. Missiles are capable of homing in on enemies within a 75-tile radius and inflict Miracle Blight. Both lasers and missiles are able to be affected by damage bonuses of the user's highest damage class.
Exo-Auric Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Auric Panels and Exo Prisms.
Exo Plating is a post-Moon Lord block that is crafted from Stone Blocks and Exo Prisms. It is used in the crafting of Exo furniture.
Exo Plating Wall is a background wall crafted with Exo Plating.

tooltip: 기하학적인 에너지가 표면을 희미하게 비추고 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Fractal energies shimmer across its surface
intro: Exo Prisms are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by the Exo Mechs. They are used in the crafting of Miracle Matter, Shadowspec Bars, Gem Tech armor and Draedon's Forge among other items.
Exo Prism Panel is a craftable post-Moon Lord block that is crafted from Glass and Exo Prisms.
Exo Prism Panel Wall is a background wall crafted with Exo Prism Panel.

tooltip: 아늑하면서도 매우 날렵한 비행형 엑소 왕좌를 소환합니다
왕좌에 앉아 [KEY]를 누르고 있으면 정밀한 이동을 위해 속도가 느려집니다
wikiTooltip: Materializes a quite cozy and extremely nimble flying Exo throne
'A comfortable gamer is a dangerous gamer'
intro: The Exo Box is a post-Moon Lord mount summoning item that is dropped by the Exo Mechs.

When used, it summons a Draedon's Gamer Chair mount that behaves similarly to the mounts summoned by the Cosmic Car Key and the Witch's Broom. It has instant acceleration, allowing it to reach its maximum speed instantly, meaning the player can move with tight precision. It also has infinite flight time.

tooltip: <좌클릭> 시 적을 추적하여 베어 넘기는 에너지 광선을 여러 줄기 발사합니다
<우클릭> 시 커서 방향으로 검을 내지르며 돌진합니다
돌진 중 검에 직접 닿은 적은 막대한 피해를 입으며 플레이어는 반동으로 튕겨 나옵니다
튕겨 나온 직후 <좌클릭> 시 주변을 휩쓰는 강력한 참격을 가합니다
참격은 공격 범위가 더 넓고 체력을 회복시키며 거대한 폭발을 일으킵니다
적중당한 적은 [cbuff:CalamityMod/MiracleBlight] 디버프에 의해 찢겨 나갑니다
wikiTooltip: Enemy hits from the blade during the dash result in massive damage and a rebound
Powerful slashes are larger, heal you, and create a large explosion
intro: The Exoblade is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon.
All of its attacks inflict the Miracle Blight debuff, the dash attack also inflicts the Frozen debuff.

wikiTooltip: A cold cluster from the great unknown
intro: Exodium Cluster is a post-Moon Lord ore that generates alongside Luminite in Planetoids after Moon Lord has been defeated. It requires at least one of the Luminite Pickaxes to mine. It is used to craft several items, including Stratus equipment as well as the four Soul Artifacts, which are accessories that correspond to Lunatic Cultist, Providence, the Profaned Goddess, The Devourer of Gods, and Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth.

tooltip: 최고천의 갑옷 장착시 최고천의 격노 버프 부여
wikiTooltip: Allows flight and slow fall
Flight time: 3 seconds
Pulsing with an alien heartbeat
intro: Exodus Wings are a craftable post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide. If they are equipped along with Empyrean armor, they grant permanent Empyrean Wrath buff.

tooltip: 하늘 높이 거대한 신성한 십자가를 던지며 잠시 후 커서 위치로 떨어집니다
떨어지는 십자가에 맞은 적은 꿰뚫린 채 신성한 빛에 반복해서 그을립니다
지속 시간이 다하면 십자 모양의 폭발이 일어납니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 십자가를 회전시켜 던지며 커서 위치에서 더욱 강력한 폭발을 일으킵니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a gigantic hallowed cross to the heavens, which will fall at your cursor a moment later
Enemies hit as it falls are impaled and repeatedly seared with holy light
Upon expiration a cross shaped explosion is created
Stealth strikes twirl and throw the cross, ending in a stronger explosion at your cursor
intro: The Exorcism is a craftable Hardmode bomb. When used, a massive holy cross is thrown upwards, falling at the cursor and impaling enemies below with holy light. Once impaled or after hitting the ground, it creates a large holy explosion after a delay.
Performing a stealth strike causes the cross to twirl before being thrown to the cursor, seeking it out before creating a stronger explosion.

tooltip: 정글에서 사용 시 어리석은 용을 소환합니다

Enrages outside the Jungle
Not consumable
'Pheromones used for hunting Draconic Offshoots.'
intro: Exotic Pheromones are a craftable boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Dragonfolly. They can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.

tooltip: 적에게 달라붙어 저주받은 불길을 입히는 세포를 발사하는 병든 눈알을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a diseased eyeball that fires cells which attach to enemies
intro: The Eye of Night is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a tiny floating eyeball that moves erratically above the player. When an enemy is nearby, the eye orbits around it and fires cells which stick to enemies and damage them twice. Up to 4 cells can be stuck to an enemy at a time.

tooltip: 밤에 사용 시 칼라미타스 클론을 소환합니다
리벤전스 모드에서 플레이어의 하단 중심으로 하는 사각형 아레나를 생성합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons the Calamitas Clone
Creates a square arena in Revengeance Mode, with you at its bottom
Not consumable
'She is here.'
intro: The Eye of Desolation is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Calamitas Clone. It can be used anywhere at any time.

tooltip: 적의 방어력을 감소시키는 성운 구름을 일으키며 폭발합니다
이 무기의 공격력은 모든 피해량 능력치의 평균값에 비례하여 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit
This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
intro: The Eye of Magnus is a craftable Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target. Upon impact, the bolt creates a nebula cloud which damages enemies in a 5-tile radius. The weapon's damage scales with the average of the current damage stats from all classes. It does not consume any ammo or mana.

The weapon itself is able to deal 100% base damage on contact while heated. Firing for too long overheats the weapon, inflicts the player with On Fire! and makes the weapon unusable for 3 seconds, while still needing it to be cooled down afterwards. All of its attacks inflict the On Fire! debuff.

intro: The Flamsteed Ring is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. When used, the player is turned into a giant controllable robot. While mounted, most of their weapons are transformed into attacks. The attack type is determined by the top button on the interface, which is summoned by right-clicking while the item is held; the crescent symbol spawns a massive slash from the bot towards the cursor which rapidly hits all targets within the area for 5200 damage, and the crosshair symbol fires a set of three lasers which deal 4200 damage and pierce infinite enemies. The player can transform into a player-sized version of the bot by clicking the left bracket, which can be transformed back to the large version by clicking the right bracket. While in the small transformation, certain tools such as Grappling Hooks are enabled, the slash's damage is lowered to 1897, and the amount of lasers per fire is reduced to one. Clicking the bottom-right button turns the player into a lightning jet which is controlled by the cursor and transforms the player back into a robot upon tile collision.

Left-clicking while the Flamsteed Ring is held will dismount the player. If the user dismounts while a boss is alive, they gain the Andromeda Cripple debuff, crippling their movement and disabling the use of the item in the duration of the debuff.

Every third attack, it instead fires a random spread of 3 bubbles of varying size. The bubbles move slowly before stopping and lingering for a short time if they do not hit an enemy.

The Gelpick is a Pre-Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Cobalt Ore and Palladium Ore. It is the fastest pickaxe available before Hardmode.

Every 6th shot, the weapon instead fires a powerful splitting beam in a Y-shape, which deals 900% damage and resets the laser spread for the following set of shots. Enemies that are hit in close-range will cause the Y-beam to split immediately and take 1350% damage instead of 900%. The lasers and beams can both pass through tiles.

intro: The Genesis Pickaxe is a craftable post-Moon Lord pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Exodium Cluster and Uelibloom Ore. It has the same pickaxe power as the Luminite Pickaxes. It has a bonus range of 4 tiles and emits magenta light particles when swung.

wikiTooltip: Summons a little flak hermit
intro: The Geyser Shell is a pet summoning item that is dropped by Baby Flak Crabs when caught with any type of Bug Net. It summons a pet Flak Hermit that is undisguised and runs along the ground but will disguise itself once the player idles for too long. If the player moves too fast, it will curl up around itself to fly towards the player.

When used, it releases homing ghast energy that travels through blocks and can pierce enemies twice before impacting on the third hit. The ghast energy explodes into smaller energy bolts after about 9 seconds or upon impacting an enemy. These energy bolts can be blue in color, in which they will be affected by gravity, or red in color, in which they will not be affected by gravity and will explode into gravity-affected shards upon impact with an enemy or tile.

Performing a stealth strike with the Ghoulish Gouger will cause the first scythe thrown to release a circular pattern of 8 tormented souls on enemy hits that will home on nearby enemies a moment after being released.

intro: The Glacial Embrace is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Cryogen. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will first encase the player with an icy shield, then with subsequent uses adding one shield spike around it at the cost of a single minion slot. While the ice shield itself does not consume minion slots, it cannot be summoned if the player has no remaining minion slots. Each summoned shield spike will revolve around the shield while moving outwards from it until the spike reaches a set distance where it glows into a deeper shade of blue and is ready to be launched. The fully-charged spike will launch themselves into a nearby enemy or continue orbiting the player otherwise. If the player has at least one shield spike, they can use their secondary fire (right-click) to surround the closest enemy to the cursor with a duplicate ring of spikes, orbiting around and diverge until a set distance when they all launch into the enemy at once.

Performing a stealth strike with the Glaive will cause the thrown glaive to deal 40% damage, pierce infinitely, and inflict a shred effect on the first target, dealing 100 damage per second for 5 seconds. Additionally, it summons a ring of orbiting glaives that last for 5 seconds. The orbiting glaive ring can hit targets once every 0.167 seconds and has 10 knockback.

The petals will not deal damage until they start homing in.

Warping causes the bullets to appear behind the player, turn blue, aiming semi-accurately at the cursor, and cause a small explosion on contact for 25% of the original damage.

When used, it performs a slow but devastating strike, swinging back and forth with high knockback. The sword provides a 14 health healing over time to the player and nearby allies with each strike. Hitting enemies that have their current health less than 500% of the weapon's base damage will also launch them at an incredible force, instantly killing them upon tile collision.

The Grand Marquis Bait has the second-highest Bait Power of all baits at 75%, behind Rage Bait (and excluding boss-summoning baits Truffle Worm and Bloodworm which cannot be used in normal fishing).

Upon consumption, it inflicts the Grape Beer debuff, which causes all bullets, arrows, darts, and rockets to gain weak homing but gives projectiles a multiplicative damage penalty which scales based on how far they are from the player, scaling from 0.75x damage at 5 tiles away to 0.25x damage at 75 tiles away.
While the effects of the Grape Beer debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

intro: The Grave Grimreaver is a craftable Hardmode non-consumable rogue weapon. When used, it throws a homing scythe which passes through solid tiles and inflicts the Confused debuff. Every 1.5 seconds, the scythe releases a flaming skull in its path which homes in after a short duration. Skulls deal 40% of the weapon's damage and inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff. On hit, the scythe explodes into a wave of four bats in random directions. Bats deal 25% of the weapon's damage, bounce off tiles up to four times, and pierce once.

Performing a stealth strike with the Grave Grimreaver will cause the next scythe thrown to spawn 20 bats and rain down 10 homing skulls on hit. The scythe and trailing skulls deal 45% of the weapon's damage, bats deal 11.25% of the weapon's damage, and raining skulls deal 35% of the weapon's damage.
