wikiTooltip: Disables the low gravity of space and grants immunity to the Distorted debuff
intro: The Gravity Normalizer Potion is a craftable Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Gravity Normalizer buff, which causes the player to move normally in space as well as providing immunity to the Distorted debuff.

tooltip: 적 공격 시 짧은 시간 동안 피해량, 방어력, 피해 경감이 크게 증가합니다
<우클릭> 벽을 허물거나 나무를 베지 않고 무기로 사용합니다
wikiTooltip: Hitting an enemy will increases your damage by 15% and defense by 15 for 15 seconds
intro: The Grax is a craftable post-Moon Lord hamaxe that is the final upgrade of the Feller of Evergreens. Its range is five tiles larger than most other tools. When striking an enemy, it grants the player the Grax Boost buff for 15 seconds, which increases defense by 15 and damage by 15%. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), the player can swing it without the ability to cut down trees or destroy walls.

tooltip: 데모나이트, 크림테인, 운석, 바다 프리즘 및 바다 프리즘 수정을 채광 가능
wikiTooltip: Can mine Demonite, Crimtane, Meteorite, Sea Prisms and Sea Prism Crystals
intro: The Greatbay Pickaxe is a craftable Pre-Hardmode pickaxe that is capable of mining blocks up to Obsidian, Crimtane Ore / Demonite Ore and Sea Prism.

tooltip: 날아가며 적을 추적하는 별들을 방출하는 관통 에너지 파동을 발사합니다
검으로 직접 타격 시 플레이어의 등 뒤에서 더 강력한 별 두 개를 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a piercing energy wave that releases homing stars as it flies
Hits with the blade summon two stronger stars from behind you
intro: The Greatsword of Judgement is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword with a custom swing animation. When swung, it fires a large energy wave that slows down as it travels and pierces infinitely, but loses 12% damage per hit. The wave spawns 2 homing stars that deal 35% base damage and pierce once. Hitting an enemy with the sword summons 2 additional homing stars from behind the player that deal 20% base damage and do not pierce.

tooltip: 항아리에 당신의 보물을 바치면 마침내 그 탐욕을 채울 수 있을지도 모릅니다
wikiTooltip: Offer your treasures to the Urn, and your avarice may at last be satiated

tooltip: 정글 내부의 실험실 방향으로 빠르게 이동합니다
중앙의 강력한 관통 이빨을 포함해 총 네 개의 이빨을 부채꼴로 발사합니다
검으로 타격 시 커서와 가장 가까운 적을 물어뜯는 두 개의 턱을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Launches a spread of four teeth with one stronger piercing tooth in the center
Hitting with the blade creates two jaws of teeth to chomp on the enemy closest to your cursor
intro: The Greentide is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings and is dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. On swing, it fires a spread of 5 leviathan teeth, with the center tooth being faster, piercing infinitely and inflicting the Riptide and Wet debuffs. Hitting with the sword itself spawns 6 leviathan teeth that converge on the player's cursor and home in on nearby enemies. True melee teeth deal 10% base damage, have 40 innate armor penetration and inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff.

tooltip: 시장에서 매우 비싸게 거래되는 멸종 위기 어종입니다
wikiTooltip: An endangered fish that is highly prized in the market
intro: The Greenwave Loach is a very rare fishing catch caught in the Sunken Sea. Its only use is to be sold for a fair amount of money.

tooltip: 커서 근처에 사방으로 거칠게 날아다니는 기체 상태의 영혼 융합체를 소환합니다
시간이 지날수록 영혼들이 응집되어 조종 가능한 하나의 괴물로 변합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a gaseous conglomeration of spirits near the cursor that fly around wildly
Over time, the spirits accumulate to create a single, controllable monstrosity
intro: The Gruesome Eminence is a post-Moon Lord magic weapon, and the exhumed form of the Ghastly Visage. When used, it summons a spirit congregation that loosely follows the cursor and occasionally moves around randomly on its own. The congregation occasionally releases smaller spirits as time passes, which are purely visual. These spirits float around and linger for a few seconds before being pulled back into the congregation. After 14 seconds, the spirits accumulate to create a single monstrosity, which is fully controllable by the player. The damage of the spirit congregation gradually builds up from 100% to 185% base damage as it grows to full size.

tooltip: '그림자는 끝없는 불길을 꿈꾸며, 떨어지는 잉걸불과 무자비함을 집어삼킨다.'
wikiTooltip: Summons a sentry
Summons a lantern that swarms your enemies with flames
'Shadows dream of endless fire, flames devour and embers swoop'
intro: The Guidelight of Oblivion is a post-Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Scryllars after defeating Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It summons a soul lantern that floats up and down near the location it was summoned. The lantern summons red flames around it which home in on enemies, travel through tiles, and explode upon contact.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 풍선장어

wikiTooltip: Shoots a spread of bullets
intro: The Gunk Shot is a craftable Pre-Hardmode gun. When used, it fires 3-4 bullets in a shotgun pattern.

wikiTooltip: Allows flight and slow fall
Flight time: 2.17 seconds
Fueled by the fury of the depths
intro: The Hadal Mantle is a craftable Hardmode wing-type accessory. While equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide.

wikiTooltip: Only gives 50 seconds of Potion Sickness
Major improvements to all stats
intro: The Hadal Stew is a craftable food item that can also be obtained from Rusty Chests. Upon consumption, it restores 100 health and grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff for 4 minutes. It also inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff for a shorter duration.
Like all other food items, the Hadal Stew can be placed on a Plate:

tooltip: '얼마나 오래 방치되었는지 안에 들어있는게 무엇인지 감도 안잡힌다'
wikiTooltip: Fires a random assortment of ocean creatures
'There's no telling how long it was down there... or what lurks inside'
intro: The Hadal Urn is a craftable Hardmode magic weapon and the direct upgrade to the Black Anurian. When used, the player holds an urn which rapidly fires a spread of three random marine creatures.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 하다리안

wikiTooltip: Allows flight and slow fall
Flight time: 1.8 seconds
Powered by the Astral Infection

tooltip: 발사 후 급격하게 총알의 속도가 감소합니다
치명타 적중 시 급속 냉각을 일으켜 추가 피해를 입히고 보스가 아닌 적을 빙결시킵니다
wikiTooltip: Once shot, bullets rapidly decelerate
Critical hits cause a flash freeze, dealing additional damage based on your crit chance and freezing enemies
intro: Hailstorm Bullets are craftable Hardmode bullets. The bullets pierce once and drastically slow down when fired, quickly becoming stationary before vanishing. On hit, the bullets inflict the Frostbite debuff, while critical hits additionally inflict the Frozen debuff on non-boss enemies and cause a flash freeze that deals 50% of the bullet's damage. The second target hit by the bullet takes half as much damage from both the bullet and the flash freeze.

wikiTooltip: 'Yes, it's still overpowered'
intro: The Halibut Cannon is a gun that is dropped by the Primordial Wyrm. When used, it fires out between 25 and 35 bullets per shot that slowly spread out, while only consuming one unit of ammo.

tooltip: 사격 정확도에 따라 적중 시 추가 스타버스트를 생성합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a burst of intensely concentrated lunar fire jets
Generates Starbursts when hitting enemies, depending on your accuracy
Uses gel for ammo
50% chance to save ammo
'Halley arrived sooner than expected'

tooltip: 적중 시 신성한 빛을 방출하여 총알의 기본 공격력을 [DAMAGE]로 증가시킵니다
특수 총기에 의해 총알이 변환된 경우에는 이 효과는 발생하지 않습니다
wikiTooltip: Releases anointed light on hit that increases the bullet's base damage to [DAMAGE]
This effect does not occur if the bullets are converted by special guns
intro: Hallow-Point Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets. They sparkle on enemy hits, which deal 6 extra flat damage as long as they have not been converted into other bullets.

Hallowed Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates in Pearlstone Blocks, Hardened Pearlsand Blocks, Pearlsandstone Blocks, and Pink Ice Blocks after all three Mechanical Bosses have been defeated. As such, it predominantly generates in the Underground Hallow biome. It is used to craft Hallowed Bars at an Adamantite Forge or Titanium Forge. It requires at least an Adamantite Pickaxe, Titanium Pickaxe, or Shardlight Pickaxe to mine.

tooltip: 소환수 공격 시 다양한 버프를 부여합니다
wikiTooltip: Minion attacks provide various buffs
Does not stack with downgrades
intro: The Hallowed Rune is a craftable Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spirit Glyph. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:
Hallowed Defense, which provides +5 defense.
The Handheld Tank is a craftable post-Moon Lord launcher. When used, it fires a small, high-velocity rocket that causes a small explosion on contact with an enemy or a block.

tooltip: '신경을 진정시키는 과일(예기치 않은 부작용이 존재할 수 있음)'
wikiTooltip: 'A fruit that calms your nerves (may have unintended side effects)'
intro: The Ha-pu Fruit is a Pre-Hardmode developer vanity accessory which transforms the user. It is obtained from shaking trees at a 1% chance.
Hardened Astral Sand is a Hardmode block which replaces Hardened Sand Blocks in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.
Hardened Astral Sand Wall is a background wall that replace Hardened Sand Wall in the Astral Infection biome upon its creation.
Hardened Eutrophic Sand is a craftable block crafted from Eutrophic Sand and Dirt Blocks.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 적중 시 꿀 버프를 부여하고 벌떼를 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a honeycomb that shatters into fragments
intro: The Hardened Honeycomb is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it throws honeycomb projectiles that are slightly affected by gravity and shatter into 2 fragments upon collision with an enemy or tile. The honeycomb fragments fly in random directions.

Performing a stealth strike with Hardened Honeycombs will cause the next honeycomb thrown to spawn homing bees and grant the player the Honey buff upon hitting enemies. The stealth strike honeycomb, fragments, and bees deal 80% base damage.

Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found in the Sulphurous Sea biome, which spawns upon world generation. It is commonly found on the outlines of caves and the sea floor.
Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone Wall is a background wall crafted from Hardened Sulphurous Sandstone.

wikiTooltip: 20% increased movement speed and flight time
intro: The Harpy Ring is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. It increases 20% movement speed and flight time while equipped.

tooltip: 근처에 적이나 플레이어가 다가가면 호박들이 튀어나오며
적을 향해 맹렬히 돌진해 부딪히면서 폭발합니다.
wikiTooltip: Summons a sentry
Grows a pumpkin patch that sprouts pumpkins nearby
Pumpkins will hop out when approached by nearby creatures or players
Once out, they will aggressively tackle enemies, exploding on hit
'No thoughts behind those eyes'
intro: The Harvest Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode sentry. When used, it summons a stationary pumpkin patch nest that causes small pumpkins to sprout anywhere on the ground near the nest. Pumpkins will emerge when approached by an enemy or the player. Once emerged, they aggressively seek out nearby enemies and throw themselves into them before exploding. If there are no enemies nearby, the pumpkins will idle and walk around passively in a similar manner to critters. If the pumpkins are near the player, they will jump around excitedly.

tooltip: 당신을 위해 싸워줄 귀신이 들린 접시들을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a stack of haunted dishes to fight for you
intro: The Haunted Scroll is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a stack of three haunted dishes which runs along the ground. It does not deal contact damage, but rapidly throws high velocity dishes at nearby enemies. On hit, the dish shatters into three shards which each deal 50% damage. If the player is far away, the minion will fly towards the player by spinning its dishes around to catch up with them.

wikiTooltip: It resonates with otherworldly energy
intro: Havocplate is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in the core of the Underworld Bio-center Lab of a world. It can be used as a building material, and is also used in the crafting of the Profaned Soul Artifact and Fire Turrets.
Havocplate Wall is a background wall crafted with Havocplate.

tooltip: 원뿔 모양으로 타오르는 유황 불꽃을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Uses gel for ammo

intro: Hazard Chevron Panels are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks that can also be found in Arsenal Labs.
Hazard Chevron Wall is a background wall crafted with Hazard Chevron Panels.

tooltip: 시간이 지남에 따라 분노 게이지를 지속적으로 얻으며 전투에서 벗어나도 분노가 사라지지 않습니다
wikiTooltip: You constantly gain rage over time, and rage does not fade away when out of combat
Revengeance
intro: The Heart of Darkness is a Pre-Hardmode accessory in Revengeance Mode. It can be obtained from any Treasure Bag at a 2.5% chance or bought from the Shady Salesman during even Moon phases after defeating Skeletron. When equipped, it fills up the Rage Meter by 2% of the total meter every second. It also prevents the Rage Meter from resetting when out of combat.

wikiTooltip: Summons all elementals to protect you
The elementals have reduced opacity if visibility is disabled
'The heart of the world'
intro: The Heart of the Elements is a craftable Hardmode accessory. It will summon all of the Elementals to assist the player and attack enemies.

When equipped, the Heart of the Elements will summon a Brimstone Elemental, a Sand Elemental, a Cloud Elemental, and a Water Elemental to attack nearby enemies and a Oasis Elemental to heal the player. Elementals have a base damage of 50 and are affected by summon damage bonuses.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 불타는 정령
커서의 위치로 날아가는 원반을 머리위로 던집니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 하늘에서 아스트랄 에너지 화살이 소나기처럼 쏟아집니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a stardisk upwards which then launches itself towards your mouse cursor
Stealth strikes rain astral energy bolts from the sky
intro: The Heavenfallen Stardisk is a Hardmode post-Astrum Aureus rogue weapon. It is always found inside the Dungeon's Astral Chest. Astrum Aureus must be defeated in order to open the chest.

When used, the main disk flies straight upwards before flying in the direction of the cursor. If thrown and when it lands, the disk will explode into 5 astral energy bolts that deal 25% of the weapon's damage.

tooltip: 활의 시위를 당기고 있으면 발사하기 전까지 수정이 점차 강력해집니다
수정이 일정수준 강해지면 수정이 발사된 위치에 엑소 번개 폭풍으로 내리칩니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a rapid stream of supercharged exo-crystals
Holding the bow and waiting for some time before firing causes the crystals to become more powerful
If the crystals are sufficiently powerful enough they will summon torrents of exo-lightning above whatever target they hit
intro: The Heavenly Gale is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. When used, it converts all arrows into a burst of 9 exo crystals that go through tiles and home in on enemies, consuming 1 arrow per burst.

Holding the bow without firing will charge up the next attack to deal more damage the longer it charges, up to 350% damage after 5 seconds of waiting (signified by a star effect). Fully charged exo crystals will also summon piercing lightning bolts above the target on hit that constantly deal 162% of the weapon's damage.

tooltip: 불안정한 별의 핵을 발사해 거대한 핵융합 폭발을 일으킵니다
wikiTooltip: Launches volatile star cores which erupt into colossal fusion blasts
Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage
'The power of a galaxy, if only for mere moments'
intro: The Helium Flash is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a burning star core which bursts on impact into an enormous flaming explosion much like the Inferno Fork. The explosion ignores NPC immunity frames. Both the burning star core and explosion inflict the Daybroken debuff, and always critically strike. Each 1% of critical strike chance the weapon would receive instead increases critical strike damage by 2%, with the total critical strike damage being listed in the item's tooltip.

tooltip: 드래곤 시대 당시 아자푸르 최고의 대장장이가 아름다운 영감으로 벼려낸 화려한 화기입니다
<좌클릭> 유지 시 총을 휘둘러 주변 적들을 빠르게 타격합니다
총신으로 직접 타격할 때마다 탄환이 충전됩니다 (최대 12발)
<우클릭> 시 탄환 한 발을 소모하여 강력한 반동을 가진 거대 에너지구를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: An ornate firearm created during the Draconic Era by Azafure's finest forgemaster
Hits with the gun itself add rounds to the gun, up to a max of 12
intro: The Hellborn is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When used, the player twirls the gun in their hand, dealing 8% base damage to enemies. Each hit with the gun itself adds 1 charge to the gun, up to a maximum of 12. Using right-click while having at least 1 charge causes the gun to fire a giant energy sphere that creates a small blast and knocks back enemies on hit.

wikiTooltip: Fires a spread of volcanic fireballs
intro: The Hellfire Flamberge is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires two small fireballs and one large fireball that travel a slow distance before stopping and dissipating on collision or after a short amount of time. Small volcanic fireballs deal 50% of the weapon's damage and large volcanic fireballs deal 75% damage. The fireballs are not affected by gravity and cannot pierce or pass through tiles. Both the sword and fireballs inflict the Hellfire debuff.

wikiTooltip: Shoots a flower spear tip
Summons petals from the sky on critical hits
intro: The Hellion Flower Spear is a craftable Hardmode spear. When used, it fires out a spike that neither pierces nor travels through tiles. Dealing critical hits from the spear or spikes will spawn a single petal from off-screen that flies towards the enemy's position. All projectiles deal 100% base damage. Both the spear and spikes inflict the Acid Venom debuff.

wikiTooltip: An ancient blade created during the Draconic Era by Azafure's finest forgemaster
Swings a slow and heavy blade with powerful knockback
intro: The Hellkite is a Hardmode special sword that is dropped by the Renegade Warlock after defeating Plantera that autoswings. On use, the sword is swung back and forth. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player. Holding right-click will channel a stronger swing, which takes 4 seconds to charge up. This stronger swing deals 250% base damage and is guaranteed to critically strike, with each 1% of critical strike chance the Hellkite would receive instead improving critical strike damage by 2%.

wikiTooltip: Casts flaming bats
intro: The Hellwing Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it spawns 4 non-piercing flaming bats that go through tiles and quickly dissipate after spawning. The way the bats spawn depends on where the cursor spawns them. If the cursor is above the screen, the bats will fly in random directions, however if the cursor is on the side or bottom of the screen, the bats will fly towards the cursor. The bats inflict the On Fire! debuff.

wikiTooltip: Fires two bullets at once
The gun also deals damage to enemies that touch it
intro: The Helstorm is a craftable Hardmode gun. When used, it rapidly auto-fires two bullets at once with a slightly random spread. The gun itself deals contact damage to enemies, a unique property for a ranged weapon that it shares with the Hellborn. Enemies that take damage from the gun are inflicted with the Hellfire debuff.

wikiTooltip: Casts a barrage of blood geysers from below
intro: The Hematemesis is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it fires 10 blood bolts that spawn from below the screen and move upwards at high speed near the cursor's position. The blood bolts can pass through tiles but cannot pierce.

tooltip: 들고 있는 책에서 불과 영혼들을 위로 방출합니다
책을 들고 있는동안 불과 영혼의 힘이 강력해집니다
wikiTooltip: Releases fire and souls upward from a held book
As the book is held the power of both increases
intro: Heresy is a post-Moon Lord spell tome that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used, it fires flame particles and souls upwards, which can pass through solid tiles but only home in on enemies when there are no solid tiles present. The time that it takes to fire varies from 0.33-0.47 seconds initially, but linearly speeds up to 0.07-0.2 seconds after 2 seconds of holding the book.

wikiTooltip: Summons the Third Sage
'As the ice melts in the springs
And waves wash the old moss' hair...
Thank you, Goodbye'

source.title: Hermit's Box of One Hundred Medicines

tooltip: '소리 없는 머리와 부리가 내리꽂혀 물고기의 머리를 낚아챘고,
부리는 꼬리를 필사적으로 흔드는 작은 물고기를 삼켜버렸다.'
wikiTooltip: Increased fishing power by 1.1x when in space
'A silent head and beak lanced down and plucked it out by the head,
and the beak swallowed the little fish while its tail waved frantically.'
intro: The Heron Rod is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing pole. While fishing in space, the player's fishing power is increased by 1.1x.

wikiTooltip: Summons a school of herrings to fight for you
intro: The Herring Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. It summons three Herrings that follow the player. They attack nearby enemies by swiftly darting at them to deal damage. The Herrings can fly through tiles but cannot attack through them and they emit visual water particles when charging at enemies.

tooltip: 트루 밀리 공격 시 하늘에서 아스트랄 별이 떨어집니다
피격 시 폭발을 일으키고 트루 밀리 피해량을 일시적으로 30% 증가시킵니다
강화 지속 시간은 받은 피해량에 비례하며 최대 10초까지 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: True melee strikes drop astral stars from the sky
Releases an explosion and temporarily increases true melee damage by 30% when damaged
Boost duration scales with the amount of damage you took, up to 10 seconds
intro: The Hide of Astrum Deus is an Expert Mode-exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Deus. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Dealing true melee damage causes 3 astral stars to rain down, each dealing 75 melee damage.

tooltip: 적들을 향해 글러머링을 소환하는 아스트라글로머레이트를 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a sentry
Summons an astraglomerate to spawn glomerings at your enemies
intro: The Hive Pod is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by Astraglomerates after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. The Astral Hive will spawn Hivelings if there are any enemies nearby, which will home onto the closest enemy to them, even through walls.

wikiTooltip: Fires two arrows at once
Converts wooden arrows into mist arrows that spread frost mist on collision
intro: The Hoarfrost Bow is a Hardmode bow that is dropped by Cryogen. When used, it fires 2 arrows in a random spread. If Wooden Arrows are used as ammo, the arrows are converted into mist arrows that split into 2 frost mists that deal 35% of the arrow's damage. The mist arrows and frost mist inflict the Wind Chilled debuff.

tooltip: 적을 녹이며 관통하는 중력의 영향을 받는 세 발의 플라즈마 방울을 발사합니다
왼쪽 클릭를 유지하면 활을 빠르게 충전하여 고속 플라즈마 화살을 발사합니다
플라즈마 화살은 충돌 후 폭발하며, 타일에 박힐 경우 더 강력한 폭발을 일으킵니다
오른쪽 클릭를 유지하면 충전되지 않은 샷을 반복해서 발사합니다
오른쪽 클릭와 왼쪽 클릭를 함께 유지하면 약간 느린 속도로 충전된 화살을 자동 발사합니다

intro: Hyperius Bullets are craftable Hardmode bullets. They can pass through tiles, but upon passing through will begin to rapidly deteriorate and fade away before disappearing. Upon hitting an enemy, they will split into 3 smaller swirling lights that swirl outward for a moment before dissipating.

They function in a drastically different way than most other bullets. Instead of dealing their full damage directly, they will instead only deal 1 damage and 'store' the damage they would have done on the struck enemy. Once the total amount of stored damage is greater than 10% of the target's maximum health, the stored damage will begin to 'leak' out, dealing damage directly and gradually returning the damage pool to 10% of the target's maximum health. The more damage is stored on a target, the faster the leaking will occur.

intro: The Ice Barrage is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that consumes Blood Runes as ammunition. When used, it summons a collapsing ring of icy dust on top of the cursor which can immediately lock onto the closest target within a 31.25-tile radius. After 1.5 seconds, snowflakes spray out from the center of the spell at a rate of 12 snowflakes per second. After 2.33 seconds, the ring explodes and deals damage in a large radius, inflicting the Frozen debuff. Then, it spawns a random spray of 45 snowflakes in all directions and 4 large rectangular blocks of ice in a cross-formation. The blocks lock onto the center of the spell, slowly dealing damage and last for 2.33 additional seconds before each bursting into 8 dark icicles, ending the spell and all its attacks. Snowflakes deal 5% damage, ice blocks deal 30% damage, and icicles deal 6% damage. The snowflakes inflict the Frostbite debuff for 2 seconds upon contact.

intro: The Lionfish is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. Lionfish projectiles will explode upon hitting a tile or after being stuck to an enemy for several seconds. This explosion is purely cosmetic and deals no damage.

The Lionfish inflicts Acid Venom on contact with enemies and sticks to them. Unlike most weapons that deal Acid Venom, the damage over time dealt by the Lionfish stacks. Each Lionfish stuck in an enemy increases the damage of the Acid Venom debuff by 15 damage per second, up to 3 Lionfish at a time for a maximum of 75 damage per second.

When used with secondary fire (right-click), it will fire a single larger kunai that pierces once and explodes upon hitting the next enemy or tile. This kunai has extremely high velocity, deals much more damage than the left-click kunai and is not affected by gravity. The kunai can inflict the Plague debuff.

Performing a stealth strike with the Malachite will cause it to throw three rapidly homing kunai that stick to enemies and hit 3 times before exploding after a short delay. Up to 6 kunai can be stuck on an enemy at a time. This delay is longer than the left click delay. This stealth strike is the same between the left and right click.

Occasionally launches homing feline entities
Uses gel for ammo
intro: The Meowthrower is a Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. It uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires a slight spread of blue and pink flames at a short range, each piercing twice. It additionally fires homing cat projectiles. Upon enemy hits, a visual burst of flame appears, and it makes a meowing sound.

Stealth strikes cause the ball to impale hit enemies, piercing them with extra shards when it breaks
'This has to hurt'
intro: The Metal Monstrosity is a craftable Pre-Hardmode non-consumable spiky ball. It throws a heavy gravity-affected metal ball that breaks upon hitting a tile or enemy. Upon breaking it releases 3 spiky balls and 3 spikes that stick into enemies inflicting damage over the time and fading away shortly after.
Performing a stealth strike with the Metal Monstrosity will make the metal ball shoot several spikes in random directions until the metal ball breaks.

wikiTooltip: Summons a Sepulcher to fight for you
While the Sepulcher is active, brimstone hearts will begin to appear and orbit you
When too many hearts are present, it will interrupt attacking to attack the hearts instead
This happens more frequently depending on how many hearts are present
Can only be summoned once
intro: The Metastasis is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon, and the exhumed form of the Void Eater Marionette. When used, it summons a full-sized Sepulcher that follows the player. The Sepulcher takes 4 minion slots to summon and attacks by alternating between circling the enemy while firing brimstone darts from its segments, and rapidly charging at the enemy back and forth.

Every 7 seconds, an Exhumed Brimstone Heart spawns which orbits around the player. If there are over 2 hearts present, each additional heart will increase the chance for the Sepulcher to enrage by 25%. When enraged, the Sepulcher will glow red and charge towards and damage the brimstone hearts instead of attacking enemies. A maximum of 5 hearts can exist at one time.

tooltip: 커서를 따라다니며 시간이 지날수록 빨라지는 로켓 주먹을 발사합니다

wikiTooltip: Fires a wired-guided rocket fist that seeks the cursor and accelerates over time
Stealth strikes immediately start accelerating and drop a meteorite on the struck enemy
intro: The Meteor Fist is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bomb. When used, it releases a rocket fist which connects to the player via a wire. After 1 second, the fist begins to accelerate and home towards the cursor's position, leaving a fiery trail behind it.

Performing a stealth strike with the Meteor Fist will cause the next fist released to immediately begin accelerating towards the cursor with a faster maximum velocity. Upon hitting an enemy, the fist spawns a meteorite above it which rains down and creates a large explosion on impact. The meteorite's velocity will aim ahead of the enemy's movement.

wikiTooltip: Fires a spread of gas clouds that slow down after hitting an enemy
intro: The Miasma is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a random spread of 3 to 5 fast gas clouds that slow down when they hit an enemy, eventually stopping in place. After being stationary for a short time, the clouds dissipate into dust. Clouds pierce nine times, cannot pass through tiles and inflict the Irradiated debuff.

tooltip: 동전을 총알로 맞추면 총알이 가장 가까운 적에게 도탄됩니다
최대 4개의 동전을 동시에 던질 수 있으며 총알은 여러 개의 동전사이에서 도탄될 수 있습니다
적에게 도탄된 총알은 항상 치명타로 적중합니다
wikiTooltip: Striking a coin with a bullet causes it to ricochet into the nearest enemy
Up to 4 coins can be tossed simultaneously, and shots will ricochet off multiple coins if possible
Coins guarantee a critical strike after a short delay and bullets do bonus damage based on coins used
intro: The Midas Prime is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Pirate Deadeyes, and is the indirect upgrade to the Crackshot Colt. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it converts any suitable bullets into Marksman Rounds. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), a Silver Coin or Gold Coin is consumed and fired with an upwards curve. Coins are gravity-affected and cannot damage enemies. They can also be recoverable at a 100% chance, unless multiple coins are hit by the same bullet, in which only the first coin hit is recovered. Only 4 thrown coins can be active at a time.

Silver Coins guarantee critical strikes and additively increase the damage of the Marksman Round by 175% on its first hit, and 50% on further hits. Gold Coins behave similarly but increase damage by 200% on first hits and 85% on further hits.

wikiTooltip: Summons a UFO to vaporize enemies
intro: The Midnight Sun Beacon is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is the direct upgrade to the Xeno Staff and the Lunar Portal Staff. When used, it throws out a Midnight Sun Beacon that summons a Midnight Sun UFO after a few seconds. The Midnight Sun UFO will track an enemy and fire small lasers towards them. After a few seconds of consecutively firing, it will circle above an enemy and fire a concentrated laser beam whose length is determined by the size of the enemy it is targeting. After firing its concentrated laser beam, it will return firing normal lasers.

intro: The Mineral Mortar is a craftable Hardmode launcher. When used, it charges up and converts all rockets into fast onyx bombs that are affected by gravity and create large explosions on contact.

'상쾌하고 시원하며 약간의 민트향이 느껴지는 것 같기도 합니다'

Refreshing and cool, perhaps even a bit minty
intro: The Miracle Fruit is a craftable Hardmode permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Sanguine Tangerine, the Tainted Cloudberry, and the Sacred Strawberry. It is the second of these to be obtainable following boss progression. It can only be used once, and after that the player must use one of the remaining fruit to increase their maximum life. With all of these, the player's maximum life is capped at 600.

tooltip: 정해진 형태가 없는 이 물질에는 무한한 가능성이 깃들어 있습니다

intro: Miracle Matter is a craftable post-Moon Lord crafting material that can be crafted after the Exo Mechs have been defeated. It is used to craft weapons from the endgame "Exo Weapons" set. When dropped or in the inventory, the item will pulse and glow. The item will also emit bright yellow dust when dropped.

intro: The Mirage Mirror is a craftable Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, the player builds rogue stealth 25% faster while standing still and 12% faster while moving. It also reduces enemy aggro by 200, however it will not reduce aggro while in the Abyss.

intro: The Mirror of Kalandra is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons the following weapons respectively: Atziri's Disfavor, Starforge, Paradoxica, Wind Ripper, and Hope Shredder. Only 1 of each weapon can be summoned at a time, each taking up 1 minion slot.

wikiTooltip: Casts a storm of pine needles and leaves
intro: The Mistlestorm is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Razorpine and the Leaf Blower. When used, it rapidly fires 2-4 pine needles and leaves in a random spread. The pine needles are slightly affected by gravity while the leaves are not affected by gravity. Both projectiles do not pierce and cannot pass through tiles.

intro: Mollusk Husks are Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Clams and the Giant Clam mini boss. They are used to craft several defensive and water-themed items.

intro: The Molten Amputator is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it throws a rapidly spinning scythe which lingers at the position of the cursor when it was fired before returning. Right-clicking recalls all existing scythes; recalling a scythe that is on top of an enemy rends them, dealing 700% base damage. The scythe inflicts the Holy Flames debuff.

The weapon does not have a traditional stealth strike; instead, right-clicking with enough stealth for a stealth strike will empower the next 30 throws of the weapon. While empowered, the weapon attacks 3x faster, and scythes travel much faster but can no longer be recalled.

your top speed will continuously and uncontrollably increase
This effect only works if there are no bosses alive
intro: The Momentum Capacitor is a Hardmode tool that is sold by the Bandit for 50 gold coins after all three Mechanical Bosses have been defeated. When holding left-click, the player gains a random movement speed increase ranging from 1% to 7% every use, or 30% to 210% every second. The maximum amount of movement speed gained while holding the item is 580%, taking an average of 145 uses or 4.83 seconds to reach top speed. The item's effects will only work if there are no bosses alive.
The Monolith Amalgam is a Hardmode furniture item.
The Monolith Bow is a craftable Hardmode bow. Upon using the item, a flurry of four arrows is released while only consuming one arrow.

The Monolith Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Astral Infection. The crate contains a pet item and items found in standard crates. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Astral Crate.
The Monolith Hammer is a craftable Hardmode hammer.

wikiTooltip: Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense
intro: The Monolith Sword is a craftable Hardmode broadsword. It has an incredibly fast use time, swinging much more frequently than most other broadswords. When swung, it has a smear effect which expands the sword's reach, which can be either orange or teal in color. The sword has an innate 15 armor penetration.

tooltip: 나무 화살을 태풍의 화살과 상어로 변환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a spread of 5 arrows
Wooden arrows are converted into typhoon arrows and sharks
intro: The Monsoon is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that auto-fires five arrows at once. When firing Wooden Arrows, four of the five arrows are converted into sharks, and the fifth, middle arrow is converted into a Typhoon Arrow. Typhoon Arrows erupt into a swirling typhoon on contact with enemies or tiles, dealing damage over time in a wide area. Additionally, arrows deal 10% more damage when firing Wooden Arrows.

wikiTooltip: Throws a spread of short-range knives that heal the user
intro: The Monstrous Knives are a craftable Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that act similarly to the Vampire Knives. When used, the player throws a spread of 3-4 gravity-affected knives that heal the player for 5% to 10% of the damage dealt. The knives fade away after a short amount of time, losing 10% of its damage and knockback every 0.5 seconds, then disappear into cosmetic red dust when fully transparent.

tooltip: [c/aaaaaa:인벤토리에서 Shift+우클릭으로][i:AngelWings][c/aaaaaa:날개 효과를 끄거나 켤 수 있습니다]

The ability to fly and glide

intro: Moonshine is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Moonshine debuff, which increases max health by 25%, but forces all hits to deal at least 50% of defense in defense damage and makes defense damage take three times as long to recover.
While the effects of the Moonshine debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

tooltip: 소환된 [c/27F5E0:달빛 인장] 1개당 마법 피해량 +2, 마나 소모량 -1%
소환된 인장 5개 이상: 마나 재생 속도 +5
소환된 인장 10개: 마법 치명타 확률 +10%, 모든 마법 공격이 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Nightwither] 디버프를 부여합니다
마나가 전부 소모되거나 마나 물약을 사용하면 모든 인장이 산산조각 납니다

Sigils are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
intro: The Moonstone Crown is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Feather Crown. When equipped, it grants +40 maxiumum mana and summons a lunar sigil that orbits the player every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10. Each lunar sigil orbiting the player grants 2% magic damage and 1% mana cost reduction. Having 5 lunar sigils grants +5 mana regeneration per second. Having all 10 lunar sigils grants 10% magic critical strike chance and makes magic attacks inflict the Nightwither debuff for 6 seconds.
Running out of mana, drinking a mana potion, or using Astral Injection causes the lunar sigils around the player to shatter and prevents them from respawning for 5 seconds.

Used by normal guns
intro: Mortar Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets. They can be used by any gun that does not shoot custom bullets. Upon impact, they create a large explosion that is able to destroy tiles.

+50% weapon knockback
Mossy Stone is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Limestone into Shimmer.

tooltip: 주변 적에게 레이저를 발사하는 강력한 무기를 머리 위에 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a powerful scanner module above your head that fires lasers at nearby enemies
intro: The Mounted Scanner is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a floating machine that surrounds the player. When an enemy is nearby, the machine fires red laser beams at them every 2.08 seconds.

tooltip: 적을 공격시 폭발하는 2개의 태양 채찍검을 휘두릅니다
wikiTooltip: Launches two solar whip swords that explode on hit
intro: The Mourningstar is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail and the direct upgrade to the Solar Eruption. When used, it fires two whipswords from the player's position. The whipswords pierce infinitely, can hit through blocks, and create explosions on hit. Both the whipswords and the explosions inflict the Daybroken debuff on hit.

tooltip: 강력한 적도 깔끔하게 절단할 수 있는 고주파 칼날입니다

신들의 포식자를 처치하고 이 검을 뽑아 자신의 가치를 증명하세요

Every third swing deals immense damage
Prove your worth by slaying The Devourer of Gods to unsheath this sword
intro: The Murasama is a post-Moon Lord melee weapon. It can be found in The Underworld's Bio-center Arsenal Lab, contained within a Security Chest.

Although the Murasama is technically obtainable in Pre-Hardmode, it cannot be swung until The Devourer of Gods has been defeated in the current world. In this unusable state, it will have a "sheathed" appearance in which the blade is covered by a mechanical exterior.

tooltip: 분노 모드의 지속 시간이 영구적으로 1초 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: Permanently increases the duration of Rage Mode by 1 second
Revengeance drop
intro: The Mushroom Plasma Root is a permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon. Upon consumption, it increases the duration of Rage Mode by one second. There are two other items that function identically to this: the Infernal Blood and the Red Lightning Container. It can only be used once.

tooltip: 피쉬론은 돌진공격, 투사체 발사, 태풍 소환의 3가지 패턴으로 공격합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a younger fishron to irradiate your foes
The fishron will cycle between charging, projectiles, and a typhoon
There can only be one minion
intro: The Mutated Truffle is a post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by The Old Duke. It summons a Baby Boomer minion that cycles between through three attacks, starting out by charging rapidly at enemies, shooting tooth balls which explode into homing teeth projectiles after 2 seconds, and then spinning around while summoning a large vortex that slowly chase enemies to deal damage. The minion deals 125% base damage while charging at enemies. There can only be one Baby Boomer active at a time.

The Mycelial Claws are a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that is dropped by Crabulon. They function similar to the Fetid Baghnakhs, having extremely fast swing speed and very short range. The weapon grants the Mushy buff for 6 seconds on enemy hits.

tooltip: 짧은 사거리의 곰팡이 뿌리를 연속으로 발사합니다

Stealth strikes spawn an explosion of fungi spores
intro: The Mycoroot is a Pre-Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Crabulon. When used, it auto-fires a continuous stream of short-range fungal roots. The fungal roots cannot pierce or pass through tiles.

Performing a stealth strike with the Mycoroot causes a burst of 12 fungi spores to release from the player and home in on nearby enemies shortly afterwards. Additionally, all players within a 50-tile radius including the user are granted the Mushy buff.

Mysterious Circuitry are crafting materials that are found in Arsenal Labs in the Cavern layer and dropped by Burrowers. They are used in the crafting of various weapons, furniture, and other items alongside Dubious Plating.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 피폭, 독, 부식성 맹독을 입힙니다
intro: The Mythril Knife is a craftable Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a knife that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.

Performing a stealth strike with the Mythril Knife will cause the knife to emit particles and inflict the Acid Venom, Irradiated, and Poisoned debuffs. These combined debuffs cause the target to lose 42 health per second, 74 health per second accounting for Irradiated's boost to sickness debuffs.

intro: NO is a post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is used to summon THE LORDE. It is dropped by Bohldohrs in the Jungle Temple after Supreme Witch, Calamitas and the Exo Mechs have been defeated in the Get fixed boi seed.

intro: The Nadir is a craftable post-Moon Lord spear. When used, it attacks like a normal spear and fires void essences that deal 25% of the weapon's damage, travel through blocks, and home in on enemies. Upon getting near enemies or after traveling a moderate distance, void essences erupt into void tentacles that extend in random directions. Upon contact with an enemy, void essences rapidly slow down, deal several hits, then dissipate. The spear and void essences inflict the Voidfrost debuff.

intro: The Omicron is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun that is the final upgrade to the Wingman and Genesis. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it fires an array of 10 lasers that pierce once and decrease in their spread on following shots before resetting back to original spread after every 5 shots. In addition, two Wingmen are summoned to the sides of the player perpendicular to the direction of the cursor, that each switch sides and fire 3 lasers towards the cursor that also pierce once. Both the cannon and the Wingmen stop attacking as soon as the player stops holding left click or runs out of mana.

When used with its secondary fire (right-click) while the weapon is in use consumes 195 mana and causes the weapon to instead fire a powerful beam, which deals 3200% damage and resets the laser spread for the following set of shots. Hitting an enemy from over 15-tiles away causes the beam to split into a Y-shape. Enemies that are hit in closer range will not split the beam but take 16000% damage instead of 3200% and causes the player to recoil in the opposite direction the weapon is fired towards. Then, after 0.83 seconds, each Wingman consumes 16 mana and fires 2 high-deceleration grenades towards the cursor which explode on collision with enemies or after 1.6 seconds, dealing 1400% damage to all enemies in a 11.25-tile radius. All attacks are capable of passing through tiles.

The Onyx Excavator is capable of moving and digging at a speed of 23 mph horizontally and can jump a single block off the ground. It provides a small amount of light when in use.

Releasing while fully charged discharges a charged bolt which deals 500% damage and 300% knockback, inflicts the Hellfire debuff, and pierces twice. Releasing while not fully charged fires a normal heated bolt which inflicts the On Fire! debuff and only pierces once.

intro: The Overloaded Blaster is a Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by The Slime God. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 25% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a spread of 3 infinitely-piercing slime pearls that slow down as they travel, and are not affected by gravity. After reaching a moderate distance, the slime pearls will stop and become overloaded. Slime pearls lose 15% damage per hit but restore to full damage when they become overloaded. When overloaded, slime pearls deal 160% of the weapon's damage and do not pierce. If a slime pearl hits a tile, it will bounce off at high speed, with its velocity reduced on each bounce.

All projectiles function identically to the ones fired from Anahita, but do not pierce or pass through tiles. The Water Elemental deals a base damage of 65, which is increased by summon damage bonuses.

There can only be one beacon summoned at a time.

It requires at least a Pickaxe Axe or a Drax to mine. It is also dropped by Perennial Slimes.

wikiTooltip: Casts two enchanted blasts of sand that converge with each other and explode
intro: The Primordial Earth is a craftable Hardmode spell tome. It is a direct upgrade to the Death Valley Duster, firing 2 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. Using it at full mana and with no Mana Sickness gives the player, and any player that touches the dust particles, the Sand's Wind buff which increases defense by 4, damage by 12%, and mana regeneration.

intro: The Primrose Keepsake is a craftable pet summoning item that is a combination of Bear's Eye and the Romajeda Orchid, allowing both pets to be summoned at once. It summons a guardian angel cat named Bear and a dog named Kendra to follow the player. If the player is moving too fast, Bear will use a pair of blue angel wings to fly towards the player, and Kendra will use a pair of black dragon wings to fly towards them.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 프리즘-백

intro: The Prism Crate is a Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sunken Sea. The crate contains several Sunken Sea blocks. Its Pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Eutrophic Crate.

intro: Prism Shards are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are naturally generated in the Sunken Sea biome. They require at least a Gold or Platinum Pickaxe to mine. They are used to craft Sea Prisms, The Etomer, Wave Skipper, several Sunken Sea-themed torches, and the Eutrophic Shelf, a furniture item used to craft the Eutrophic funiture set.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 프리즘 파편이 추가적으로 폭발해 적을 잠시 기절시킵니다

intro: The Prismalline is a craftable Hardmode dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Crystalline. When used, it throws a prism dagger that is affected by gravity and pierces infinitely. Shortly after it is thrown, it splits into 3 copies of itself in a random spread. Split daggers can either be homing or non-homing, but neither type can pierce. Homing split daggers will not deal damage until they start homing. If the main dagger hits a tile before splitting, the extra daggers will not appear.

Performing a stealth strike with the Prismalline causes the next dagger thrown to split into 6 copies instead of 3 and spawn 4 prism shards. The main dagger shatters into 5 prism shards and all dagger copies shatter into 1-2 prism shards. Prism shards are affected by gravity, do not pierce, and home in on nearby enemies. Prism shards will not deal damage until they start homing. Shards from the main dagger deal 50% of the weapon's damage while shards from the dagger copies deal 33.33% damage. The main dagger and prism shards inflict the Eutrophication debuff.

intro: The Profaned Core is a post-Moon Lord boss-summoning item that is dropped by the Profaned Guardians. It is used to summon Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It can only be used in The Hallow or The Underworld.

Profaned Crystal is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Glass and Unholy Essences at an Ancient Manipulator. It is used in the crafting of Runic Profaned Bricks.
Profaned Crystal Wall is an aesthetic building material. It is crafted with Profaned Crystal.

intro: The Profaned Partisan is a craftable post-Moon Lord javelin that is an upgrade to the Spear of Paleolith. On use, it throws a javelin that splits into holy spears on hit. Holy spears have oscillating velocity and can pierce through enemies.

Performing a stealth strike with the Profaned Partisan will cause the next spear thrown to impale into enemies; javelins that hit an enemy with a stealth strike javelin impaled into them will instead explode into several homing holy fires.
Profaned Rock is a craftable post-Moon Lord block crafted from Stone Blocks and Unholy Essences at a Hardmode Forge. It is used in the crafting of Profaned furniture.
Profaned Rock Wall is a background wall crafted with Profaned Rock.

Profaned Slab Walls are background walls crafted with Profaned Slabs.

The Profaned Soul Crystal has two distinct states dependent on whether or not the Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas have been defeated in the world. Before defeating them, the accessory is entirely vanity. After defeating them, the accessory gains extensive combat functionality.

intro: The Protolith Bangle is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. The Puff Warrior attempts to stay on the same side of where the player is facing. If the minion is within a 22.5-tile radius near the enemy, it will attempt to jump towards the enemy, firing 3 damaging puff clouds that do not pierce. However, it will only perform this attack when it is jumping.

intro: The Pulse Dragon is a craftable post-Moon Lord flail. When used, the player swings two glowing electric dragon heads which move in a whip-like manner. As they converge, up to eight short-lasting electrosphere projectiles are spawned per flail. The flail then returns, either after converging or upon tile contact.

On hit, the grenade bursts into 8 outward-spiraling pulse orbs which pierce through all enemies in their path and return to the player after a delay, reforming the grenade in their hand.
Stealth strikes have a longer throw animation and deal 85% damage, but throw the grenade at much higher speed and cause it to burst into 16 pulse orbs.

After hitting an enemy, the orb splits into two smaller pulse orbs that deal 25% base damage. If the initial pulse orb deals the killing blow to an enemy, it will home to the next nearest enemy before splitting - there is no limit to how many times it can retarget before splitting.

intro: The A-PLS: Pulse Rifle is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. The pulse orbs briefly pause in place before aggressively tracking nearby enemies and get faster the more enemies they hit. If the target is killed by the pulse orb, the pierce is not used up and the orb gains 1.5 additional seconds of lifetime. If no enemies are present for the pulse orbs to hit, they will travel straight in the direction they are set in.

intro: The Pumpkaboom is a craftable Pre-Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws a pumpkin bomb that sticks to enemies on hit. Upon sticking to enemies for 1.83 seconds, it explodes in a 10.625 tile radius for 200% damage.
Performing a stealth strike with the Pumpkaboom throws a larger pumpkin that pull in enemies within a 15 tile radius upon sticking. The explosion radius is also increased to 14.375 tiles.

The Pumpler is a craftable Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, the weapon slowly charges, indicated by the barrel increasing in size after each charge. After five charges, the weapon is fully loaded and can fire five gravity-affected pumpkin grenades; each charge adds a pumpkin grenade and releasing the left-click before the weapon is fully charged will cause it to fire whatever amount was charged at that point. The pumpkin grenades explode immediately on contact with enemies and will explode on impact with tiles if they have been in the air for at least 0.25 seconds, otherwise they will rebound away. It does not require ammo to use.

After 2.5 seconds of firing, the barrage of beams is replaced with two large, sweeping holy rays which deal 650% base damage.

Purified Gel is a Pre-Hardmode crafting material that is dropped by The Slime God. It is used in the crafting of several late Pre-Hardmode equipment that belongs to the "Night's" theme as well as some potions and Statigel-themed items.

The split daggers do not pierce and will not deal damage until they start homing. If the main dagger pierces 3 times or hits a tile before splitting, the extra daggers will not appear. If the explosion hits an enemy, three different types of stars will rain down on the initial impact of the explosion. The daggers, explosions, and astral stars inflict the Astral Infection debuff.

Performing a stealth strike with the Radiant Star will cause the next dagger thrown to split into 7 copies of itself instead of 3 and the main dagger causes a larger, lingering explosion that sucks in non-boss enemies within a 37.5 tile radius.

intro: The Relic of Deliverance is a post-Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear. The spear allows the player to ram enemies and pass through tiles, but staying inside tiles for too long teleports the player out to the last spot they were in that was an open tile. Holding left-click slows down the spear to charge energy. Releasing left-click launches the player at high speed towards the cursor with slower turning speed, but waiting too long to release left-click busts the charge, resetting speed. The spear has halved speed while a boss is alive, and reduces the damage of summon weapons by 90% while in use.

intro: The Relic of Resilience is a post-Moon Lord tool that is dropped by the Guardian Defender. When used, it summons an orbit of rocks around the player while held. While the rocks are orbiting, the player's defense cannot be reduced below 200 and their damage reduction cannot be reduced below 10%. Getting hit or right-clicking briefly pulls in the shards before blasting them out, dealing damage and inflicting Profaned Weakness on all nearby enemies, reducing their damage reduction by 50%. Triggering the blast prevents the relic from being used for 10 seconds. While in use, player's summon weapons have their damage reduced by 90%.

The blades neither pierce nor pass through blocks.

intro: The Resilient Candle is a post-Moon Lord furniture item that is sold by the Wizard for 25 gold coins after Moon Lord has been defeated. It emits light and right-clicking the placed candle grants the Resilience buff, which makes defense block 15% more damage additively, and this buff scales in higher difficulties. In Classic Mode, it will block 65% damage, while in Expert and Master Mode, it will block 90% and 115% damage respectively.
This buff lasts permanently and persists after death, but will be overridden if Limber, Spite, or Vigor are applied or the player cancels the buff.

The chainsaw itself has an innate 15 armor penetration and heals the player for 1-2 every hit. Both the chainsaw and blood inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff.

intro: The Resurrection Butterfly is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon. When used with 2 or more minion slots, it summons two butterflies of different colors. The purple butterfly will charge into enemies with a short delay between charges, while the pink butterfly will fire 2 bullets towards enemies every 2-4 seconds that deal 85% of the weapon's base damage and last for 3.5 seconds.
One pair of butterflies counts as two minions towards the maximum minion count.

intro: The Riftburst is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow that is the direct upgrade to the Phantasm. When used, it shoots volleys of 5 arrows at an initially low rate of fire that increases as it is used continuously. When its arrows hit an enemy, it also spawns an additional barrage of phantasm arrows that home in on that enemy and has a 66% chance to not consume arrows. It is later used in the crafting of the Contagion.

intro: The Rock is an item that is obtained as a reward for defeating the Boss Rush. It can be placed as furniture or shimmered into the Boss Rush Monolith, as well as providing lore and being a trophy for completing the Boss Rush.

wikiTooltip: 15% increased rogue damage
intro: The Rogue Emblem is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When equipped, it increases rogue damage by 15%. It is the rogue-class equivalent of the vanilla class emblems. It is used in the crafting of the Avenger Emblem and Nanotech.

wikiTooltip: Summons a never forgotten friend
intro: The Romajeda Orchid is a pet summoning item that is sold by the Dryad for 40 gold coins. It summons a dog named Kendra to follow the player. When the player is idle, Kendra will either waggle its tail, yawn or bark to alert the player. If the player moves too fast, Kendra will use a pair of black dragon wings to fly toward them.

intro: The Rose Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When equipped, it summons a friendly Brimstone Elemental to protect the player, which attacks nearby enemies by firing brimstone fireballs or through contact damage. The Brimstone Elemental deals a base damage of 60, increased by summon damage bonuses.

wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes spawn rain clouds on enemy hits
intro: The Rot Ball is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When used, it throws a rot ball that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and pierces twice.

Performing a stealth strike with the Rot Ball causes a shade nimbus cloud to spawn above every enemy hit by the weapon and rain down raindrops that damage enemies. Up to 2 shade nimbus clouds can exist at a time, causing the older existing cloud to dissipate when a new cloud spawns. The weapon and raindrops inflict the Brain Rot debuff.

intro: The Rotten Dogtooth is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Rotdogs. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and inflict the Crumbling debuff.

intro: The Rotting Eyeball is a Pre-Hardmode pet summoning item that is dropped by The Hive Mind. It summons a miniature Hive Mind to follow the player around. It has a 1 in 500 chance per frame to charge at the player while making a roar sound and then teleporting to a random location near the player afterwards, which has a 5 second cooldown.

wikiTooltip: Fires a wave of 3 rouge air slashes
intro: The Rouge Slash is a post-Moon Lord spell tome that is dropped by Dragonfolly. When used, it fires three curved waves out from the player, which each vary in their size and speed and pass through tiles. The waves each pierce twice and disappear upon contact with a third.

Rounded Anodized Wulfrum Panels are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block made from Stone Blocks, Wulfrum Metal Scraps, and Anodized Wulfrum Metal at a Heavy Work Bench. It is used to make the Anodized Wulfrum furniture set.

intro: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

Durability regenerates the same way as it is formed, requiring the player to not take damage for 10 seconds. Matrix durability will regenerate at a rate of 4 durability per second, and takes five seconds to fully regenerate from 0. It can regenerate if the shield is partially or fully damaged, but will immediately be interrupted as the player takes damage.

When used, the sword is charged up and held over the player's head. Releasing will cause one of two attacks to occur depending on the position of the mouse.

intro: Rubber Mortar Rounds are craftable Hardmode bullets that are an upgrade to Mortar Rounds. They can be used by any gun that does not shoot custom bullets. They bounce up to two times, creating a large explosion that is able to destroy tiles on each bounce.

intro: The Rubico Prime is a craftable Hardmode gun that is a direct upgrade to the Nitro Express Rifle. When used, it fires bullets at a high velocity, producing recoil. Every 5 shots, the weapon must be reloaded. Its shots can hit up to 5 targets.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 루비 크롤러

+6% rogue damage

intro: Ruinous Souls are post-Moon Lord crafting materials that are dropped by Polterghast. They are used to craft two armor sets, numerous weapons, the Phantom Heart, and Stratus Bricks.

15% decreased minion damage

intro: Rum is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Rum debuff, which multiplies summon damage that aren't minions or minion shots by 1.15x but multiplies damage of minions and minion shots by 0.85x.
While the effects of the Rum debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.
Runestone is a Pre-Hardmode block obtained by throwing Navystone into Shimmer.
Runestone Wall is a background wall crafted with Runestone.
Runic Profaned Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Profaned Rocks and Profaned Crystals at a Hardmode Forge.
Runic Profaned Brick Wall is a post-Moon Lord background wall crafted with Runic Profaned Brick.

intro: The Rusted Jingle Bell is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by Baby Ghost Bells when hit with any type of Bug Net or obtained rarely by fishing in the Sunken Sea. It summons a Baby Ghost Bell pet to follow the player and provide a large amount of light while underwater.
Rusted Pipes are craftable Pre-Hardmode blocks that can also be found in Arsenal Labs. They are used in the crafting of Laboratory Pipe Platings.
Rusted Plate Beams are background walls crafted with Rusted Plating.
Rusted Plate Pillars are background walls crafted with Rusted Plating.
Rusted Plating is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block that can also be found in Arsenal Labs. It is used in the crafting of Aged Laboratory furniture.
Rusted Plating Walls are background walls crafted with Rusted Plating.

Rusty Chests are chests found only in the Sulphurous Sea that contain rare and unique items. Each Rusty Chest will contain one unique item along with other standard loot.

intro: The Sacred Strawberry is a craftable post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Sanguine Tangerine, the Miracle Fruit, and the Tainted Cloudberry. It is the last of these to be obtainable following boss progression. It can only be used once, and after that the player must use one of the remaining fruit to increase their maximum life. With all of these, the player's maximum life is capped at 600.

intro: Sacrifice is a post-Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When used with the left-click, it rapidly throws daggers that stick to enemies and constantly deal damage for 0.83 seconds. Up to a maximum of 15 daggers can be stuck at a time. When used with the right-click, daggers that are stuck on an enemy will return to the player and heal for 4 health per dagger.
Performing a stealth strike with the Sacrifice will cause the resulting dagger to heal for 40 health when returning to the player.

intro: The Sahara Slicers are a Pre-Hardmode shortsword that are dropped by the Desert Scourge. When swung, a pair of dual daggers rapidly stab in front of the player. Hitting an enemy with one of the daggers will spawn 2 bolts which appear behind the player, up to a maximum of 10. Right clicking while a bolt is available will throw one of the bolts in the direction of the cursor; thrown bolts deal 100% base damage.
Like every shortsword, they have an incredibly short range, but unlike most other vanilla shortswords, they have autoswing.

The disk can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely, and has a chance to fire 6 smaller disks outwards from it when an enemy is nearby, which linger for a short time before dissipating.
Performing a stealth strike with the Samsara Slicer will cause the next disk thrown to travel slower, but also continuously generate smaller disks that orbit around it.

When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has. The Profaned Energy can target enemies through tiles and its projectiles can pass through tiles.

When equipped, dashing creates a large damaging dust veil around the player that follows the player for 15 seconds, or until the player dashes again. The dust veil deals 10 typeless damage, cannot deal critical hits, and does not scale with any damage boosts. This effect has a 15-second cooldown after the veil disappears. While in the dust veil, the player is granted an additional +3 defense and 1.75x acceleration and enemies will take 30% knockback while near the dust veil.

Performing a stealth strike with the Sand Dollar will throw an additional 2 sand dollars. They travel farther and each spawn a coral shard on enemy hits, which is slightly affected by gravity.

10% increased damage

intro: The Sand Sharknado Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Forgotten Apex Wand. When used, it summons a sandnado to attack nearby enemies by firing miniature high velocity Sand Sharks at them.

Unlike its predecessor, it does not place Sand Blocks where its projectiles collide.

After hitting an enemy, the flare explodes for 50% of its charged damage and releases up to 20 blood orbs. These orbs can pass through tiles and lower Potion Sickness by 0.3 seconds when collected or increase natural life regeneration if the player does not have Potion Sickness.
