intro: Saros Possession is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to Sirius. When used, it summons a spinning solar aura that fires homing light orbs that can bounce between enemies and pierce twice. Repeated summons will increase the aura's damage and attack speed by 20% per minion slot used.

Using the weapon with no free minion slots will cause it to stop firing light orbs and instead fire an eclipse beam that deals 200% base damage, multiplied by the number of minions slots in use. Over 5 seconds, the eclipse beam will become thinner and gradually decrease its damage from 200% to 100% of the base damage. The eclipse beam recharges to full damage over time when not in use.

wikiTooltip: Sprays homing blood on hit
intro: The Sausage Maker is a Pre-Hardmode spear that is dropped by The Perforators. When hitting an enemy with the spear, it fires a blood bolt that homes in on enemies. Both the spear and blood bolts inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

tooltip: 당신을 보호하는 작은 블러드 크롤러를 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a baby blood crawler to protect you
intro: The Scab Ripper is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a tiny Blood Crawler minion that flies around and latches onto nearby enemies. When latched, it deals contact damage in addition to spawning 2 damaging blood particles from the sky that pierce once. Like the Spider Staff minions, it is able to move on walls. It is the Crimson counterpart to the Vile Feeder.

tooltip: 날아간 궤도에 적을 추적하는 흔적을 남기는 창을 빠르게 던집니다
창은 적을 타격시 진홍빛 폭발을 일으킵니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 적을 타격하면 체력을 훔쳐오며 별 투사체를 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Throws an ultra high velocity spear, which leaves a trail of homing bullets
The spear creates a Scarlet Blast upon hitting an enemy
Stealth strikes grant you lifesteal and summon a star of projectiles upon hitting an enemy
'Divine Spear "Spear the Gungnir"'
intro: The Scarlet Devil is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer javelin. When used, it throws an extremely fast spear that pierces 4 times and releases scarlet bullets every 4 frames as it travels, which deal 3.5% base damage. The scarlet bullets are not affected by gravity and home in on enemies after a short delay. If no enemies are nearby, they will stop moving and disappear after a short amount of time. Upon hitting the first enemy, the spear causes a scarlet explosion that rapidly deals damage. Both the spear and its bullets can pass through tiles.

Performing a stealth strike with the Scarlet Devil will cause the next spear thrown to heal the player for 0.5% of the damage dealt on hit, as well as release many scarlet bullets in a hexagram pattern.

tooltip: 원거리 적중 시 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Irradiated] 디버프의 효율이 증가합니다
[cbuff:CalamityMod/Irradiated]의 지속 피해량이 사용자의 원거리 공격력 및 치명타 확률에 비례해 증가합니다
적 처치 시 적이 폭발하며 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Irradiated] 디버프를 퍼뜨립니다
wikiTooltip: Taking damage causes the curio to explode in retaliation
intro: The Scions Curio is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Rusty Chests. When equipped, it makes killing an enemy or getting hit create a blast that inflicts Irradiated for 5 seconds. Also, hitting enemies with ranged weapons boost the effects of the Irradiated debuff in the following ways:
Its damage scales based on the player's ranged damage and critical strike chance.
Scorched Bone is a block obtained by cutting down Spine Trees in the Brimstone Crag biome. It requires at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.
Scorched Bone Walls are background walls crafted with Scorched Bones.

wikiTooltip: Fires a burst of four heat seeking missiles that rapidly accelerate after a short delay
All rockets explode into napalm cluster bombs on impact
50% chance to save ammo
'Burns your targets to a fine crisp'
intro: The Scorched Earth is a craftable post-Moon Lord launcher. When used, it fires a burst of four homing rockets which can travel through tiles. After five seconds or upon enemy hits, the rockets creates a large explosion which inflict the Daybroken and Oiled debuffs and spawns five additional cluster bombs in random directions outward from the enemy. Each cluster bomb explodes into two or three gravity-affected flaming shards. The cluster bomb and shards both deal 25% of the weapon's damage.

Scorched Remains are blocks that generate naturally in the Brimstone Crag in massive conic patches. Their surfaces can be covered with Cinder Blossom grass and Lava Lilies, or manually grown with Cinder Blossom Seeds. They require at least a Molten Pickaxe to mine.

wikiTooltip: The smoke feels warm
intro: Scoria Bars are Hardmode bars that are made with 4 Scoria Ore at a Hardmode Forge and are additionally dropped from the Fleshy and Necromantic Geode. They are used to craft various volcanic-themed items, as well as being used to craft Life Alloys.
Scoria Brick is a craftable Hardmode brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Scoria Ore at a Furnace.
Scoria Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Scoria Brick.

Scoria Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates naturally in the Abyss. It can generate on the underside of the floating Abyss Gravel or Pyre Mantle islands, dropping harmful lava particles into the water beneath itself. These lava particles deal a base damage of 25.

Like Meteorite and similar blocks, making direct contact with Scoria Ore inflicts the player with the Burning debuff, which can be prevented if the player has equipped any accessory that provides immunity to Burning.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 경멸을 먹는 자
<좌클릭> 적을 추적하는 나노 미사일을 연속으로 발사하며 에너지를 충전합니다
<우클릭> 최대 충전상태에서 <좌클릭>을 함께 누르면 나노 핵탄두를 발사합니다
나노 핵탄두는 매우 강력한 피해를 입히며 나노 미사일의 발사 쿨타임을 초기화 합니다
wikiTooltip: Maximum charge is reached after firing 3 barrages
Nano nukes deal massive damage and reset the cooldown of missile barrages

tooltip: 적이나 지형에 부딪히면 튕기며 적을 추적하는 작은 무법자를 생성하는 우주의 무법자를 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a bouncing cosmic scourge that emits tiny homing cosmic scourges on enemy and tile hits
intro: The Scourge of the Cosmos is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon that is a direct upgrade of the Scourge of the Corruptor. When used, it throws a mini scourge head that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and bounces twice before dissipating. On each bounce, it releases a mini cosmic scourge that flies and homes on nearby enemies, bounces once, does not pierce, and can deal damage a second after spawning. On the first and second bounces, the scourge head releases 1-2 cosmic scourges and upon hitting a tile after the second bounce, it releases 3-4 cosmic scourges. If the scourge head directly hits an enemy, it dissipates immediately into 3-4 cosmic scourges. The cosmic scourges deal 75% of the main projectile's damage.

tooltip: 땅속에 파고들어 적을 공격하는 창을 던집니다
wikiTooltip: A javelin that will burrow through the ground and launch itself at enemies
Stealth strikes throw three javelins that will burrow multiple times
intro: The Scourge of the Desert is a javelin dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.
Performing a stealth strike with the Scourge of the Desert will throw 3 javelins instead of 1 that can burrow through the ground and pierce 3 times. The javelins deal 65% of the weapon's base damage.

tooltip: 적을 타격시 방사능 구름을 내뿜는 창을 던집니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 독소로 코팅한 창을 던져 더욱 강력한 디버프를 입힙니다
intro: The Scourge of the Seas is a Hardmode javelin that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When used, it throws a javelin that gains velocity while in flight before being affected by gravity. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and when in contact with an enemy or tile, they will explode into 3-4 toxic clouds. The javelin and clouds inflict the Irradiated debuff.
Performing a stealth strike with the weapon will cause the next javelin and its spawned clouds to inflict the Acid Venom debuff.

tooltip: 블록 및 벽면 배치 범위와 속도 크게 증가
3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Greatly increases tile and wall placement range and speed
Greatly reduces damage dealt
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Screwdriver is a craftable Pre-Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Screwdriver debuff, which increases building range by 5 tiles and tile and wall placement speed by 100%, but multiplies all damage by 0.75x.
While the effects of the Screwdriver debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 스크릴라
스텔스 스트라이크 투사체가 적중하거나 파괴될 때 보석 가시를 생성합니다
추출기에 넣어 재활용 할 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strike projectiles spawn a jewel spike on hit or when destroyed
Can also be broken down at an extractinator

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 바다 부유물
주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 바다 피라미

intro: The Sea Minnow is a critter that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It passively swims back and forth, gaining a temporary speed boost when hitting a tile and will attempt to swim away from the player. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net and may be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 20%.

Sea Prisms are a Pre-Hardmode ore found naturally generated within the Sunken Sea and can be crafted using Prism Shards. They require at least a Gold or Platinum Pickaxe to mine. They are used as crafting materials in several weapons themed around the Sunken Sea, as well as Mollusk armor and pieces of the Eutrophic furniture set. They are also used to craft Tesla's Amulets.
Sea Prism Brick is a craftable brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Sea Prisms at a Furnace.
Sea Remains are a Pre-Hardmode crafting material made with a Pearl Shard, Coral, a Starfish and a Seashell. They are used to craft various ocean-themed items.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 바다뱀
사용자를 따라다니는 정령의 보주가 최대 8개까지 서서히 주변에 머뭅니다
체력이 50% 미만이면 정령들이 사용자를 치유하며 그 외에는 주변 적을 공격합니다
가시성이 비활성화된 경우 정령의 보주가 투명해지고 소리가 나지 않습니다
wikiTooltip: Slowly accumulate up to eight spirit orbs that follow you
Spirits disperse when dashing
If below 50% life, they will heal you, otherwise they will attack nearby enemies
35% increased Water debuff damage
Spirit orbs are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
intro: The Sea Spirit Amulet is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be caught while fishing in the Sunken Sea after defeating Desert Scourge. While equipped, it spawns spirit orbs every 1.25 seconds which follow the player, up to a maximum of 8. Spirit orbs disperse when the player dashes; their next action depends on the player's health.
If above 50% max health, spirit orbs will attack enemies with a base damage of 12 and inflict the Riptide debuff on enemies for 3 seconds.

tooltip: 탄환과 고압 수류가 번갈아 가며 장전되는 50발들이 탄창을 장착합니다
고압 수류는 자신 주변을 헤엄치는 작은 물고기를 소환합니다
모든 탄환을 발사하면 재장전하는 동안 소환된 물고기들이 커서 방향으로 떼 지어 돌진합니다
wikiTooltip: Loads a 50 round magazine of alternating bullets and pressurized water jets
Water jets summon small fish that swim around you
When all bullets are fired, summoned fish swarm the cursor while you reload
66% chance to save ammo
intro: The Seadragon is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun that is an upgrade to the Megalodon. When used, it loads a magazine of 50 shots, then alternates between firing bullets and pressurized water jets that inflict the Riptide debuff. Water jets pierce four times and summon small fish that swim around player on enemy hits. After exhausting the entire magazine, all fish swarm the cursor and home in on nearby enemies before having to reload again, repeating the process. Summoned fish deal 150% base damage. The gun has a 66% chance to not consume ammo.

tooltip: 폭발하며 적에게 추가 피해를 입히는 폭탄을 던집니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 더 빠르고 날아가며 5개의 거품을 내뿜습니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a bomb that explodes into a bubble which deals extra damage to enemies
Stealth strikes are faster and explode into 5 bubbles
intro: The Seafoam Bomb is a Pre-Hardmode non-consumable bomb. When used, it throws a small bomb that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. Upon collision with a tile or enemy, the bomb explodes into a bubble that ignores enemy immunity frames.
Performing a stealth strike with the Seafoam Bomb causes it to have higher initial velocity and cause a significantly larger explosion releasing five bubbles instead of one.

tooltip: 유황 바다에서 사용 시 바다의 무법자를 소환합니다
'대어를 낚기 위한 커다란 미끼입니다. 바다의 괴수들을 조심하세요'
wikiTooltip: Summons the Aquatic Scourge when used in the Sulphurous Sea
Enrages outside the Sulphurous Sea
Not consumable
'Large bait for a large catch. Beware the monsters of the seas.'
intro: Seafood is a craftable boss-summoning item that is used to summon the Aquatic Scourge. It can only be used in the Sulphurous Sea.

tooltip: 짧은 도화선 시간이 지난 후 속도가 느려지며 지속 피해 영역을 생성하는 구속된 특이점 폭탄을 투척합니다
왼쪽 클릭 길게 누르면 스텔스 게이지를 생성하지만 폭탄의 도화선을 태워 없앱니다
영역이 붕괴하면 특이점은 자신이 타격한 가장 강한 대상을 추적하여 폭발합니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 지속 피해 영역의 크기와 지속 시간이 증가합니다
도화선을 너무 오래 붙잡고 있으면 손 안에서 폭발합니다
wikiTooltip: Disables normal stealth generation
Throws a contained singularity bomb that slows down and creates a damaging field after a short fuse
After the field collapses, the singularity seeks out the strongest target that it hit and explodes
Stealth strikes increase the size and duration of the damaging field
Will explode in your hand if you hold the fuse too long
intro: The Sealed Singularity is a craftable post-Moon Lord bomb. When used, it throws a bomb that stops in place and creates a long-lasting damaging field of rock debris and purple dust clouds that are pulled towards the initial impact of the bomb after a delay or upon hitting an enemy. The bomb gains a purple aura afterimage that grows more intensity the longer the bomb is out before exploding. After a moment, the bomb will transform into a blackhole before launching towards the enemy it hit and explode into an eruption of purple clouds.
Performing a stealth strike with the Sealed Singularity makes the damaging field larger and last longer.

tooltip: 여러개의 거품을 발사하며 거품에 맞은 적에게 추가적인 거품이 날아갑니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a string of bubbles summoning a shower of bubbles on hit

tooltip: 물로 만들어진 검 모양의 광선을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Shoots an aqua sword beam
intro: The Seashine Sword is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a glowing aquamarine sword beam that deals 100% base damage. The beam disappears upon hitting a block or an enemy, or after 2 seconds of travel.

Security Chests are chests found only in the Arsenal Labs that contain rare and unique items. Each Security Chest will contain two or more unique items depending on the type of lab, along with other standard loot.

tooltip: 적중 후 추가로 3명의 대상에게 튕겨 나가는 거대한 수정 도끼를 던집니다
튕길 대상이 남아있지 않으면 해당 위치에 고정되어 수정화됩니다
고정된 수정 도끼는 다른 도끼를 던져 맞혀서 터뜨릴 수 있습니다
폭파 시 파괴된 개수에 따라 위력이 강화되지만 대신 더 이상 수정화되지 않습니다
'적들이 지은 죄로 인해 지옥에서 영원히 타오를것 입니다'
wikiTooltip: Throws a massive crystalline axe which bounces to three additional targets after hitting
Crystallizes in place if all bounces have not been exhausted
Crystallized hatchets can be shattered by another axe
Doing so empowers the hatchet based on the amount shattered but prevents it from crystallizing
'May your enemies burn in hell for the sins they have committed'
intro: The Seeking Scorcher is a craftable post-Moon Lord thrown melee weapon and the direct upgrade of the Possessed Hatchet. When used, it throws a massive crystalline hatchet which can bounce between up to four enemies, losing 20% damage per hit. If the hatchet does not reach its maximum bounces, it crystallizes in place. Crystallized hatchets can be shattered when hit by another hatchet, which increases its damage by 200% and speed by 125% multiplicatively per bounce up to a maximum of 3, but prevents the empowered hatchet from crystallizing. The hatchets inflict the Holy Flames debuff.
Its best modifier is Godly.

tooltip: 가속되는 유황 지옥 폭발탄을 곡선 형태로 발사합니다
세 번째 공격마다 적을 추격하는 유황 화살 고리를 생성합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires an accelerating arc of brimstone hellblasts
Every third attack spawns a brimstone dart ring which chases after foes
intro: The Seething Discharge is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by the Brimstone Elemental. When used, it fires an arc of 5 hellblasts that accelerate over time. Every third use of the weapon additionally spawns a ring of 8 brimstone darts that can home in on enemies after a short delay. Both the hellblasts and darts pass through tiles and inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

wikiTooltip: Capable of mining Lihzahrd Bricks
intro: The Seismic Hampick is a Hardmode pickaxe and hammer combination that is capable of mining blocks up to Lihzahrd Brick and Scoria Ore. Left clicking allows it to be used as a pickaxe, while right clicking allows it to be used as a hammer. Both modes automatically swing, emit fiery particles, and inflict the Hellfire debuff on contact.

tooltip: 작살은 적에게 박혀 오래 유지되는 유황 중독 상태를 부여합니다
박힌 지 1초가 지나면 작살이 스스로 뽑혀 나오며 피해를 주는 살점을 흩뿌립니다
<우클릭>으로 모든 작살을 수동으로 뽑아내어 추가 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다
죽음에 임박한 적은 되돌아오는 작살에 끌려오며 플레이어에게 닿는 순간 처형됩니다
처형 시 체력을 25 회복하고 추가 작살 한 발을 자동으로 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Launches a vile chained harpoon infested with toxins
After being impaled for one second, harpoons rip themselves back out and spray damaging gores
Enemies close to death are dragged back with returning harpoons and executed when they reach you
Executions heal you for 25 health and launch an additional harpoon automatically
intro: The Septic Skewer is a post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it fires harpoons that stick into enemies. After being stuck for 1 second, harpoons return to the player, releasing gore projectiles from the stuck enemy. Right-clicking causes all stuck harpoons to return to the player, dealing additional damage.

Enemies that are at low health are instead pulled to the player by harpoons, which instantly executes them. Executions heal the player for 25 health, and cause an additional harpoon to be automatically fired. Each successive harpoon which executes an enemy moves faster but heals less health.

tooltip: 용암 및 [i:CalamityMod/AuricOre] 오릭 광석을 포함한 위험한 타일에 면역을 부여합니다
[c/aaaaaa:인벤토리에서 Shift+우클릭으로][i:AngelWings][c/aaaaaa:날개 효과를 끄거나 켤 수 있습니다]
wikiTooltip: Allows flight and slow fall
Flight time: 4.17 seconds
50% increased running acceleration
Provides the effects of Angel Treads
Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore
'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'
intro: The Seraph Tracers are a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory. They are the direct upgrade to the Void Striders and final upgrade to the Hermes Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:
The ability to fly and glide

tooltip: 기하급수적으로 느려지며 소멸할 때 빛이 나는 단검을 빠르게 던집니다
완전히 소멸하면 6개의 빠른 칼날로 분열하며 큰 광선과 함께 근처의 적을 조준하여 조각냅니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 폭발하며 7개의 광선을 내뿜는 작은 빛 덩어리를 던집니다
wikiTooltip: Throws an extraordinarily fast dagger which slows down exponentially and dissipates into light
Once dissipation has ended, 6 splitting blades that slice nearby targets are released, along with a large laserbeam
Stealth strikes release a volley of 8 lights which explode into smaller laser beams along with the dagger
intro: The Seraphim is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Shattered Dawn and the final upgrade to the Wulfrum Knife. When used, it throws a holy dagger that naturally slows down exponentially as it travels, while also reducing its speed by 60% for each enemy hit. After 0.83 seconds, it glows and bursts into 6 daggers and an angelic light orb. Splitting daggers deal half of the weapon's damage and pass through tiles but do not pierce. Splitting daggers are aimed towards the nearest enemy within a 100-tile radius. If no enemies are nearby, the splitting daggers will travel upwards and dissipate afterwards. The angelic light orb bursts into a laser beam at nearby enemies after 0.16 seconds which covers a 62.5-tile distance. The main dagger and laser beams pierce infinitely and pass through tiles.

Performing a stealth strike with the Seraphim spawns a spread of 8 angelic light orbs in front of the player that travel a moderate distance before dissipating. If enemies are nearby, the orbs will burst into laser beams after 1.58 seconds.

wikiTooltip: Casts a serpent that follows the mouse cursor
Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense
intro: The Serpentine is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by Sea Serpents. When used, it fires a cyan glowing serpent that moves around in a wave-like motion and periodically propels itself forward towards the cursor position in random directions and propels itself back to the area of the cursor before dissipating after a moderate amount of time. The serpent pierces 4 times before dissipating on the fifth or on tile collision and has an innate 15 armor penetration.

wikiTooltip: Reach: 28.125 tiles
Launch Velocity: 18
Reelback Velocity: 14
Pull Velocity: 12

tooltip: 폭발하며 적을 추적하는 어둠의 수정 조각을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons bursts of shadecrystals that can home in on enemies
intro: The Shadecrystal Barrage is a craftable Hardmode spell tome that is a direct upgrade to the Crystal Storm. When used, it fires two bursts of six inaccurate storm of shadecrystals which pause in between them and inflict the Frostbite debuff. The crystals can ricochet off tiles and gain velocity as they travel and slightly home on enemies after traveling fast enough.

tooltip: 그림자 불꽃을 입히는 그림자 비구름을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a spray of evil clouds and rain
intro: The Shaderain Staff is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When used, it fires a spread of 2 gravity-affected raindrops along with a decelerating cloud ball that can go through walls. Both the cloud balls and raindrops inflict the Brain Rot debuff and do not pierce.

tooltip: 어둠의 구름을 뿜어내 적에게 부패한 뇌 상태이상을 부여합니다
wikiTooltip: Uses gel for ammo
intro: The Shadethrower is a Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that is dropped by The Hive Mind. It uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires four bursts of shade clouds at a short range. Each cloud pierces twice, is unaffected by liquids, cannot pass through tiles, and inflicts the Brain Rot debuff.

tooltip: 플레이어를 빛나는 눈을 가진 그림자로 변형시킵니다
스텔스 투명화 설정을 통해 시각 효과를 비활성화할 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: 8% increased stealth generation

intro: The Soma Prime is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer gun. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a small spread. It also converts Musket Balls into high-damage High Velocity Bullets which have 4 additional base damage. Each shot has a 5% chance to inflict the Shred debuff. Critical strikes deal 3x damage, and have a 30% chance to inflict the Shred debuff. This debuff deals 600 damage per second, scales with the player's ranged damage and critical strike chance bonuses, can critically strike for 3x base damage, and can stack multiple times, with the number of stacks being displayed above the afflicted enemy.

Damage from Soma Prime and the Shred debuff are affected by a supercrit mechanic, where critical strike chance over 100% can still provide benefits. Any critical strike chance over 100% counts as chance to increase the critical strike damage over the base multiplier of 3x. For example, with a critical strike chance of 160%, there is a 60% chance to deal 4x base damage and a 40% chance to deal 3x base damage. A critical strike chance of 325% would provide a 25% chance to deal 6x base damage and a 75% chance to deal 5x base damage.

intro: The Starcore is a craftable Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon Astrum Deus. It can only be used at an Astral Beacon in the Astral Infection.
This item is only accessible after Astrum Deus has been defeated; before defeating Astrum Deus, consumable Titan Hearts must be used instead.

intro: The Starfleet is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Super Star Shooter. It uses Fallen Stars as ammo. Upon using left-click, the gun fires a spread of piercing star shots. Right click fires a short-range blast on a cooldown. Both attacks can be used independently of each other, and using them together can increase acceleration of star shots, damage, and reduces the spread of star shots. Missing the timing increases damage but greatly increases the spread.

intro: The Starlight Fuel Cell is a Hardmode permanent power-up item obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. Upon consumption, it increases the damage of the Adrenaline Mode buff by +20% and increases how much damage reduction the player gains when hit while the meter is full by +5%. There are 2 other items that function identically to this: the Electrolyte Gel Pack and the Ectoheart. It can only be used once.

intro: Starlight Wings are a craftable Hardmode wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

intro: The Starmageddon is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon. It does not consume ammo. When used, it fires a pair of stars, one blue and the other orange. The stars orbit each other and home in on enemies, then stick onto them on hit. While stuck, the stars rapidly deal damage, release sparks and clouds of their respective colors, and summon a barrage of star-related projectiles towards the target from its left and right. These projectiles each deal 50% of the weapon's damage and are fired at a rate of 8 per second. The pair of stars instantly dissipate when the player stops using the weapon. Every projectile can pass through tiles.

intro: The Starnight Lance is a craftable Hardmode spear. When used, it fires a starlight beam that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before dissipating. The spear and beams inflict the Frostbite debuff.

intro: The Star of Destruction is a craftable Hardmode bomb. On use, it throws a large spread of cosmic bolts which converge into a bomb. The bomb weakly follows the cursor, exploding when it hits an enemy or after 5 seconds.

Performing a stealth strike with the Star of Destruction will cause the bomb to deal 25% of the weapon's base damage and follow the cursor faster, and allows it to hit enemies without immediately expiring. Its explosion when it expires will also be much larger.

The Starspawn Helix Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it summons an Astral Probe minion that orbits around the player and fires homing astral lasers that go through tiles.

The Starter Bag is a grab bag that is given to every newly spawned player. Right-clicking on the bag while it is in the inventory will give the player many items, all of which will help them progress through the beginning of the game more quickly and easily.

intro: The Stellar Cannon is a Hardmode ranged weapon that is dropped by Novas after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. When used, it fires explosive astral crystals that explode on contact with enemies, inflicting the Astral Infection debuff. The astral crystal fired requires no ammo and will pass through tiles.

intro: The Stellar Contempt is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon and the direct upgrade to the Fallen Paladin's Hammer. When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles. Upon hitting an enemy, it slows down and starts returning to the player, damaging all enemies in its path.
Up to 5 times, thrown hammer hits have increasingly higher pitched hit sounds and summon 1 additional lunar flare from the sky. The lunar flares deal 5% base damage.

'ZA WARUDO'
intro: The Stellar Knife is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated. When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.
Performing a stealth strike with the Stellar Knife causes ten knives to be thrown instead of one. If more than fifteen knives are present, this effect cannot trigger.

tooltip: 적을 공격시 하늘에서 달빛 섬광을 내립니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a swarm of lunar flares from the sky on enemy hits
intro: The Stellar Striker is a craftable post-Moon Lord special sword that is a direct upgrade to the Comet Quasher. On use, the sword is swung in a circular motion around the player. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player and rains a successive barrage of 7 lunar meteors on them that deal 150% base damage. Lunar meteors additionally explode on hit, dealing 37.5% base damage to all enemies within their radius except the target that is directly hit by the meteor. All of its attacks inflict the Nightwither debuff.

tooltip: 적을 불태우는 망원형 광선을 발사하는 궤도 원반을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons a Torus Orbital that fries foes with a telescoping light beam
intro: The Stellar Torus Staff is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons an orbital disk that follows the player and attacks enemies by charging up a sweeping laser for 1 second. The laser goes through tiles and has a length of 150 tiles, piercing infinitely and lasting for 2 seconds.
Stohne is a Hardmode block that is dropped by Bohldohrs. It is used as a renewable source of Lihzahrd Bricks.

tooltip: 적을 공격 시 토네이도를 일으키는 광선을 발사합니다

'Only a storm can fell a greatwood'
intro: The Storm Ruler is a craftable Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. When swung it shoots out a beam which, upon impact with an enemy or tile, spawns a small tornado similar to the one the Cloud Elemental spawns. The tornado lingers for 10 seconds, hits 4 times per second with infinite piercing, dealing damage to enemies that come in contact with it. The tornado also pulls in enemies similarly to the Wind Blade.

intro: The Storm Saber is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It has a chance to be dropped from Cloud Elementals. When swung, it fires a slow and homing glowing sword-like projectile from the blade, and another from the sky towards the cursor. The blade projectile deals 100% of the weapon's base damage, whereas the sky projectile deals 75%.

Does not consume ammo
'Fear the storm'
intro: The Storm Surge is a Pre-Hardmode ranged weapon. It fires a glowing blue shockwave that can pass through solid blocks and pierce a single enemy, making it useful for dispatching enemies through walls and searching for nearby caves. However, the shockwave has a short range. Unlike many other early-game ranged weapons, it does not consume ammo.

intro: The Stormfront Razor is a craftable Hardmode non-consumable dagger that is an upgrade to the Cinquedea. When used, it automatically throws a dagger that summons lightning bolts if it hits a solid tile or enemy. The daggers do not pierce. Both the knives and lightning inflict Static Discharge for 3 seconds.
Performing a stealth strike with the Stormfront Razor causes the resulting dagger to travel faster and summon three more lightning bolts.

intro: The Stormjaw Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Stormlions. When used, it summons a miniature Stormlion minion. It runs on the ground and aggressively rams enemies back and forth, does not deal contact damage but creates damaging sparks in contact with enemies. Sparks linger for 2 seconds and partially ignore immunity frames, in a similar manner to the Ilmeris' Spark. If the player is far away, it will fly with electric wings to catch up with them.

intro: Stormlion Mandibles are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Stormlions in the Desert. They are used in the crafting of several items themed around the desert and storms, including the Desert Medallion which is used to summon the Desert Scourge.

intro: The Strange Orb is a light pet summoning item that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. It summons an Ocean Spirit to follow the player. If the player is not submerged in water or honey, it sleeps while holding the orb and gives a small amount of light. When in water or honey, it swims above the player and provides more light.
Stratus Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick. It is used in the crafting of Stratus furniture.

intro: The Stream Gouge is a craftable post-Moon Lord melee weapon. When used, the spear spins around the player but does not deal damage while spinning. After spinning for a moment, it spawns a portal in the direction of the cursor which then causes the spear to repeatedly stab through the portal and deal damage on contact. It will always stab in the direction of where the portal spawns regardless of cursor position. While stabbing through the portal, two additional portals spawn near the cursor that each rapidly stab out a copy of the spear in random directions. Hitting enemies with the spear copies cause a tear of nebula cloud-like particles to form which are purely cosmetic.

intro: Stress Pills are a Pre-Hardmode accessory in Revengeance Mode. They can be obtained from any Treasure Bag at a 2.5% chance or bought from the Shady Salesman during odd Moon phases after defeating Skeletron. They grant the following effects while equipped:
+5% movement speed and acceleration
The Stuffed Fish is a grab bag-type fish that can be caught on the surface during the day at a 6.67% chance. It contains various herbs and seeds.

intro: The Stygian Shield is a craftable Hardmode melee weapon. While the weapon is in use, it provides the player 8 defense and grants immunity to knockback, at the cost of being unable to perform dashes. The player will regain the ability to dash if the weapon is not used for at least 1.5 seconds.

Holding left-click for at least 0.25 seconds charges up a dash which is aimed towards the cursor, indicated by a white arrow. Releasing grants the player 21 immunity frames and initiates the dash which lasts for 0.35 seconds, damaging enemies upon contact. Holding for longer linearly increases the damage and distance given from dashing up to a maximum of 600% damage and 45 tiles when holding for 0.75 seconds.

intro: The Subduction Slicer is a craftable Hardmode rogue boomerang that auto-fires. When used, it throws a scythe that pierces 4 times and creates a small explosion on enemy hits that deals 80% of the weapon's damage and inflicts the Hellfire debuff. It can be continuously thrown regardless of whether the first scythe has returned.
Performing a stealth strike with the Subduction Slicer will create a pillar of fire on enemy hits, dealing 120% of the weapon's damage. Only one pillar of fire can exist for each throw.

wikiTooltip: Enemies release electric sparks on hit
intro: The Submarine Shocker is a Hardmode shortsword that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When swung, it releases electric sparks upon enemy hits. The sparks linger for 1 second, can pierce 2 enemies, and can hit up to 5 times before dissipating. They are affected by gravity, cannot pass through tiles, and they deal 70% of the weapon's damage.

intro: The Subsuming Vortex is a craftable post-Moon Lord spell tome.
All of its attacks inflict the Miracle Blight debuff.

알맞은 바이옴에 하나씩만 설치할 수 있다

Acid Rockets stick to enemies and explode into toxic mist after a short delay
intro: The Sulphuric Acid Cannon is a post-Moon Lord launcher that is dropped by the Mauler miniboss in the Tier 3 Acid Rain. When used, it slowly fires acid rockets which home in on enemies and stick to them. After being stuck to an enemy for 3.33 seconds, the acid rocket creates a large sulphuric mist explosion, dealing 200% base damage and inflicting the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff. If Cluster Rockets are used, the explosion instead deals 150% base damage and spawns 3 acid droplets that deal 15% base damage and inflict Irradiated.

Sulphuric Scales are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by various enemies in the Acid Rain event after the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated. They are used to craft several weapons themed around the Acid Rain, as well as the Sulphurous armor.
Sulphuric Treasure is a grab bag obtained from breaking Sulphurous Pots. It contains several items that typically drop from pots.

wikiTooltip: 6% increased rogue damage

intro: The Sulphurous Crate is a Pre-Hardmode fishing crate that can only be hooked in the Sulphurous Sea. The crate contains several items based originally in the Sulphurous Sea and serves as an alternative way of getting these items through fishing. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Hydrothermal Crate.

wikiTooltip: Reach: 25 tiles
Speed: 32
Infinite throw duration
Occasionally releases a ring of colored bubbles
The yoyo powers up after touching a green bubble
intro: The Sulphurous Grabber is a Hardmode yoyo that is dropped by Sulphurous Skaters. While deployed, it fires three bubbles in a triangular pattern in a random direction. The bubbles can be either green or purple. The bubbles do not pierce, can pass through tiles, and deal 50% of the weapon's damage. If the yoyo touches a green bubble, it will power up for 1.33 seconds and glow green, gaining increased speed and firing rate. Only the yoyo inflicts the Irradiated debuff on hit.

Grants underwater breathing

intro: Sulphurous Sand is a Pre-Hardmode block that composes most of the Sulphurous Sea biome, which spawns upon world generation. It is used to craft Seafood and the Ballistic Poison Bomb. It also can be obtained by opening Hydrothermal and Sulphurous Crates, and is dropped by Aquatic Scourge.
Sulphurous Sand Walls are background walls crafted from Sulphurous Sand.

Sulphurous Sandstone is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found in the Sulphurous Sea biome, which spawns upon world generation. It composes most of the lower portion of the biome and is incredibly common. It also can be obtained by opening Hydrothermal and Sulphurous Crates.
Sulphurous Sandstone Walls are background walls crafted from Sulphurous Sandstone.

intro: Sulphurous Shale is a Pre-Hardmode block that can be found at the bottom of the Sulphurous Sea biome and mostly in the Sulphuric Depths layer of the Abyss, which spawns upon world generation. It requires at least a Nightmare or Deathbringer Pickaxe to mine.
Sulphurous Shale Wall is a background wall crafted with Sulphurous Shale and is also found naturally in the first layer of the Abyss.

intro: The Sulphurskin Potion is a craftable Pre-Hardmode buff potion that can also be found in Rusty Chests. Upon consumption, it grants the Sulphurskin buff, which halves the build-up rate of Sulphurous Sea's poison water meter and reduces the effect of Sulphuric Poisoning by 1 damage per second.

Repeated summons increase its power
intro: The Sun Spirit Staff is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a Solar Spirit minion above the player's head that fires non-piercing yellow energy beams at nearby enemies once every 0.83 seconds. Unlike most minions, only one Solar Spirit can be summoned at a time.

wikiTooltip: Zooming at 60 miles per hour
intro: The Sunken Sailfish is a fishing catch caught in the Sunken Sea with a 15% chance. It is used for the crafting of the Soaring Potion and Seafood Dinner.

Move in the indicated direction while fishing to catch items

+10 fishing power

한 번에 최대 50개까지만 소환할 수 있습니다

intro: The Super Dummy is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoning item. When used with its primary function (left-click), it spawns a Super Dummy enemy. This enemy is nigh-invincible, with 9,999,999 health that it is constantly regenerating. It also cannot be killed by damage-over-time from inflicted debuffs. However, when used with its secondary function (right-click), it will remove all spawned Super Dummies.

Due to the Super Dummy enemy's high resilience and inability to harm the player (despite being an enemy), it is considered an improved alternative to the Target Dummy. It features several practical advantages to Target Dummies, including more accurate DPS numbers when using the DPS Meter or any of its successors, the ability for weapon projectiles to home in on it, and the ability for minions and sentries to target it.

은신 타격 시 현실의 근간 자체를 흔드는 폭발을 일으킵니다

intro: The Supernova is a craftable post-Moon Lord rogue bomb.

When used, it throws a smart bomb that travels a short distance before quickly homing in on the nearest enemy, or returning to the player if no target is found. On hit, the bomb charges up an explosion while pulling in enemies and sticking to bosses. The explosion's first hit does 100% base damage and decreases by 5% for every hit onward.
All saws inflict the Elemental Mix and Laceration debuffs while the bolts inflict Elemental Mix.

intro: The Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station is a craftable Hardmode fishing accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+50 fishing skill

source.title: Supreme Bait Tackle Box Fishing Station

intro: The Supreme Healing Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.
The Supreme Mana Potion is a craftable post-Moon Lord potion. Upon consumption, it restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff.

intro: The Surge Driver is a post-Moon Lord gun that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XS-01 Artemis and XS-03 Apollo have been defeated last.

wikiTooltip: JELLY BEAN
intro: The Suspicious Looking Jelly Bean is a Hardmode mount summoning item that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it summons a Squishy Bean mount that functions similarly to the Slimy Saddle. It moves horizontally at 40 mph and falls very fast with a terminal fall speed of 102 mph. However, it will not deal damage to enemies or bounce on them. Unlike the Slimy Saddle, this mount can negate fall damage.

wikiTooltip: Summons a Lil Lorde that provides light
'It lives!'
intro: The Suspicious Looking NO U is a light pet summoning item that is dropped by THE LORDE. It summons a miniature version of THE LORDE to follow the player which emits a relatively strong rainbow light. Equipping the pet while THE LORDE is alive causes the boss to constantly emit Exo Overload Beams, which normally only start occurring once THE LORDE reaches 1% health.

tooltip: 더 커다란 완전체의 일부분인 것처럼 보입니다
wikiTooltip: Looks like it may be part of a greater whole...
intro: Suspicious Scrap is a crafting material found in the Abandoned Research Facility and Abandoned Workshop variants of the Arsenal Labs in the Cavern layer. They are used to craft the SHPC.
Four Suspicious Scraps are required to make the SHPC, alongside the Prototype Plasma Drive which can be found in the Planetoid sky lab.

tooltip: 세갈래의 에너지 볼트를 발사하며 광선으로 분열된 뒤 커서의 위치로 날아갑니다

intro: The Svantechnical is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer gun. When used, it fires three streams of charged energy bolts in a sine-wave pattern. Each bolt splits off into 2 small bolts in a wide backwards spread upon hitting an enemy or tile, before turning around after travelling a small distance. Small bolts deal 30% base damage, pierce infinitely and can hit enemies both upon splitting and turning around. Small bolts also track the cursor until they come within 5-tile range of the cursor in which they begin to curve and drift in one direction before vanishing. Both bolts have an innate 200 armor penetration.

wikiTooltip: Fires multiple rainbow beam swords that rain from the sky
Sword swarm
intro: The Swordsplosion is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword. When used, it fires several beam swords that converge on the cursor and causes even more beam swords to rain from the sky when swung. It rotates between firing different colored beam swords. Red and blue swords are able to pass through tiles, while purple and green ones cannot.

wikiTooltip: Casts a bouncing beam that splits when enemies are near it
'Also known as the Karma Staff!'
intro: The Sylvestaff is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer wand. When used, it fires a beam with a pink, white, and blue trail that bounces off tiles in quick succession and pierces infinitely. When enemies are nearby, the beam will emit small splitting beams that are aimed towards the nearest enemy and do not bounce on tiles.

intro: The System Bane is a craftable Hardmode spiky ball. When used, the player throws a gravity-affected electric machine that continuously deals damage to targets that come into contact with it. Occasionally if there's a target nearby, the device releases lightning to triple-strike it. Up to 5 machines can be out at a time.
Performing a stealth strike with the System Bane causes the resulting machine to emit a large pulsating electric field that releases lightning into enemies within it.

intro: The Tactical Plague Engine is a craftable post-Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a Plague Jet minion that fires and consumes bullets. It will attempt to fire from above, and will occasionally fire homing missiles instead of bullets, which inflict the Plague debuff and deal 150% of the weapon's base damage. Additionally, it will always align itself horizontally when idle.

intro: The Tainted Cloudberry is a craftable post-Moon Lord permanent power-up item that increases the player's maximum life, as an extension to Life Fruits. There are 3 other items that function identically to this: the Sanguine Tangerine, the Miracle Fruit, and the Sacred Strawberry. It is the third of these to be obtainable following boss progression. It can only be used once, and after that the player must use one of the remaining fruit to increase their maximum life. With all of these, the player's maximum life is capped at 600.

Performing a stealth strike with the Tarragon Throwing Dart causes a circle of eight thorns to encircle enemies on the resulting hit. Each thorn deals 25% of the dart's damage.

intro: Tarragon Wings are a craftable post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

intro: The Tau Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. It is one of the final upgrades to the Magna Cannon and Opal Striker, alongside the Ontological Despoiler. While holding, the player channels a glowing blue orb at the tip of the cannon which increases in charge level every second, as indicated by a pulse. Attack types are different based on how long the cannon has been held for when releasing:
Releasing prior to charging for one second immediately cancels out the weapon and performs no attack.

The Tectonic Truncator is a craftable Hardmode axe. When swung, it produces light particles. On strike, it inflicts the Hellfire debuff.

intro: The Telluric Glare is a post-Moon Lord bow that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it rapidly fires volleys of arrows and radiant arrows in a sequential stream, with slight variation in their position of origin. Wooden Arrows are all converted into radiant greatarrows that deal 120% base damage. Radiant arrows inflict the Holy Flames debuff, can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely but will quickly disappear upon striking an enemy.

intro: The Temporal Umbrella is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. When used, it summons a Magic Hat on the player's head which in turn summons five tools, including an arrow, axe, hammer, rifle, and an umbrella. There can only be one Magic Hat and each of the tools at a time. It requires 5 minion slots to use.

'Inundatio ex Laminis'
intro: The Tenebreus Tides is a craftable Hardmode spear. When swung, it launches a water spear that pierces four times and deals 75% of the spear's damage. When an enemy is struck with the spear or its main projectile, two swords or spears appear around the struck target. The secondary wave of swords and spears deal 40% damage of the projectile that spawned them, and will disappear and return to attack an enemy once more before disappearing, similarly to the Influx Waver.

tooltip: 3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다

50% decreased Cold debuff damage
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Tequila is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Tequila debuff, which increases the damage per second of player-inflicted electric-related debuffs by 50% but decreases the damage per second of player-inflicted cold-related debuffs by 50%.
While the effects of the Tequila debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

intro: Tequila Sunrise is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Tequila Sunrise debuff, which greatly accelerates natural life regeneration after a debuff expires, but increases the damage per second of debuffs inflicted onto the player by 50%.
While the effects of the Tequila Sunrise debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

tooltip: 오염 지대에서 사용 시 하이브 마인드를 소환합니다

wikiTooltip: Summons the Hive Mind when used in the Corruption
Despawns outside the Corruption
Not consumable
'An exquisitely hideous tumor for those diseased in the head.'
intro: The Teratoma is a craftable Pre-Hardmode boss-summoning item that is used to summon The Hive Mind. It can only be used in The Corruption or Underground Corruption. Note that the boss can also be summoned by killing a Hive Tumor, which spawns rarely in the Corruption.

tooltip: 보스 러시 모드를 활성화합니다. 다시 사용 시 보스 러시 모드가 비활성화됩니다
intro: Terminus is an event-summoning item that is used to start and cancel the Boss Rush event. It can only be obtained by finding it in the shrine in the 4th layer of the Abyss.

tooltip: 공격시 적을 추적하는 에너지 탄을 생성합니다
wikiTooltip: Heals the player on true melee hits

On hit, explodes and repeatedly slashes the target
'Linked to the essence of Terraria'
intro: The Terratomere is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that autoswings. When used, it fires 4 homing energy bolts that cause an explosion which deals 50% of the weapon's damage and also fires a short-range slash projectile after every swing. Both the blade and energy bolts create 3 light beam slashes that deal 40% of the weapon's damage on hit. The sword itself inflicts the Frozen debuff and heal the player for 2.5% of damage dealt.

wikiTooltip: Fires a terror beam that bounces off tiles
On every bounce it emits an explosion
intro: The Terror Blade is a post-Moon Lord broadsword that is dropped by Polterghast. On every swing, it fires a red terror beam that can bounce off tiles or pierce enemies a total of three times before exploding on the fourth impact. Large explosions will occur, on varying delays, at the locations that the beam bounced off of. An explosion also occurs at the first enemy the terror beam pierces. Each explosion deals 30% of the weapon's damage and can deal damage multiple times.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 여러번 공격하는 빠르고 거대한 발톱을 던집니다
wikiTooltip: Fires small wavering claws

intro: The Terror Talons are a craftable Hardmode rogue weapon. When used, they fire small and swift claws, alternating and creating a double sinewave like movement from the player towards the direction of the cursor. The claws do not pierce or go through tiles.

Performing a stealth strike with the Terror Talons will cause the next claw thrown to move very quickly forward, pierce up to four enemies, attack the same enemy five times, and deal 1.8x the weapon's base damage.

tooltip: 폭발하는 전기 광선을 발사하는 경량화된 에너지 대포
wikiTooltip: A lightweight energy cannon that blasts an intense electrical beam that explodes
The beam can arc to nearby targets
intro: The Tesla Cannon is a craftable post-Moon Lord magic gun. When used, it fires a large blue beam that creates a large dust explosion upon contact with a block or enemy. The beam will arc towards other nearby enemies on enemy hits.

자신이 받는 [cbuffplr:CalamityMod/StaticDischarge] 디버프의 지속 시간이 줄어듭니다

intro: The Teslastaff is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand. When used, it fires a straight beam of lightning which slowly tracks the cursor. Each hit increases the damage of the beam by 10%, up to a maximum of 500%. If the beam has not hit within 0.27 seconds of the previous hit, damage starts to decay at a rate of 60% per second. The beam pierces infinitely, passes through tiles, and inflicts the Electrified debuff.

Performing a stealth strike with The Atom Splitter will cause the resulting javelin to spawn 60 rainbow javelins that deal 30% damage each.

When used, the player holds the weapon out similarly to a wand, and a stream of burning meteors rain down from the sky in the direction of the cursor. The meteors inflict melee damage and can travel through tiles but do not pierce enemies. The meteors inflict the Dragonfire debuff for 3 seconds on contact. The weapon itself does not deal damage.

The Campfire, Exquisitely Stuffed, and Heart Lamp buffs

The Devourer Cart has a top running speed of 112 mph with an acceleration of 36 tiles/second2 (49 mph/second). Similar to other minecarts, the Devourer Cart is able to jump with a similar height and acceleration.

intro: The Cauldron is a craftable Pre-Hardmode magic weapon. When used, the player holds the cauldron overhead which lobs gravity-affected lava bombs towards the cursor. Upon impact with a tile or enemy, the lava bombs cause a small explosion that deals 66% of the weapon's damage as well as erupting into 3 smaller bombs. Small bombs deal 50% of the weapon's damage directly. The lava bombs and explosions inflict the On Fire! debuff.
Using the weapon while submerged in lava or while in The Underworld will reduce its mana usage by 80%.

It adds a sparkle effect to the character's hair, similarly to Leinfors' Luxury Shampoo. Sparkles slightly move towards any nearby chests within a 100x100 tile range around the player.

intro: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

At its base form, it grants 1% critical strike chance, 2.5% damage, 2% maximum health, 1.25% damage reduction, 2 defense, 2.5% movement speed, and 5% flight time. While the player's life regen is below zero, it also grants 1 life regen.

intro: The Dance of Light is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it rapidly summons four pairs of fast inaccurate light blades from a cone around the player towards the cursor's direction. Each pair of light blades will curve, converge, and home with each other and they pierce once and go through tiles. When the blades hit enemies up to 300 times, all nearby blades vanish, and a flash of light appears from above to damage all enemies in a large area. The flash of light deals 16,000 magic damage added by the damage of all blades that vanished, then divided by the number of enemies and will always critically hit.

Pressing right-click summons 3 darkened clones of the player in a triangle formation which follow the player. The clones always fire beams which deal 40% damage as the player swings the weapon, regardless of their health. Clones do not deal contact damage even whilst swinging the sword and will disappear into black smoke as the player stops holding the item. The clones copy the player's current appearance, allowing them to display armor, vanity items and accessories.

It also allows hooked items to remain hooked indefinitely and consumes common fish when hooked, granting the player Plenty Satisfied or Exquisitely Stuffed and immediately allowing a new item to be hooked. The color of the fishing line is randomized between blue and pink.

intro: The Elixir is a Pre-Hardmode potion that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 10 silver coins during odd moon phases. It acts identically to the Potion of Return. However, there is a 25% chance for the player to be inflicted with the Chaos State and Cursed debuffs and instead be teleported to the Forsaken Archive in the Dungeon, the Jungle Temple, or the lowest layer of the Abyss.

If the item is dropped and contacts a Town NPC, the item is consumed and the happiness of the targeted NPC is set to either a price factor of 50% or 175%, at an equal chance between either outcome. This effect lasts for 24 in-game hours.

Holding down the fire button will charge the weapon, narrowing the spread of the missiles while increasing their velocity and range. The weapon will become fully charged after 1.5 seconds, indicated by a sound effect and red flash, and it will instead fire a high-velocity plague nuke that causes a massive explosion on hit, dealing 1000% of the weapon's damage and releasing 20 homing plague bees.
The Hive missiles and nukes will spawn more bees if the player is wearing the Hive Pack.

wikiTooltip: Use to adopt a piggy for your town
intro: The Housing Contract is a consumable item that is sold by the Shady Salesman for 5 gold coins in Hardmode.

Upon use, the status message "The license teleports away to the piggy delivery service..." is displayed. Following this status message, a Town Piggy will move into an available house the next morning. The item may also be used when a Town Piggy is already present in the world, but it currently has no effect.

wikiTooltip: Releases electric mines outward that connect to each-other via arcs
intro: The Jailor is a post-Moon Lord ranged weapon that is dropped by the Exo Mechs after XF-09 Ares has been defeated last. When used, it fires an electric mine that decelerates to a stop after as it travels and pierces infinitely. The mine detects other mines in a 75-tile radius and forms a damaging electric arc between them. On hit, the damage of all mines and electric arcs that are connected are exponentially decreased, to a lower bound of 42.5% base damage.

intro: The Last Mourning is a craftable post-Moon Lord broadsword that is an upgrade to The Horseman's Blade. Upon striking an enemy, mourning skulls and flaming pumpkins will spawn from all directions off-screen and move in towards the enemy that was struck. Mourning skulls pierce four times and explode into two fire orbs upon their first hit. The sword and the mourning skulls inflict the Daybroken debuff while the fire orbs inflict the Hellfire debuff.

intro: The Maelstrom is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. When used, it slowly and accurately fires charged reaper sharks which inflict the Hadopelagic Pressure debuff and are not affected by gravity. Upon contact with enemies or solid tiles, the shark bursts into visual gores and a damaging water explosion.

At 7 charges, the sword creates a burst of 30 blood orbs and its charge is reset. Each blood orb collected reduces Potion Sickness cooldown by 0.33 seconds or increases natural life regeneration if the player does not have Potion Sickness.

intro: The Obliterator is a post-Moon Lord yoyo that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. While deployed, it is able to charge towards an enemy every 2 seconds, dealing 600% base damage. Counterweight hits can instantly trigger charges.

Performing a stealth strikes instead throws the scythe upwards before homing in towards enemies, causing a torrent of acid rain to spawn that deals continuous damage. The Old Reaper's stealth strike has a 50% damage modifier.

intro: The Oracle is a craftable post-Moon Lord yoyo. While deployed, it emits a yellow aura that constantly damages enemies within a 4-block radius and can pass through tiles. The aura effectively counts as the yoyo's hitbox (thus also dealing direct hits), despite being visually separate from the yoyo itself. On direct hits, the yoyo emits a lightning aura that damages nearby enemies, dealing 35% base damage per hit, or 80% base damage at maximum charge. The lightning aura's size and damage increase with every direct hit; the damage will continue to rise even after the aura stops growing, while the aura will grow to a max of 9.375 tiles. The aura shrinks and eventually dissipates when not doing direct hits. Once the the aura is larger than the yellow aura, it starts to fire 3 orbs in a triangular pattern in a random direction every 0.17 seconds. The orbs deal 100% base damage, pierce infinitely, and can pass through tiles. The yoyo itself can also pass through tiles. Both the yoyo and its aura inflict the Auric Rebuke debuff.

intro: The Sponge is a craftable post-Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. Durability depletes instead of health as the player takes damage equal to the amount of damage taken. Once all 120 shield durability is depleted, the barrier breaks and all effects are taken away.

Durability regenerates the same way as it is formed, requiring the player to not take damage for 8 seconds, causing it to regenerate at a rate of 12 durability per second. It can regenerate if the shield is partially or fully damaged, but will immediately be interrupted as the player takes damage.
