The flower can target and attack through tiles. Blossom orbs create a small explosion on enemy hits in the shape of a flower with three, four, or five petals in a randomized manner. Unlike most minions, only one set of Tundra Flame Blossoms can be summoned at a time.

wikiTooltip: Summons a Rimehound mount
intro: The Tundra Leash is a Pre-Hardmode mount summoning item that is dropped by Rimehounds. When used, it summons a Rimehound mount which acts similarly to the Basilisk summoned by the Ancient Horn but is much slower. The Rimehound is capable of moving at a speed of 38 mph horizontally and can reach 41 mph while moving vertically. Like the Basilisk, it can charge enemies and deals 50 damage upon contact. This damage can be increased by summoner bonuses.

tooltip: 적중 시 바람의 칼날이 뿜어져 나오는 자벨린을 발사합니다
바람의 칼날은 일정 확률로 적을 추적하며 치명타 시 반드시 추적하는 칼날로 변합니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 날아가며 궤적에 적을 추적하는 바람의 칼날을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a cloudy javelin that bursts into wind slashes on hit
Wind slashes occasionally home, and always home if the javelin crits
Stealth strikes are trailed by homing wind slashes
intro: The Turbulance is a craftable Pre-Hardmode non-consumable javelin. When used, it throws a javelin that releases 3 wind slashes in random directions upon collision with enemies or blocks, which have a 33% chance to home in on enemies. If the player performs a critical strike on the javelin itself, the wind slashes home in on nearby enemies and last for 4 seconds. Wind slashes deal 1/3 of the weapon's damage, do not pierce or pass through tiles, and inflict the Wind Chilled debuff.
Performing a stealth strike with the Turbulance will cause the next javelin thrown to periodically release trails of homing wind slashes as it travels, which deal 75% base damage.

The Twinkler is a Hardmode critter found within the Astral Infection that acts similarly to a Firefly. Twinklers can be caught with any type of Bug Net and may be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 40%.

wikiTooltip: The scales gleam like crystals
intro: The Twinkling Pollox is a fishing catch caught in the Astral Infection. It replaces Bass when fishing in the Astral Infection and can be used to craft Cooked Fish.
Twisting Nether is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that is dropped by Signus. It is used in the crafting of various weapons, the Statis' Void Sash and other items.

tooltip: 번개 화살은 비가 올때 더 빠르게 날아갑니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 투사체 속도가 증가하며 내려치는 번개가 많아집니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a lightning bolt to electrocute enemies
The lightning bolt travels faster while it is raining
Summons lightning from the sky on impact
Stealth strikes summon more lightning and travel faster
intro: The Twisting Thunder is a craftable post-Moon Lord dagger that is an upgrade to the Stormfront Razor and the final upgrade of the Cinquedea. It automatically throws a gravity-defying lightning bolt that does not pierce and travels faster while raining. When it hits an enemy, lightning strikes vertically from the sky which pierces indefinitely and can pass through tiles.
Performing a stealth strike with the Twisting Thunder will cause the next lightning bolt thrown to summon five strikes of lightning, in addition to the main bolt travelling much faster.

tooltip: 정령은 플레이어를 향해 이동한 뒤 적을 추적합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons water spirits while in use
These water spirits will home in on enemies after traveling towards the player

tooltip: 머스킷 총알을 적의 방어와 저항을 무시하는 .70구경 탄환을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Converts musket balls into .70 caliber sniper rounds that deal devastating damage
Critical hits summon a swarm of 6 additional bullets
'Pierce the heart of even the most heavily-armored foe'

intro: Uelibloom Bars are craftable post-Moon Lord bars. They are used to craft Uelibloom-themed items along with various other items.
Uelibloom Brick is a craftable post-Moon Lord brick crafted from Stone Blocks and Uelibloom Ore at an Ancient Manipulator. It is used in the crafting of Botanic furniture.
Uelibloom Brick Wall is a background wall crafted with Uelibloom Brick.

Uelibloom Ore is a post-Moon Lord ore that generates in Mud Blocks after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated. It is used to craft Uelibloom Bars at an Adamantite Forge or a Titanium Forge. It requires at least a Lunar Pickaxe to mine. It is also dropped by Bloom Slimes.

tooltip: 지속적으로 발사하면 플라즈마 볼트가 솔리드 광선으로 변화합니다
wikiTooltip: Casts a continuous stream of plasma bolts
Over time bolts power up into solid beams as you continue shooting
66% chance to save ammo
intro: Ultima is a craftable post-Moon Lord bow. Upon firing initially, it fires rainbow bolts which bounce off surfaces and do not pierce, firing in a manner parallel from the bow to the cursor with a random offset around the bow's sprite position. After 2.45 seconds, the chance of a bolt being replaced with a solid beam of light linearly increases until it reaches 100% chance at 7 seconds. The beams pierce all tiles and targets and deal 50% more damage than the bolts and inflict the Elemental Mix debuff. After 4.9 seconds, there is a 16.67% chance per frame that a rainbow dust spark is fired. The spark deals 33.33% damage, moves in a spiral and homes into enemies. Bolts and sparks create small explosions on hit, essentially doubling their damage output. This weapon has a 66% chance to not consume ammo when fired.

tooltip: 적을 공격시 폭발하며 적을 추적하는 불꽃을 내뿜습니다
wikiTooltip: Launches damaging homing sparks and explodes on enemy hits
intro: The Ultimus Cleaver is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by the Ravager. When swung, it fires five homing gravity-affected sparks. The sparks deal 10% of the weapon's damage and pierce once. Each spark lasts for 1.5 seconds before dissipating. Additionally, landing a true melee hit will cause an explosion that always deals the weapon's base damage.

tooltip: 적중 시 추가적으로 칼날을 생성하는 칼을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Summons liquidation blades that summon more blades on enemy hits
intro: The Ultra Liquidator is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Infernal Rift. When used, it fires a set of five rainbow blades that do not pierce or pass through tiles. Each blade that hits an enemy will spawn a secondary rainbow blade that flies off from a random approximate location on the corner of the screen. The secondary blades can pass through tiles but cannot pierce.

tooltip: 로그 공격력 +9% 및 로그 치명타 확률 +6%
wikiTooltip: 9% increased rogue damage and 6% increased rogue critical strike chance
20% increased movement speed

tooltip: 로그 공격력 +8% 및 로그 투사체 속도 +10%
wikiTooltip: 8% increased rogue damage and 10% increased rogue velocity
10% increased rogue damage and critical strike chance

tooltip: 인벤토리에서 이 아이템을 즐겨찾기하면 원하는 재련이 나올 확률이 증가합니다
이 효과는 장신구를 재련할 때만 적용됩니다
[c/aaaaaa:인벤토리에서 Shift + 마우스 우클릭으로 목표 재련을 변경할 수 있습니다]

wikiTooltip: Casts a swarm of homing spears

intro: The Unholy Core is a craftable Hardmode crafting material crafted from Infernal Suevite and Hellstone at a Hellforge. It is used in the crafting of various Brimstone-themed equipment and some Ashen-themed items.

wikiTooltip: The essence of profaned creatures
intro: Unholy Essence is a post-Moon Lord crafting material that drops from Impious Immolators, Profaned Energies, Scorn Eaters, Profaned Guardians, and Providence, the Profaned Goddess.

wikiTooltip: Increases defense by 3 while in the corruption
intro: The Unholy Tonic is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

tooltip: 커서 위치에 별을 쏟아져 내리게 하는 총알을 발사합니다
머스킷 총알을 별 부르미 총알로 변환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a spread of bullets from the gun and a flurry of stars to rain down on the cursor
Converts musket balls into starcaller shots that summon additional stars on enemy hits
'Let the starry sky fall upon your enemies'
intro: The Universal Genesis is a craftable post-Moon Lord gun which is an upgrade to the Conference Call. When used, it fires a tight spread of six bullets from the gun and five additional stars from above which are aimed towards the cursor. If Musket Balls are used as ammo, bullets are replaced with Starcaller Shots which spawn 1 additional star on hit. Initial stars deal 50% damage, while stars from the Starcaller Shots deal 65% damage.

tooltip: 필드가 전개된 후 여러 작은 광선이 소환되기 시작합니다
몇 초가 지난 뒤 거대한 레이저 광선이 필드 위치에 나타납니다
쿨타임 동안 이 아이템을 사용하려고 하면 합선이 발생해 사용자에게 피해를 입힙니다
[c/BB57FF:'이전 세대의 고대 유물, 당신의 명령을 기다리고 있다.']
[c/BB57FF:'이건 정말 안 좋은 생각이지만, 그게 당신의 것도 아니죠... 맞나요?']
wikiTooltip: Summons an energy field at the mouse cursor
After the field has been deployed, it begins to summon multiple small beams
After several seconds have passed, an enormous laser beam appears at the field's position
This effect has a 30 second cooldown
Attempting to use this item during the cooldown will cause it to short circuit and do damage to you
intro: The Universe Splitter is a craftable post-Moon Lord developer summon weapon. When used, a field appears at the player's cursor. After two seconds, a red laser sweeps down from the sky towards the field every second for six seconds, slightly randomized in the angle shot. One second after the sixth shot, a huge white laser beam strikes down from the sky towards the center of the field. All laser beams inflict the Electrified debuff and pierce infinitely through targets. The main beam cannot travel through solid tiles.
Unsafe Navystone Wall is a background wall that generates naturally in the Sunken Sea biome, alongside Unsafe Eutrophic Sand Wall. It can be removed using any hammer.

tooltip: <우클릭> 각 태초의 원소를 상징하는 인장 고리를 소환합니다
인장이 활성화된 상태에서 <좌클릭> 유지 시 무작위 인장을 소모하여 각각의 공격을 퍼붓습니다
인장 고리가 전개된 상태에서 다시 <우클릭> 시 비어 있는 모든 슬롯을 [c/DD84E8:뒤틀린] 인장으로 채웁니다
[c/DD84E8:뒤틀린] 인장은 정확도가 낮은 보라색 폭발탄을 자동으로 일제 사격합니다
wikiTooltip: Left Click to fire piercing needles
Right Click to summon a ring of sigils, each representing a primordial element
Hold Left Click with sigils available to consume random sigils, each unleashing an attack

tooltip: 주기적으로 적에게 전이되는 에너지를 방출하는 에너지장을 얻습니다
전이되는 에너지는 적 방어력의 상당 부분을 무시합니다
wikiTooltip: Gain an energy field that periodically zaps enemies with arcing energy
The arcing energy ignores a substantial amount of enemy defense
intro: The Unstable Granite Core is a Pre-Hardmode accessory found in the Granite Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 gold coins during a New Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, every 5 seconds the player gains an invisible energy field that will send out a blue arc lightning that can jump between up to 5 enemies within a 20-block radius. The lightning deals 15 typeless damage, has 25 armor penetration, and has a lifespan of 5 seconds.

tooltip: 철퇴를 던질 때 소용돌이를 함께 방출합니다
[c/5C95A1:'바다의 민족은 숙련된 사냥꾼이었으나 불필요한 폭력은 혐오했습니다.]
[c/5C95A1:불행히도 이웃 국가들은 야만적이었기에 그들은 도구를 전쟁용으로 개조해야만 했습니다.']
wikiTooltip: Throws out a whirlpool when released
intro: The Urchin Mace is a craftable Pre-Hardmode flail. When used, the player starts spinning the mace around, creating a whirlpool around themselves. If the player stops using the weapon after 1.83 or more seconds of spinning, they launch the whirlpool towards their mouse cursor, which pierces infinitely, deals double damage, and travels a short distance before popping, emitting glowing water dust in a large radius. The projectile can also travel through walls.

tooltip: 적에게 박혀 매우 강력한 독을 주입합니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 더 오랫동안 박혀 독 대미지를 입힙니다
스텔스 스트라이크로 박힌 침을 포함하여 총 7개의 침이 박히면 방사능 폭발을 일으킵니다
wikiTooltip: Sticks into enemies and injects an extremely potent poison
Sticking seven stingers in an enemy with a stealth strike stuck in it spawns an irradiated blast
intro: Urchin Stingers are Pre-Hardmode rogue weapons dropped by Aquatic Urchins. When used, they fire an urchin stinger that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. The urchin stinger pierces once and inflicts the Poisoned debuff on hit.
Performing a stealth strike with Urchin Stingers will cause the next stinger thrown to stick to an enemy for 10 seconds, periodically releasing bubbles in random directions that float upwards.

tooltip: 공격 시 아스트랄 발톱으로 적을 난도질합니다
피해를 입으면 재사용 대기시간이 감소하지만, 자신에게 아스트랄 감염 디버프를 부여합니다
비활성화 시 발톱이 반투명해지고 소리가 나지 않습니다
wikiTooltip: Enemy kills also reduce the cooldown
Swipes will be translucent and silent if visibility is disabled
intro: The Ursa Sergeant is a Hardmode accessory that is rarely fished up in the Astral Infection. While equipped, it will make an astral claw swipe that deals 325 flat typeless damage spawn when attacking enemies on a 5 second cooldown. Getting hit or killing an enemy reduces the cooldown by 3 seconds, but getting hit inflicts the player with Astral Infection debuff for 2.5 seconds.

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 식기 대신 강력한 도살자의 칼로 변환시킵니다
wikiTooltip: Fires utensils in bursts of three
Stealth strikes replace any utensil with a powerful butcher knife
'Space chickens, that is all'
intro: The Utensil Poker is a post-Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it fires a set of three random utensils.
Performing a stealth strike with the Utensil Poker will cause it to fire three butcher knives.

tooltip: 탈것에 탑승한 상태에서도 사용가능 한 긴 쿨타임의 돌진 능력을 부여합니다
이 돌진은 적에게 피해를 입지 않으며 적을 통과할 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Grants a dash with a long cooldown that works while mounted
This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
'Are soul-powered engines eco-friendly?'

tooltip: 탈것에 탑승한 상태에서도 사용가능 한 긴 쿨타임의 돌진 능력을 부여합니다
wikiTooltip: Grants a short dash with a long cooldown that works while mounted

tooltip: <스텔스 스트라이크> 적을 타격시 면도날 태풍을 소환합니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a homing reaper scythe
Stealth strikes spawn razorblade typhoons on enemy hits
intro: The Valediction is a post-Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by the Reaper Shark after Polterghast has been defeated. When used, it throws a high velocity reaper scythe that goes through tiles, pierces infinitely, homes on nearby enemies and inflicts the Hadopelagic Pressure debuff. It will return to the player after traveling a moderate distance or after hitting an enemy. When returning, the scythe dissipates into water particles.

Performing a stealth strike with the Valediction will deal 80% damage and spawn three typhoons on enemy hits that rapidly spin around the hit enemy and damage them. The typhoons deal half of the weapon's damage.

wikiTooltip: Casts a devastating ray of holy power
intro: The Valkyrie Ray is a craftable Hardmode wand. When used, it charges for half a second, then releases a straight magenta laser beam that fades out very shortly after. The beam pierces infinitely, cannot pass through tiles, and cannot be aimed after its release. The beam also partially ignores enemy immunity frames, and will strike enemies 2 times per shot if the beam remains in contact with them.

tooltip: 로그 치명타 적중 시 적의 체력을 흡수합니다
스텔스 스트라이크 적중 시 10초 동안 일반 공격의 치명타 확률 +15% 및 생명력 흡수량이 증가합니다
스텔스 스트라이크 적중 시 [cbuff:CalamityMod/HeavyBleeding] 및 [cbuff:CalamityMod/ArmorCrunch]를 입히고 피해량이 8% 증가합니다
'탈리스만을 소유하게 된 당신은 피를 갈망하게 됩니다'
wikiTooltip: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life
Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds
'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'
intro: The Vampiric Talisman is a craftable Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

Stealth strikes also increase critical strike chance by 15% and multiply lifesteal by 1.5x for non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds. A minimum of 92 damage (a crit of 46) must be dealt in order to receive any healing. The lifesteal effect is indicated by a red streak traveling from the hit enemy back to the player.

wikiTooltip: Fires a lance beam that splits multiple times as it travels
'Rend the cosmos asunder!'
intro: The Vanishing Point is a craftable post-Moon Lord spear. When used, it fires one gravity-affected cyan beam that splits into more beams with similar properties. All beams travel for a long distance before being affected by gravity.
Each usage of the Vanishing Point results in 162 orange beams at most, if the blue and pink beams do not prematurely dissipate on enemies. All beams do not pass through tiles.

tooltip: 적 적중 시 공간에 균열을 만듭니다
wikiTooltip: Pierces through tiles and homes in on enemies
Tears a rift in space on enemy hits
intro: Vanquisher Arrows are craftable post-Moon Lord arrows. They appear as pink or magenta colors, can pass through tiles and aggressively seek the closest target within 4 tiles of range, inflicting the God Slayer Inferno debuff. They can pierce once, dealing 40% on the initial hit and full damage on the second hit. Upon expiring, they spawn void slash effects which are purely visual.

tooltip: 넉백이 강한 바람의 파동을 원형으로 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Casts a circular spread of wind waves with high knockback

tooltip: 충돌 시 별 파편으로 부서지며 스타버스트를 생성하는 창을 던집니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 거문고자리의 형상을 소환하여 광범위에 엄청난 피해를 입힙니다
<우클릭> 시 스타버스트 20개를 소모하여 스텔스 게이지와 상관없이 즉시 스텔스 스트라이크를 발동합니다
이 공격은 모든 별 파편을 불러모아 타격당한 적을 공격하며 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Voidfrost]를 부여합니다
베가로 스타버스트를 소모하면 로그 갑옷 없이도 10초간 스텔스 기능을 사용할 수 있습니다
'이해받지 못한 천재... 혹은 광인의 마지막 노래'
wikiTooltip: Throws a spear that shatters into star fragments on impact and generates Starbursts
Stealth strike conjure an image of Lyra to deal immense damage in an area
Consuming Starbursts with Vega allows using stealth for 10 seconds, even without rogue armor
'The final song of a misunderstood genius... or just a madman'
intro: The Vega is a craftable post-Moon Lord javelin. It throws a rapid stratus spear that breaks upon hitting a tile and explodes upon striking an enemy, releasing 4 stratus stars that inflict Voidfrost. These stars can pierce for a short amount of time and the explosion from the spear will not be triggered if the spear doesn't strike an enemy.
Performing a stealth strike with the Vega will summon a static constellation which damages enemies that touch it.

wikiTooltip: Casts intense bolts of hellish power that explode into skulls
intro: The Vehemence is a post-Moon Lord wand that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. It fires a high-velocity hellish bolt that explodes into 18 skull clouds upon contact with enemies or tiles which deal 11% of the weapon's damage.

tooltip: 타일에 달라붙어 폭발하는 피의 공을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a blood ball that sticks to tiles and explodes
intro: The Vein Burster is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by The Perforators. When swung, it fires a blood ball that is affected by gravity and sticks to any tile that it contacts. After sticking onto a tile for 4 seconds or upon hitting an enemy, it explodes, dealing 100% base damage to all enemies in an extremely small radius. Both the weapon and blood balls inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

tooltip: 로그 투사체가 날아가는 동안 커서 위에서 복제본을 소환합니다
스텔스 스트라이크 사용 시 적을 추적하는 코즈밀라이트 칼날 고리를 방출합니다
wikiTooltip: 10% increased rogue damage
Rogue projectiles summon a clone from above the cursor
Stealth strikes unleash a ring of seeking cosmilite knives
'You'll never be alone, no matter where you go'
intro: The Venerated Locket is a post-Moon Lord rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 10 platinum coins after The Devourer of Gods has been defeated. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+10% rogue damage

wikiTooltip: Summons a sun spirit to protect you
Repeated summons eclipse the spirit and increase its power
intro: The Vengeful Sun Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Sun Spirit Staff. When used, it summons a Vengeful Solar Spirit above the player's head that fires yellow non-piercing beams at nearby enemies. Unlike most minions, only one Vengeful Solar Spirit can be summoned at a time.

tooltip: 폭발하며 불과 용암 파편을 흩뿌리는 지옥의 삼지창을 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Casts an infernal trident that erupts into a gigantic explosion of fire and magma shards
Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage
intro: The Venusian Trident is a craftable post-Moon Lord wand and the direct upgrade to the Inferno Fork. When used, it fires an infernal trident that causes a very large explosion upon hitting a tile or an enemy, releasing 4-9 flaming shards that fall to the ground and deal 2% of the weapon's damage. The tridents, explosions, and flaming shards inflict the Daybroken debuff, and always critically strike. Each 1% of critical strike chance the weapon would receive instead increases critical strike damage by 2%, with the total critical strike damage being listed in the item's tooltip.

tooltip: 적중 시 적에게 표식을 남긴 뒤 추가 피해를 입힙니다
추가 피해는 적을 적중 시킨 횟수에 비례하여 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: Marks enemies on hit, dealing extra damage after a short time
This damage stacks based on how many bolts hit the enemy
'There is no escape...'
intro: Verium Bolts are craftable Hardmode arrows. When hitting enemies, it marks them, causing the enemy to emit star particles for 1.5 seconds before exploding, dealing additional flat damage. The explosion damage can be increased if additional Verium Bolts hit the target within the 1.5 second window. Only one mark can be active on any enemy at a time.

tooltip: 나무 화살을 벽에 미끄러지는 볼트로 변환합니다
wikiTooltip: Fires a tight column of three arrows
Converts wooden arrows into sliding energy bolts
intro: The Vernal Bolter is a craftable Hardmode bow that is a direct upgrade to the Lunarian Bow. If there are enemies nearby, each outer orb will fire one electric beam at them consecutively that ignores immunity frames but cannot target enemies through tiles. The large orb, smaller orbs, and beams inflict the Auric Rebuke debuff.

After exhausting the entire magazine, the gun charges up before unleashing a massive abyssal fire beam for 8.33 seconds that inflicts Whispering Death and Demonic Flames before having to reload again, repeating the process. The damage of the beam and its Demonic Flames scales based on how many prior shots hit an enemy, up to 250% base damage and 5000 damage per second. The gun has a 66% chance to not consume ammo.

It is also dropped by enemies that spawn in the lower layers of the Abyss. It is used in the crafting of various Abyss-themed equipment, Hadal Stew, and the Frostcrush Valari.

wikiTooltip: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies
Maximum damage boost is 1.15x, minimum damage boost is 0.85x
Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you
Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
intro: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode-exclusive post-Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%. Additionally, up to 7 enemies that are close to the player are constantly damaged and repelled by a blazing aura around the player; however, there is a damage penalty for hitting multiple enemies at once. This aura's damage gets larger the closer the enemy is and the longer they stay near the player, taking 5 seconds to reach maximum power and dealing up to 3x damage based on distance.

wikiTooltip: Summons a celestial fist to punch enemies for you

tooltip: 주변 적들에게 고속 수압 포를 발사합니다

wikiTooltip: Throws a bomb which explodes into a agonizingly forceful shockwave
Stealth strikes emit absurdly powerful shockwaves
intro: The Wave Pounder is a craftable post-Moon Lord bomb. When used, it throws a gravity-affected bomb that sticks onto solid tiles for 3 seconds or until a target is struck before it explodes. When it explodes, a large shockwave is formed along with cosmetic cloud particles, continuously dealing damage for a short time.
Performing a stealth strike with the Wave Pounder causes the resulting explosion to dramatically increase in size, allowing it to shake the screen.

wikiTooltip: Throws a spear that bounces a lot
Stealth strikes throw three high speed spears
intro: The Wave Skipper is a craftable Hardmode javelin that is an upgraded version of the Scourge of the Desert. When used it will throw a Wave Skipper that will bounce five times before disappearing.
Performing a stealth strike with the Wave Skipper will cause three javelins to be thrown instead of one. The three javelins have slightly higher velocity.

wikiTooltip: Casts a deluge of inaccurate water bolts
intro: The Waywasher is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is sold by the Sea King for 2 gold coins. When used, it rapidly fires inaccurate water bolts that emit water drips as they travel, and can pierce once before dissipating on the second.

tooltip: 적을 거미줄로 묶어 느리게 만드는 거미줄 공을 던집니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes slow enemies down longer
intro: The Web Ball is a craftable consumable Pre-Hardmode spiky ball. It throws a gravity affected web-covered ball that inflicts the Webbed debuff onto enemies for half a second, slowing their movement speed.
Performing a stealth strike with the Web Ball causes the next ball thrown to inflict Webbed for 2 seconds instead of half a second.

tooltip: 설치 후 <우클릭> 시 이동 속도, 비행 시간, 가속도가 10% 증가합니다
wikiTooltip: This cannot be stacked with other candle buffs
'The floating flame seems to uplift your very spirit'
intro: The Weightless Candle is a post-Moon Lord furniture item that is sold by the Wizard for 25 gold coins after Moon Lord has been defeated. It emits light and right-clicking the placed candle grants the Limber buff, which increases movement speed, flight time, and horizontal movement acceleration by 10%.
This buff lasts permanently and persists after death, but will be overridden if Resilience, Spite, or Vigor are applied or the player cancels the buff.

tooltip: 들고 있는 무기 종류에 따라 피해량이 -15% 에서 15% 사이로 증가합니다
무기 종류에 따라 개별로 피해량이 증가합니다
한 종류의 무기를 오래 들고 있으면 증가한 피해량이 점차 감소하며 완전히 사라지는 데 10초가 걸립니다
다른 종류의 무기를 들면 피해량이 다시 증가하며 최대치까지 5초가 걸립니다
3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: Provides between -15% and 15% damage to the held weapon's class
Each class tracks this boost individually
This boost lowers the longer you hold weapons of the same class, taking 10 seconds to fully decay
This boost recharges when holding weapons of a different class, taking 5 seconds to fully recharge
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: Whiskey is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Whiskey debuff, which increases the damage of all classes by 15%, but holding a weapon decreases the held weapon's class damage linearly until it reaches -15% after 10 consecutive seconds of holding the item. Holding a weapon of a different class recovers the damage boost of all other classes, being able to revert linearly from -15% to +15% in 5 seconds.
While the effects of the Whiskey debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff, and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.
White Pearl Pile is a craftable Pre-Hardmode block.

tooltip: 얼어붙은 동굴 내부의 실험실 방향으로 빠르게 이동합니다
적에게 가까이 있을수록 비행 시간을 회복합니다
3가지 이상의 서로 다른 술을 마시는 것은 간에 해로울 수 있습니다
wikiTooltip: You regain flight time the closer you are to an enemy
50% reduced flight time
Drinking more than 3 different alcohols might not end well with your liver
intro: White Wine is a craftable Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the White Wine debuff which causes the player to gradually restore flight time when an enemy is within 46.25 tiles of the player, restoring more while the closer to the enemy, up to a maximum of 0.66 seconds of flight time per second while an enemy is within 6.25 tiles of the player. However, the player's flight time is decreased by 50%.
While the effects of the White Wine debuff are mostly beneficial, it is still considered a debuff and therefore cannot be removed by right-clicking the icon.

tooltip: 커서 위치로 잠시 후 빛나는 마법 급류병을 던집니다
빛나는 상태로 적중한 병은 병의 위치로 모여드는 4발의 물 창을 뿜어냅니다
병이 적에게 적중하거나 너무 멀어지면 소유자에게 되돌아옵니다
<스텔스 스트라이크> 6발의 물 창을 생성하고 플레이어를 치유하며 적을 밀쳐내는 급류 소용돌이를 소환합니다
소용돌이에 들어간 아군은 치유 효과를 두 배 더 오래 받습니다
wikiTooltip: Throws a flask of magic white water at the cursor that glows after a short while
Flasks that hit enemies while glowing release four water spears that converge back on the flask's position

Allies that enter the vortex will heal for twice as long
intro: The Whitewater is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When used, it throws a whitewater flask that follows the cursor. Hitting an enemy with the flask causes it to burst into 4 water spears before returning to the player. Water spears turn around and return to the hit location after a short amount of time.

Performing a stealth strike with the Whitewater causes it to deal 90% damage and summon 6 water spears on hit instead of 4, and create a swirling whitewater vortex after returning to the player which deals heavy knockback to enemies and heals players every 0.33 seconds while they are inside the vortex. The healing persists for 5 seconds after leaving the aura, 10 seconds if the vortex was spawned by another player.

tooltip: 충전하여 불을 내뿜고 적을 추적하는 산불씨 2개를 함께 발사합니다
wikiTooltip: Charges up to emit a stream of energized flames and pairs of homing wildfire flares
Uses gel for ammo
50% chance to save ammo
intro: The Wildfire Bloom is a craftable Hardmode flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a long burst of green flames at a moderate range. Each flame pierces three times, is unaffected by liquids, and cannot pass through tiles. It additionally fires pairs of homing terra flares.

wikiTooltip: Fires cyclones that suck enemies in
intro: The Wind Blade is a craftable Pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a wind cyclone toward the cursor that deals 60% base damage, pierces once and drags non-boss enemies nearby toward it. The cyclone can pass through blocks for a short time before colliding and inflicts the Wind Chilled debuff.

tooltip: 플레이어 주변을 머무는 윙맨 2기를 소환하여 커서 위치로 광선을 발사합니다
윙맨이 완전히 가동된 상태에선 수류탄의 쿨타임이 감소합니다
wikiTooltip: Spawns two Wingmen which orbit you and fire lasers at your cursor
Grenades have a cooldown which is shortened if the Wingmen are fully revved up
intro: The Wingman is a Hardmode magic gun that is dropped by Martian Engineers during the Martian Madness event. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it summons two Wingmen to the sides of the player perpendicular to the direction of the cursor, that each switch sides and fire lasers towards the cursor that travel through tiles and pierce once. The Wingmen gradually increase in firing rate and laser velocity the longer it is held for, reaching a full speed of 6 lasers per second after 6 shots. As the Wingmen are in use, the player's arms will move along with them. Wingmen will remain active even if the player runs out of mana but will not fire anything until mana is replenished and will despawn as soon as the player stops holding left click.

When used with its secondary fire (right-click) while the Wingmen are in use will consume 40 mana per Wingman and cause them to fire high-deceleration grenades towards the cursor which travel through tiles with 130% velocity and explode on collision with enemies or after 1.6 seconds, dealing 600% damage to all enemies in a 7.5-tile radius, but lose 20% damage per hit. Grenades have a 1.5-second cooldown between firing, which is then reduced up to 0.58 seconds as the Wingmen fully charge. Charging up Wingmen also increases the initial speed of grenades, allowing them to reach farther before slowing to a halt.

wikiTooltip: Allows flight and slow fall
Flight time: 6 seconds
'Resplendent to the very end'
intro: The Wings of Rebirth are a post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory that are dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

wikiTooltip: Fires a stream of ice orbs and a barrage of ice shards towards the cursor
'The pages are freezing to the touch'

tooltip: 머리 위에 [cbuff:CalamityMod/Plague]를 입히는 네 송이의 썩어가는 꽃을 소환합니다
intro: The Wither Blossoms Staff is a craftable Hardmode summon weapon that is an upgrade to the Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff. When used, it summons up to four dark-colored flowers that orbit around the player, and fire homing bolts at nearby targets. The bolts travel through terrain, disappearing shortly after hitting an enemy and inflicting the Plague debuff. Each flower consumes half a minion slot.

tooltip: 빠르게 적을 추적하여 날아가며 궤적에 불길을 남기는 창을 던집니다
wikiTooltip: Stealth strikes create an eruption of cinders on hit
intro: The Wrathwing is a post-Moon Lord javelin that is dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When used, it throws a fiery javelin which homes in on enemies while releasing gravity-affected fireballs as it travels, which explode violently on contact. The javelin also inflicts the Dragonfire debuff.
Performing a stealth strike with the Wrathwing will cause it to erupt into eleven gravity-affected fireballs on enemy hits.

tooltip: 이 새총의 성능은 장착 중인 갈고리에 비례합니다
갈고리에 특수 효과가 있다면 새총에도 해당 효과가 적용됩니다

intro: The Wulfrum Acrobatics Pack is a craftable Pre-Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+8% movement speed

intro: The Wulfrum Battery is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum enemies. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+7% summon damage

tooltip: 울프럼 조각 또는 은화를 탄약으로 사용합니다
멀리 조준하면 공격력은 감소하지만 분산도를 줄일 수 있습니다
[c/83B87E:실제로 울프럼 기계가 망가지면 총알로 재활용되는일도 흔하다고 한다']
wikiTooltip: Consumes wulfrum scrap or silver coins to fire
The shot's spread can be diminished by aiming further away, at the cost of less damage
Ignores 3 points of enemy Defense
intro: The Wulfrum Blunderbuss is a craftable pre-Hardmode ranged weapon which uses Wulfrum Metal Scraps or Silver Coins as ammunition. When used, it fires a spread of six scrap bullets in a manner similar to a shotgun - the farther the cursor is from the gun, the tighter the spread but the lower its damage. This linearly scales up to a maximum of 28.75 or more tiles away, in which the spread decreases by 66.67% but damage also decreases by 20%. The player is required to reload and consume ammo after every 30 shots. Bullets have an innate 3 armor penetration.

tooltip: 낚시 중 표시된 방향으로 움직여 아이템을 낚으세요
실수 없이 오래 버틸수록 낚싯대가 강화되어 속도가 빨라집니다
'어군 탐지기가 설치되어 있어야 하는데, 자신을 향할 때만 삐 소리가 나네요...'
wikiTooltip: Provides a fishing minigame
Hold movement inputs in the indicated directions while fishing to catch items
The rod empowers the longer you go without a mistake, speeding it up
'There's supposed to be a fish finder installed, but it only beeps when you point it at yourself...'
intro: The Wulfrum Bobber is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing accessory. While equipped, bobbers emit a blue pulse ring in a random cardinal direction every second while fishing conditions are valid. The player instantly performs a catch upon successfully holding a directional input in the direction the pulse is moving within 0.25 seconds for four consecutive times. Each successful catch reduces the time taken for each pulse ring to show up by 0.083 seconds, up to a minimum of 0.583 seconds after five successful catches in a row. Failing to perform an input in time, or holding the button for too long, resets any progress and prevents the player from catching.

tooltip: 당신을 위해 싸워줄 울프럼 로봇을 소환합니다

과충전된 로봇은 체력 재생 0.5와 방어력 3을 제공합니다
다른 플레이어에게 커서를 올려놓으면 치료할 수 있습니다

intro: The Wulfrum Controller is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

tooltip: 작은 터널을 파내기 위해 허술한 굴착 장치를 던집니다

wikiTooltip: Throws a rickety mining contraption to dig out a small tunnel
The turtle scales with your pickaxe power
intro: Wulfrum Digging Turtles are craftable Pre-Hardmode consumable tools. When used, the player throws a gravity-affected digging turtle which does not deal damage. Upon collision with a tile, it starts to break tiles in its path for up to 5.83 seconds before breaking. Upon breaking, it has a 50% chance to break into a Wulfrum Metal Scrap. The pickaxe power of the digging turtle is equivalent to the highest pickaxe power item the player has in their inventory, up to a maximum of 160. When right-clicked, all existing digging turtles instantly explode.

wikiTooltip: Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense
intro: The Wulfrum Drill is a craftable Pre-Hardmode drill that is capable of mining blocks up to Gold Ore / Platinum Ore. It has an innate 15 armor penetration.

<우클릭> 시 박힌 모든 단검을 자석처럼 끌어당겨 스텔스 게이지를 회복합니다

{| class="terraria lined"

Wulfrum Metal Scraps are Pre-Hardmode crafting materials that are dropped by Wulfrum enemies. They are used solely to craft the Wulfrum-tier items. They can also be used as ammunition for the Wulfrum Blunderbuss and Wulfrum Scaffold Kit.

wikiTooltip: 5% increased summon damage

intro: Wulfrum Panels are a craftable Pre-Hardmode block made with Stone Blocks and Wulfrum Metal Scrap at a Furnace.
Wulfrum Plating is a craftable block crafted from Stone Blocks and Wulfrum Metal Scraps at a Heavy Work Bench. It is used in the crafting of Wulfrum furniture.
Wulfrum Plating Wall is a background wall crafted from Wulfrum Plating.

tooltip: 울프럼 금속 조각과 울프럼 에너지 코어를 낚을 수 있습니다
'거의 작동하지 않는 수준이지만, 없는 것보다는 낫지...'
wikiTooltip: Can fish up Wulfrum Metal Scrap and Wulfrum Energy Cores
'This barely works, but it's better than nothing...'
intro: The Wulfrum Fishing Pole is a craftable Pre-Hardmode fishing pole. It has slightly higher fishing power than the Wood Fishing Pole. It has:
20% chance to catch 1-5 Wulfrum Metal Scraps.

tooltip: 주변 플레이어가 다음의 적을 상대할 때 보너스: 울프럼 로버
임시 금속 비계를 배치합니다. 울프럼 금속 조각을 사용하여 40개의 타일을 설치합니다

Scaffold needs to be adjacent to a solid tile to be placed down
'For when you need something built fast and don't need it to last.'
intro: The Wulfrum Scaffold Kit is a craftable Pre-Hardmode tool. When used, the player can place Wulfrum Pipes on air tiles that are orthogonally or diagonally adjacent to an existing solid tile. Clicking and dragging with the tool will draw a highlighted silhouette of where multiple pipes will be placed instantly upon letting go of the use button, similar to The Grand Design but with more free-form player-drawn shapes. It consumes Wulfrum Metal Scraps on use for every 40 pipes built; each potential pipe drawn by the highlight will count as being consumed, even before placement. Each pipe lasts for six seconds after it is placed.

tooltip: 적을 빠르고 강력하게 분해할 수 있습니다
적을 공격하면 가끔씩 울프럼 나사가 떨어지며 <우클릭> 주워서 던질 수 있습니다
던진 나사를 드라이버로 쳐내면 매우 빠르게 날아갑니다
wikiTooltip: Can be used to rapidly and royally screw over foes
Hit a thrown screw with the screwdriver to launch it forward at high speed

intro: The Wulfrum Screwdriver is a craftable Pre-Hardmode melee weapon. When used, the player holds the screwdriver in the direction of the cursor. The screwdriver hits faster as it continuously hits any targets. Each hit has a 20% chance to spawn a screw if one is not present. The screw initially hovers near the player and has no effect. When right-clicked with a screw available, the screw launches. The screw is gravity-affected, cannot pierce, and deal 150% of the weapon's damage. Striking the screw with the screwdriver launches the screw in the displayed path, increasing its damage from 150% to 650% of the weapon's damage. The path taken is partially aimed towards a nearby enemy within a 37.5-tile radius. Killing an enemy with the screw has a 50% chance to recover it.
