intro: The Acid Eel is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Acid Rain event. It swims around in the water in a wave-like motion and does not directly attack the player in any way. If it makes contacts with a nearby tile, it will slowly turn around and swim in a different direction. When outside of water, it will become motionless. The segments of the Acid Eel glow but do not emit light.

The Aero Slime is a Pre-Hardmode slime that spawns in Space after The Hive Mind or The Perforators have been defeated. It exists to drop Aerialite Ore, so that the player cannot use up all the ore available to them. Unlike other ore slimes, it can fly around freely.
Like most other slimes, the Aero Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

Upon placing down the Androomba item, a deactivated Androomba Pal is spawned, facing away from the player. The Androomba Pal can be right clicked by the player with any solution usable by the Clentaminator or Terraformer to change its appearance and activate it. Once activated, it will start moving back and forth while converting blocks around it in a 5-tile wide, 5 tile tall square based on which solution was put into it.
Androombas have a 20% chance to be caught if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in an Arsenal Lab.

The Anthozoan Crab is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea after the Aquatic Scourge has been defeated. It attacks by quickly running at the player and occasionally stopping to throw Crab Boulder at the player. It will leap backwards when the player gets too close to it.
The Aquatic Aberration is a boss servant that is summoned by Leviathan throughout the fight. It flies around the player and occasionally performs dashes straight at the player.

The Aquatic Urchin is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on underwater tiles in the Sulphurous Sea and in the first layer of the Abyss. It slowly rotates in a clockwise direction, though it will not move towards the player in any way.

CalamityMod/Archmage.ko: 하드모드에 등장하는 마법 관련 상인 NPC입니다.
intro: The Archmage is a Hardmode NPC vendor that will spawn once the following conditions have been met:
There is an empty house.
Cryogen has been defeated.
When threatened by enemies, he will defend himself with a Dark Ice Crystal.
environment: 유효한 빈 집 (세부 입주 조건 별도)

intro: The Aries is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface Astral Infection biome. It leaps quickly towards the player with both small and larger strides.

The Astraglomerate is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Astral Infection. It is stationary and attacks by spawning Glomerlings which attempt to fly into the player. It will also spawn Glomerlings when damaged.
The Astral Probe is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Astral Infection. It moves freely through the air and fires Pink Laser at the player, similarly to the Probes spawned by The Destroyer.

The Astral Slime is a Hardmode slime that spawns in the Astral Infection biome. After defeating Astrum Aureus, Astral Slimes will begin to drop the Abandoned Slime Staff and after defeating Astrum Deus they will start dropping Astral Ore.
Like most other slimes, the Astral Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

Astrum Aureus is a Hardmode boss fought in the Astral Infection biome. Defeating it grants access to new Astral-themed gear from various sources. It is intended to be fought around the time Plantera has been defeated.

Defeating Astrum Aureus is also a repeatable method to cause Astral Infection meteors to fall in the world, but only under the right conditions or if an Astral Infection meteor is not already present in the world.
spawn: Astrum Aureus does not spawn on its own and must be summoned using the Astral Chunk in the Astral Infection biome.

intro: Atlas is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface Astral Infection. It is initially idle, in which it stands still and occasionally turns around. If it notices the player, it will walk slowly towards them, attempting to jump over any obstacles in the way. When Atlas gets close enough to the player, it will uppercut them with its big arm and launch them far away, after which the attack will enter a short cooldown. If it loses sight of the player for long enough, it will return to its idle behavior.

The Aureus Spawn is a Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by Astrum Aureus. Upon initially spawning, it will attempt to fly into the player, exploding on contact to deal heavy damage. When its health is at 50%, it will pause briefly, start glowing bright blue, and rapidly charge at the player, additionally exploding upon death or after some time has passed. If an Aureus Spawn collides with Astrum Aureus in this state, it will explode instantly and damage Astrum Aureus for a small percentage of its maximum health.

In Death Mode, Aureus Spawn will fire Astral Crystal when not charging and will additionally explode into several Astral Laser upon death, with the spread being less numerous if directly killed by the player.

The Aurora Spirit is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome. It charges around at high speeds and attempts to ram the player for high damage, and once it leaves a small area around the player, it turns around to charge back again.

The Baby Cannonball Jellyfish is a critter that spawns in the 1st layer of the Abyss. It remains still underwater and on land similarly to a Baby Ghost Bell and emits a small amount of turquoise light. When killed, it explodes in a small radius, capable of damaging the player. It can be caught with any type of Bug Net.

Baby Cannonball Jellyfish can be inserted into Cannons and shot outwards as an aggressively homing projectile that passes through tiles and explodes upon impact with enemies. This explosion deals 300 damage and can hit multiple enemies.

The Baby Flak Crab is a critter that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea biome or dropped while shaking an Acidwood Tree. Similarly to its adult counterpart, it disguises itself as a geyser. If the player gets too close to one, it will reveal itself and run away until they are far enough from the player. Baby Flak Crabs can be caught with any type of Bug Net, and will rarely drop the Geyser Shell when captured.

The Baby Ghost Bell is a critter that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It is completely motionless both in water and on land. It can be caught with any type of Bug Net and can be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 20%.

There is a 5% chance for a Baby Ghost Bell that spawns to sparkle; sparkling Baby Ghost Bells will drop the Rusted Jingle Bell when caught with any type of Bug Net, a light pet that provides extra light while submerged.

CalamityMod/Bandit.ko: 로그 직업의 무기와 장신구를 판매하는 NPC입니다.
conditionsKo: 최초 입주 시 인벤토리 또는 개인 보관함에 백금화 1개 이상이 필요합니다. 이전에 입주한 적이 있다면 이 조건은 필요하지 않습니다.
intro: The Bandit is an NPC vendor that provides a plethora of weapons and accessories that tailor to the Rogue class.
The Bandit will move into an available NPC house if the following conditions have been met:
There is an empty house.
Skeletron has been defeated.
The player has at least 1 platinum coins in their inventory or personal storage items (such as the Piggy Bank). (This condition will not be required if the Bandit has moved in before on that world)
When threatened by enemies, they will defend themselves with the Cinquedea.
environment: 유효한 빈 집 (세부 입주 조건 별도)

intro: The Belching Coral is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea after the Aquatic Scourge has been defeated. It is stationary and will fire Belching Coral Spike at the player if they are directly above it.

The Blinded Angler is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It is initially passive and slowly swims back and forth. However, it will become aggressive if the player gets very close to it (~5 blocks away) and will try to swim towards the player to deal contact damage. It will become passive again if the player gets out of its range and dealing damage to it will not change its behavior.

The Bloatfish is an enemy that spawns in the 4th layer of the Abyss. While it is not aggressive and will not chase the player to attack them, it can still slightly hurt them via its low contact damage. It serves primarily as a meat-shield for other enemies, as it absorbs projectiles and gets larger as it takes damage, potentially reaching 3 times its original size.

The Bloom Slime is a post-Moon Lord slime that spawns in the cavern layer after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated. It exists to drop Uelibloom Ore, so that the player cannot use up all the ore available to them.
Like most other slimes, the Bloom Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.
Bohldohr is an enemy that spawns in the Jungle Temple. It rolls and bounces towards the player, similarly to an Angry Tumbler, making a sound of impact whenever it hits the ground.

The Box Jellyfish is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean and the 1st layer of the Abyss. It will remain passive until the player gets too close; it will then attempt to attack the player by darting towards them.
Brimlings are Hardmode boss servant enemies that are spawned by the Brimstone Elemental in Revengeance Mode or during the Boss Rush.
The Brimstone Elemental is a Hardmode boss that is fought in the Brimstone Crag. She cycles through 3 distinct behaviors, with varying levels of aggression and methods of attack.
spawn: The Brimstone Elemental does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her with the Charred Idol. She must be summoned in the Brimstone Crag.

CalamityMod/BrimstoneWitch.ko: 문 로드 이후 등장하는 상인 NPC입니다.
intro: The Brimstone Witch is a post-Moon Lord NPC vendor that will spawn once the following conditions have been met:
There is an empty house.
Supreme Witch, Calamitas has been defeated.
When threatened by enemies, she will defend herself with Brimstone Hellblasts.
environment: 유효한 빈 집 (세부 입주 조건 별도)

intro: The Calamitas Clone is a Hardmode boss that can be fought anywhere. She is a significant mid-Hardmode boss that is intended to be challenged at a similar point to Plantera.
spawn: The Calamitas Clone does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her with the Eye of Desolation anytime.

intro: The Calamity Eye is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Brimstone Crag. It acts like Demon Eyes, but will inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff on contact. When below half health, its speed and maneuverability increase.
In Death Mode, Calamity Eyes are capable of becoming intangible and passing through blocks for a brief period of time, in order to reach the player.
After Providence, the Profaned Goddess is defeated, its stats receive a significant boost, and starts dropping Bloodstone.
Calamity Eyes have a 20% chance to be caught in a group of 7 if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in Lava in the Brimstone Crag.

The Cannonball Jellyfish is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the first layer of the Abyss. It bobs up and down while underwater and emits a medium amount of turquoise light. When killed, it instead emits red light and halts for one second, then launches towards the player, exploding upon impact.
The Ceaseless Void is a post-Moon Lord boss. Defeating it provides the player with Dark Plasma, a crafting material used to craft the Cosmic Worm.
spawn: The Ceaseless Void does not spawn on its own and requires the player to summon it by using the Mark of Providence in the Dungeon.

intro: The Chaotic Puffer is an enemy that spawns in the 3rd layer of the Abyss. It slowly swims towards the player and inflicts the Brimstone Flames debuff on contact, while periodically puffing up every 5 seconds. While it is unable to damage the player while not puffed, if it hits the player or dies while puffed up, it creates a large brimstone explosion, which also hurts other enemies. It receives increased knockback upon being hit.

The Clad Crab is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the Surface at Day. It initially starts as passive, simply walking back and forth while occasionally pausing. If the player gets too close to it, it will aggro and crawl towards them, attempting to deal contact damage.

Clams are Pre-Hardmode enemies that spawn in the Sunken Sea. They are initially passive but become hostile after taking three hits. While hostile, they chase the player by making short leaps towards them.

If the Giant Clam is hostile, the spawn rate of Clams is drastically increased via the Clamity debuff, which causes them to become instantly aggressive as well. The Giant Clam also occasionally spawns three Clams while hostile.
Clams receive a boost to their stats when the world enters Hardmode.
Clams have a 6% chance to be caught in a group of 8 if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in an Sunken Sea.
The Cloud Elemental is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in space while it is raining.
She is one of the few enemies that can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer and its upgrades.

Cnidrion is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert. It will attempt to follow the player while firing a burst of either four or twelve water blasts every five seconds. In Death Mode, its firing rate doubles while below 33% health, and triples while below 10% health.
It can be detected with the Lifeform Analyzer and its upgrades.

The Colossal Squid is an enemy that spawns in the 3rd and 4th layers of the Abyss. When the player gets too close or hits it, it attempts to attack the player by ramming them and firing damaging Squid Ink Bomb, which burst into hovering Ink Poison Cloud. It also has the ability to latch onto the player and "eat" them, inflicting the Obstructed debuff, greatly reducing visibility and inflicting rapid damage until they are released.
It can be detected with the Lifeform Analyzer.

conditionsKo: 발광 버섯 지형에서 Decapodita Sprout를 사용해 소환합니다. 시간 제한은 없습니다.
intro: Crabulon is a Pre-Hardmode boss, intended to be fought after the Eye of Cthulhu.
spawn: Crabulon does not spawn naturally and the player is required to summon it by using the Decapodita Sprout in the Glowing Mushroom biome at any time.

intro: The Cragmaw Mire is a Hardmode mini boss that spawns during Tiers 2 and 3 of the Acid Rain event. It will always spawn underwater on the Sulphurous Sea's ocean floor.
The Cryo Slime is a Hardmode slime that spawns in the Ice biome after Cryogen and two mechanical bosses have been defeated. It exists as an alternative way to obtain Cryonic Ore aside from mining it.
Like most other slimes, the Cryo Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.
Cryogen is a Hardmode boss that can be fought in the Snow or Ice biomes which possesses many phases and features a multitude of projectiles.
Defeating Cryogen for the first time will free the Archmage, as well as generate Cryonic Ore in the Ice biome.
spawn: Cryogen does not spawn on its own and requires the player to summon it with a Cryo Key while in the Snow biome or Ice biome at any time.

intro: The Cryon is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome. It jumps and charges towards the player in an attempt to deal contact damage. Upon contact, it will inflict the Frostburn and Chilled debuffs.

The Cuttlefish is an enemy that spawns in the second layer of the Abyss. It stays invisible on the ground, waiting for the player to come near and attack them. Unlike most Abyss enemies, it does not become passive again even if the player did not hit it.

conditionsKo: 사막 또는 지하 사막에서 사막의 메달리온을 사용해 소환합니다. 자연적으로 등장하지 않습니다.
intro: The Desert Scourge is a Pre-Hardmode boss. It is intended to be one of the first bosses fought by the player and is considered to be the weakest of all of the bosses added by the Calamity Mod. It is intended to be fought after the King Slime, but it can still pose a considerable challenge to new players with only basic equipment.
spawn: The Desert Scourge does not spawn on its own and requires the player to summon it with the Desert Medallion in the Desert or Underground Desert.

intro: The Despair Stone is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Brimstone Crag. It moves by rolling and bouncing towards the player similarly to an Angry Tumbler, and each bounce causes it to emit red particles and make an impact sound.

Every 8 seconds, the Despair Stone will begin making a sound like a buzz saw, and it will accelerate to a high velocity and roll across the ground instead of bouncing, leaving aesthetic sparks behind as it rolls. In this buzz saw state, it is unable to turn around once it has started moving in a direction, however it gains the ability to climb up the sides of tiles to get to the player, its vertical velocity up walls being just as fast as its horizontal velocity along the ground. The buzz saw state lasts for a few seconds before it returns to its default behavior.
Its stats receive a significant boost and starts dropping Bloodstone after Providence, the Profaned Goddess is defeated.
Despair Stones have a 1% chance in pre-Hardmode and 0.33% chance in Hardmode to be caught in a group of 50 if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in Lava in the Brimstone Crag.
If the Divine Swine comes into contact with a Vile or Vicious Powder, it will transform back into a Piggy.
The Dragonfolly is a boss that is fought in the Jungle. Although it can be fought any time after the Lunatic Cultist is defeated, it is intended to be fought soon after defeating the Moon Lord.
spawn: The Dragonfolly does not spawn on its own and requires the player to summon it by using Exotic Pheromones in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.

intro: The Eidolist is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the 3rd and 4th layers of the Abyss after the Wall of Flesh or Calamitas Clone has been defeated. The Primordial Wyrm also summons them during its first four phases.

It hovers in the air motionlessly and does not attack the player until damaged. Once provoked, it will attempt to fly towards the player, passing through tiles and teleporting periodically. It will also release Lightning Orb and Ice Mist that emits image=Extra 35.gif. Both attacks are very similar to those of the Lunatic Cultist.
The lightning orb inflicts the Electrified debuff, and the ice mist and spikes inflict the Frozen and Chilled debuffs.

The Eutrophic Ray is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It is initially passive and sits on the ground motionless until attacked. When aggressive, it swiftly moves side to side to damage the player and is able to move through tiles while doing so.
Eutrophic Rays receive a boost to their stats when the world enters Hardmode.

The Fearless Goldfish Warrior is a rare Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface while it is raining. It resembles a walking Goldfish equipped with a Tin Helmet and Magic Dagger, both of which will be dropped when killed. It will slowly approach the player in an attempt to stab them with the dagger.

The Flak Crab is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during Tiers 2 and 3 of the Acid Rain event. It sits on the ground disguising itself as a geyser, which will fire Flak Shot at the player if they are directly above it. When it takes approximately 10 hits, it will start jumping away from the player about 3 times before turning back into a geyser afterwards.

The Frogfish is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. It stays invisible on the sand, waiting for the player to come near or hit it. When aggressive, it will swim towards the player to deal contact damage and inflict them with the Acid Venom debuff.

The Fusion Feeder is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert Astral Infection. It is the Astral variant of Sand Shark, although unlike Sand Sharks, it is unable to swim freely through blocks nor lunge at the player through them. Instead, it crawls along the tops of blocks or submerges shallowly, about 1 block deep, to approach the player. It is able to swim and lunge at the player if it is within a body of water. While lunging towards the player, it fires an Astral Meteor which is aimed towards the player.

The Gamma Slime is a post-Moon Lord slime that spawns during Tier 3 of the Acid Rain event. It jumps around erratically and will shoot 5 Flak Shot out in a star pattern while it is jumping. Occasionally, it will stop jumping and charge up a Gamma Ray and fire it upwards.
Like most other slimes, the Gamma Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

The Ghost Bell is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It is always passive even if attacked by the player. It bobs up and down in the water and will only do this if it is within water. However, despite being passive, its tentacle will deal contact damage and inflict the Electrified debuff. If it ends up outside of water, it will slowly fall to the ground and become motionless.
Ghost Bells receive a boost to their stats when the world enters Hardmode.
Ghost Bells have a 79% chance to be caught in a group of 2 if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in an Sunken Sea.

CalamityMod/GiantClam.ko: 가라앉은 바다의 미니보스입니다. 하드모드에서는 크게 강화됩니다.
conditionsKo: 데저트 스커지 처치 후 가라앉은 바다에서 드물게 등장합니다.
intro: The Giant Clam is a mini boss that rarely spawns in the Sunken Sea after defeating the Desert Scourge and is generally the first mini boss that the player will encounter. It receives a huge buff during Hardmode.
It will drop the Sea King if he is not already present in the world and the Desert Scourge has been defeated already.
It can be detected with the Lifeform Analyzer.

The Giant Squid is an enemy that spawns in the 3rd layer of the Abyss. It is initially passive, only becoming aggressive if the player attacks it or draws too close to it. Once hostile, it swims towards the player in short, frequent bursts, attempting to deal contact damage. Due to its height and vertical orientation, it can be a challenging enemy to maneuver around in the confined spaces of the Abyss.

The Gnasher is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on or near the surface of the Sulphurous Sea. It walks towards the player in an attempt to deal contact damage and inflict them with the Irradiated debuff.

The Great Sand Shark is a Hardmode mini boss that spawns after killing 10 Sand Sharks during a Sandstorm event after Plantera has been defeated. Alternatively, it can be summoned manually by using a Sandstorm's Core in a Desert at any time. While it swims through sand like the more common Sand Shark, it has a much greater variety of attacks on top of its increased size, speed, health and damage, making it a dangerous foe.

It typically performs horizontal leaps towards the player's direction, but it may also perform a vertical leap aiming straight for the player. When it leaps out of the sand, it may also cause an eruption of Sand Blast. It is also capable of redirecting itself while in a leap and executing a charge in midair. If the player strays too far away from it, it will perform a series of very long charges until it returns to their vicinity.

The Hadarian is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert Astral Infection. It behaves like a Vulture, initially waiting in place for a player to come near, then takes off once approached and begins hovering above the player, periodically swooping down to deal contact damage. It is much faster than the Vulture and is able to hover and pursue the player at a better pace.

The Heat Spirit is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Brimstone Crag. It charges around at high speeds and attempts to ram the player for high damage, and once it leaves a small area around the player, it turns around to charge back again.
The Hive Mind is a Pre-Hardmode boss, intended to be fought after the Eater of Worlds has been defeated.
It is the Corruption counterpart to The Perforators.
spawn: The Hive Mind is summoned by killing a Hive Tumor in The Corruption.
After its defeat, the player can craft a Teratoma to summon it instantly, at any time.

intro: The Hive Tumor is a rare Pre-Hardmode stationary enemy that spawns in The Corruption biome. When killed, it will summon The Hive Mind. The Hive Tumor has abnormally high life for Pre-Hardmode, ensuring that early players won't accidentally summon the boss.
The Hive Tumor can be prevented from spawning by using the Anti-Tumor Ointment.
The Hive Tumor can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer and its upgrades.

The Horrible Hog is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface during a Blood Moon after the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated, or summoned manually anywhere by using the Vile or Vicious Powder on a Piggy or Gold Piggy. If the Horrible Hog is not defeated by dawn (4:30 AM), it will burrow away and despawn.

It can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer or its upgrade, with a rarity of 4. It also requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.
Defeating the Horrible Hog allows the Shady Salesman to occasionally spawn at the start of each night.

The Ice Clasper is an uncommon Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow and Ice biomes. It flies around the player by firing three Dark Ice Crystal at them, afterwards it will attempt to ram them to deal contact damage and inflict them with Frostburn and Chilled debuffs. It will only deal contact damage when it rams into the player and is able to fly through tiles freely.
In Revengeance Mode, it will fire 4 ice crystals instead of 3 while in Death Mode, it will fire two sets of three ice crystals.
It can be detected with the Lifeform Analyzer.

The Impious Immolator is a post-Moon Lord enemy that spawns in The Hallow and The Underworld. Initially, it flies peacefully in one direction and turns around when it hits a block, similarly to the Sunskater. After being attacked, it will fly quickly towards the player while shooting bursts of fire that weakly home in on the player.

The Infernal Congealment is a Hardmode slime that spawns in the Brimstone Crag after the Brimstone Elemental has been defeated. It exists to drop Infernal Suevite, so that the player cannot use up all the ore available to them.
Its stats receive a significant boost and starts dropping Bloodstone after Providence, the Profaned Goddess is defeated.
Like most other slimes, the Infernal Congealment will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

The Irradiated Slime is a Hardmode slime that spawns during Tier 2 of the Acid Rain event. Rather than spawning like normal enemies, it gradually falls from the sky while the event is ongoing and can fall through platforms while doing so until it is at a similar height to the player.
Like most other slimes, the Irradiated Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

The Laserfish is an enemy that spawns in the 2nd and 3rd layers of the Abyss. It passively swims around but if the player gets too near or hits it, it will swim towards their direction and fire lasers at them. If hit, it will stay aggressive even if the player is far away from it.
The Luminous Corvina is an enemy that spawns in the second layer of the Abyss. It simply swims from side to side, never attempting to chase the player, even if they damage it.

The Mantis is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface Astral Infection. It chases the player on the ground, gaining speed if continuously running in one direction, slowing down when turning around, and hopping if it encounters a gap in the ground or a change in elevation. If the player is on the ground and close enough, it briefly stops and fires a short-ranged spinning Astral Scythe Ring projectile at them.

The Mantis Shrimp is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. It walks along the ground and chases the player. When hitting them, it will release an explosion which is purely visual and deals no damage.
After Plantera has been defeated, the Mantis Shrimp will occasionally drop the Mantis Claws, a claw-like melee weapon that mimics its main attack.

The Mauler is a post-Moon Lord mini boss that spawns during Tier 3 of the Acid Rain event. It swims towards the player and alternates between three attacks at random, each telegraphed by a different roar.
Quickly lunges at the player.
Fires three spreads of Sulphuric Acid Bubble that home in on the player after a delay.
Charging horizontally and firing a large barrage of Acid Droplet upwards, which home in on the player after a delay.
If it is out of the water for too long, it will start repeatedly using its charge attack until it lands back in water again.
It can be detected with the Lifeform Analyzer.

The Melter is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle after Golem has been defeated. Like most Bat enemies, it flies towards the player to deal contact damage and inflict them with the Plague debuff.

The Mirage Jelly is an enemy that spawns in the third layer of the Abyss. It slowly swims upward, ignoring all tiles in its way, and will occasionally teleport somewhere else on the screen upon taking damage. It never moves to directly attack the player, serving more as a living hazard than an enemy.

The Moray Eel is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean and the 1st layer of the Abyss. It swims around when not aggressive, but as soon as the player gets too near or hits it, it will swim in their direction and attempt to attack them. If hit, it will not go passive again, even if the player is far from it.

The Nova is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface Astral Infection. Initially, it loosely hovers near the player. If it maintains a line of sight on the player for long enough, it starts pulsating and stops in place, then begins to accelerate in a straight line until it collides with the player or any surface, exploding on contact.

The Nuclear Terror is a post-Moon Lord mini boss that spawns during Tier 3 of the Acid Rain event. It has 3 special attacks and 2 other attacks which it uses when not using the special attacks. The 3 special attacks are as follows:
Fires 3-shot bursts of Nuclear Bullet at the player, which will return to their firing position shortly after being fired.
Fires a barrage of Large Nuclear Bullet at the player.
Fires 2 converging streams of large nuclear bullets to trap the player.

After it has used a special attack, it will stay in place for 1.25 seconds (0.5 seconds shorter when at 50% health), and then it will lunge at the player multiple times, returning to using a special attack afterwards. It can also teleport to the player, which is telegraphed by green dust. If the player is below it, it will teleport to the same layer as the player, even if it is in the middle of attacking.
Upon death, the Nuclear Terror will explode into 16 large nuclear bullets or Sulphuric Acid Mist in all directions.

The Nuclear Toad is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Acid Rain event. It is stationary and when near the player, it will flash red for 2 seconds before exploding into 7 Goop in a random spread, which are affected by gravity. The explosion radius depends on what tier of the Acid Rain event the player is currently on. The radius is roughly 16.875 blocks for Tier 1, 22.5 blocks for Tier 2 and 35 blocks for Tier 3.
The Old Duke is a post-Moon Lord boss that can be fought in the Sulphurous Sea biome. While it is optional, it is recommended to be fought after Polterghast and before The Devourer of Gods.
spawn: The Old Duke can be spawned by finishing the Acid Rain event after Polterghast is defeated, appearing from a giant sulphurous tornado. It can also be summoned by fishing in the Sulphurous Sea with a Bloodworm after defeating the Moon Lord.

intro: The Tooth Ball is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by The Perforators. When used, it throws a tooth ball that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and pierces twice.

Performing a stealth strike with the Tooth Ball causes a crimson nimbus cloud to spawn above every enemy hit by the weapon and rain down raindrops that damage enemies. Up to 2 crimson nimbus clouds can exist at a time, causing the older existing cloud to dissipate when a new cloud spawns. The weapon and raindrops inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

The Orthocera is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during Tiers 2 and 3 of the Acid Rain event. It will swim towards the player if they are in water to deal contact damage. If the player is outside of the water, it will attempt to lunge towards them while firing streams of acid. If it lands on the surface, it will flop around aimlessly.

The Overloaded Soldier is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the underground layer. It moves similarly to other Skeleton-type enemies, but its movement speed accelerates considerably the nearer it is to the player. It constantly emits a magenta glow, allowing it to be easily seen in dark caves.
After the Moon Lord is defeated, its stats are buffed and it begins dropping Necroplasm, a versatile crafting material.
The Perennial Slime is a Hardmode slime that spawns in the cavern layer after Plantera has been defeated. It exists as an alternative way to obtain Perennial Ore aside from mining it.
Like most other slimes, the Perennial Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

The Perforator Cyst is a rare Pre-Hardmode stationary enemy that spawns in The Crimson biome. When killed, it will summon The Perforators. The Perforator Cyst has abnormally high life for Pre-Hardmode, ensuring that early players won't accidentally summon the boss.
The Perforator Cyst can be prevented from spawning by using the Anti-Cyst Ointment.
The Perforator Cyst can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer and its upgrades.

The Pestilent Slime is a Hardmode slime that spawns in the Jungle after Golem has been defeated. It jumps towards the player and while it has them in its line of sight, it releases high velocity Plague Stinger that explode into shortly lingering plague eruptions. In Expert Mode, it releases 5 plague stingers when the player is close to it.
Like most other slimes, the Pestilent Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel accessory equipped.

The Piggy is a critter that spawns in the Forest during the day or at any time while in a town. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net. It passively walks back and forth and occasionally idles in place.

The Piggy will occasionally start running, emitting the same particles and sounds as the Hermes Boots and upgrades. While running, if it detects a gap, the Piggy will leap across it. If there are any tiles in its flight trajectory, it will hit the tiles and get bounced back, rolling on the ground for a bit before resuming basic behavior, taking no damage.
If a Piggy comes into contact with a Purification Powder, it will transform into a Divine Swine. If it comes into contact with a Vile or Vicious Powder, it will transform into a Horrible Hog.

The Gold Piggy is a critter that spawns in the Forest during the day or at any time while in a town. It is a golden recolor of the ordinary Piggy, with a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of spawning in place of the ordinary version. It passively walks back and forth and occasionally idles in place. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net.
If a Gold Piggy comes into contact with a Purification Powder, it will transform into a Divine Swine. If it comes into contact with a Vile or Vicious Powder, it will transform into a Horrible Hog.
It can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer or its upgrade, with a rarity of 3. Similar to other gold critters, its name will appear in gold.
The Plaguebringer Goliath is a Hardmode boss and the central force of the plague afflicted onto the Jungle following the Golem's defeat.
Defeating her provides the player with Infected Armor Plating, a crafting material for various weapons and equipment, including the third tier of Draedon's Arsenal.
spawn: The Plaguebringer Goliath does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her by using the Abombination in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.

intro: The Plaguebringer is an uncommon Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle after Golem has been defeated. It behaves similarly to Queen Bee, alternating between backing away at a minimum distance before charging at the player horizontally three times and hovering above them while firing explosive Plague Stinger. While firing stingers, it has a 6.66% chance to fire a Plague Rocket instead of a plague stinger. The chance of firing a plague rocket and stinger fire rate increases in higher difficulties.
If the player is outside of the Jungle, it becomes enraged, charging more aggressively and charging up to five times instead of three.

The Plagueshell is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle after Golem has been defeated. It behaves identically to a Giant Tortoise, walking around slowly and occasionally retracting into its shell. It then starts spinning and hurling itself towards the player, gaining increased defense, dealing high contact damage and inflicting the Plague debuff. This attack will be interrupted when it takes damage.
In Revengeance Mode and on For the Worthy worlds, the Plagueshell can no longer be interrupted while performing its spin attack.

The Prism-Back is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It swims back and forth passively and is always passive even when attacked. However, despite being passive, it can still deal contact damage and will deal even more contact damage if the player touches the top of its spiked shell.
Prism-Backs receive a boost to their stats when the world enters Hardmode.
Prism-Backs have a 14% chance to be caught in a group of 3 if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in an Sunken Sea.
Providence, the Profaned Goddess is a post-Moon Lord boss that is fought in either The Hallow or The Underworld.

Defeating Providence will provide the player with Divine Geodes, as well as the Mark of Providence used to summon three bosses (Storm Weaver, Ceaseless Void and Signus). Additionally, Uelibloom Ore will generate in the world, and the Ravager and Brimstone Crag enemies will be buffed and begin to drop Bloodstone.
spawn: Providence does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her with the Profaned Core while in the Hallow or the Underworld. When summoned, a brief animation plays where the Profaned Core floats above the player while light and fire converge on it, before Providence appears in an explosion of flames.

intro: The Radiator is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Acid Rain event. It slowly crawls around the sides of tiles much like a Snail and emits an aura around it that inflicts the Irradiated and Poisoned debuffs while the player is within its aura. After Polterghast has been defeated, the aura will also inflict the Sulphuric Poisoning and Acid Venom debuffs.
It has a 10% chance to spawn as a white colored-variant, which deals no contact damage and can be caught with any kind of Bug Net, which will drop the Radiating Crystal.

The Reaper Shark is an enemy that spawns in the 4th layer of the Abyss. It is initially stealthed as it hunts for prey, growling to indicate its presence. If approached or attacked by the player, the Reaper Shark will roar and enter an enraged state. Once enraged, it attempts to hurt the player by swimming directly into them.

At 50% health, the Reaper Shark will briefly go invincible and roar, enraging further. It will then perform a series of faster, angled dash attacks, before resuming its prior behavior. Under 10% health, the Reaper Shark will stop dashing, have its contact damage reduced by 50%, and go back to just swimming towards the player albeit more slowly than when above 50% health.
It can be detected with the Lifeform Analyzer.

The Renegade Warlock is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Dungeon and Brimstone Crag. It behaves similarly to a Chaos Elemental, running towards the player to deal contact damage and teleporting near the player if it cannot reach them.
After Providence is defeated, the Renegade Warlock will gain a large buff in stats, and is able to drop Bloodstone.
Renegade Warlocks have an 0.67% chance in Hardmode to be caught in a group of 50 if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in Lava in the Brimstone Crag.

The Repair Unit is a critter that can be found in all five Bio-center Labs. It passively walks back and forth, jumping over gaps and solid blocks in its path. Every 5 seconds, it will latch onto a nearby wall if available for up to 10.33 seconds or until it leaves a wall. It can be caught with any type of Bug Net.

The Rotdog is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface at night after the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated. It has the same AI as the Unicorn, charging and ramming into the player at high speeds. This, along with their ability to inflict Bleeding, makes them a dangerous enemy for unprepared players.

The Scorn Eater is a post-Moon Lord enemy that spawns in The Hallow and The Underworld. It jumps towards the player at high speed, then stands still and pants for a moment before jumping again. It is capable of jumping through tiles in order to reach the player, however it cannot move significant vertical distance at once.

The Sea Floaty is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It crawls along the seafloor and never chases the player. Upon being hit, it will swim away from the player by going through tiles and despawn shortly afterwards.

CalamityMod/SeaKing.ko: 유용한 무기를 판매하고 도움말을 통해 특별한 수중 호흡 버프를 부여하는 NPC입니다.
conditionsKo: 거대 조개 처치 시 즉시 등장합니다.
사망 후 재입주: 빈 집이 있고 데저트 스커지를 처치해야 합니다.
intro: The Sea King is an NPC vendor that provides a plethora of helpful information, several useful weapons, and a unique buff known as Amidias' Blessing.
The Sea King will immediately spawn upon killing a Giant Clam, but if killed he will only move in once the following conditions have been met:
There is an empty house.
The Desert Scourge has been defeated.
When threatened by enemies, he will defend himself with Snap Clams.
environment: 유효한 빈 집 (세부 입주 조건 별도)

intro: The Sea Minnow is a critter that spawns in the Sunken Sea. It passively swims back and forth, gaining a temporary speed boost when hitting a tile and will attempt to swim away from the player. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net and may be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 20%.

The Shady Salesman is a unique NPC vendor who visits the player's town for one in-game night after having previously defeating the Horrible Hog. He sells various items which usually both help and hinder the player, as well as shrine items if they have been found before.

Similar to the Traveling Merchant, in order for the Shady Salesman to spawn, at least 2 other NPCs must already be present. The Guide counts as one of these, but the Old Man and Skeleton Merchant do not. He will not spawn during Solar Eclipses, the Goblin Army, Frost Legion, Pirate Invasion, or Martian Madness. He does not require his own house in order to spawn, and will instead spawn next to NPCs, including town pets, spending the night walking around them.

Once the criteria are met, the Shady Salesman has a 25% chance of appearing at 7:30 PM. He leaves once the night has passed and time hits 4:30 AM, but can only do so once he is off-screen. He despawns if the world is exited.

If the Town Piggy is present, the Shady Salesman will stop naturally spawning, and instead, the Town Piggy will transform into the Shady Salesman at night. The Shady Salesman will then revert back into a Town Piggy the following morning.
If threatened by enemies, the Shady Salesman will defend himself with the Elephant Killer.

The Shockstorm Shuttle is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in Space. It behaves similarly to the Martian Saucer, attacking the player by firing two blue lightning bolts that inflict the Electrified debuff and two yellow lasers that travel at a high velocity.
The Shroomble is a critter that spawns on the Surface during the day. It passively walks back and forth and occasionally idles or jumps in place. It can also be caught with any type of Bug Net.

The Sightseer Collider is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Astral Infection. It circles around the player at a distance before periodically ramming towards them to deal contact damage in a similar manner to an Eater of Souls. When the enemy hits a tile, or the player hits it, it will either back away or slow down for a brief moment before reattempting its attack.

The Sightseer Spitter is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Astral Infection. It circles around the player before periodically ramming towards them to deal contact damage. It will also occasionally fire Seeker Spit, a projectile with a double helix trail. It will emit dust from its mouth shortly before firing, telegraphing its attack. If the enemy takes damage, its attack will reset.
Signus is a post-Moon Lord boss. Defeating it provides the player with Twisting Nether, a crafting material used to craft the Cosmic Worm.
spawn: Signus does not spawn on its own and requires the player to summon it by using the Mark of Providence in The Underworld.

intro: The Skyfin is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Acid Rain event. It typically spawns underwater, flying up above the player. When close to the player or after 2.5 seconds, it pauses briefly and makes a sharp dive towards the player. After 0.83 seconds of diving, it flies back up and repeats its attack pattern.

The Slab Crab is an enemy that spawns in the 1st layer of the Abyss. Similarly to Baby Flak Crab and its adult counterpart, it disguises itself as a rock and is immune to damage while disguised. If the player gets too close to one or break the blocks below it, it will reveal itself and run and jump towards the player, dealing contact damage. Once the player exits its range, it disguises itself again after 3 seconds.
The Slime God is a Pre-Hardmode boss that is intended to be fought after Skeletron.
spawn: The Slime God does not spawn on its own and requires the player to summon it with the Overloaded Sludge. It can be summoned anywhere, at any time.

intro: The Soul Slurper is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Brimstone Crag. It continuously faces the player while attempting to ram into them. It also fires Brimstone Dart at the player, that inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.
Its stats receive a significant boost and starts dropping Bloodstone after Providence, the Profaned Goddess is defeated.
Soul Slurpers have a 79% chance to be caught in a pair if the player fishes with the Trusty Old Rod in Lava in the Brimstone Crag.
The Stellar Culex is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the underground Astral Infection. It flies over the player's head and attempts to slowly swoop down on them.

The Stormlion is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert during Thunderstorms, as well as the Underground Desert regardless of weather. It slowly moves towards the player in an attempt to deal contact damage and inflict the Static Discharge debuff.

The Sulflounder is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea and in the first layer of the Abyss. It initially stays invisible on the sand, waiting for the player to come near or hit it, in which it will then become visible and hostile. It attacks by slowly swimming towards the player while spraying Sulphuric Acid Mist projectiles at them.

The Sulphurous Skater is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during Tiers 2 and 3 of the Acid Rain event. It moves around by jumping both on land and in water, however it will jump more often if it is outside of water. It will target nearby Sulphurous Sea bubbles and upon latching onto them, it will gain the ability to fly around and chase the player. If the bubble is popped by the player, it will return to jumping around.

The Sunskater is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Space. It flies peacefully in one direction and turns around when it hits a block. Once attacked, it starts diving into the player at a fast speed in order to ram them.

The Super Dummy is a craftable Pre-Hardmode summoning item. When used with its primary function (left-click), it spawns a Super Dummy enemy. This enemy is nigh-invincible, with 9,999,999 health that it is constantly regenerating. It also cannot be killed by damage-over-time from inflicted debuffs. However, when used with its secondary function (right-click), it will remove all spawned Super Dummies.

Due to the Super Dummy enemy's high resilience and inability to harm the player (despite being an enemy), it is considered an improved alternative to the Target Dummy. It features several practical advantages to Target Dummies, including more accurate DPS numbers when using the DPS Meter or any of its successors, the ability for weapon projectiles to home in on it, and the ability for minions and sentries to target it.

Supreme Witch, Calamitas is a major boss intended to be fought after defeating Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth, and around the same time as the Exo Mechs. She is currently one of the most challenging bosses in the Calamity Mod, and currently acts as the final boss alongside the Exo Mechs.

Defeating her provides the player with Ashes of Annihilation, a crafting material for various endgame equipment, and also causes her to move in as the Brimstone Witch Town NPC, granting players access to the Enchantment mechanic.
spawn: Supreme Witch, Calamitas does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her by using Ashes of Calamity on an Altar of the Accursed. She can be summoned anywhere at any time. After this, the screen will darken and shake before Supreme Witch, Calamitas herself appears above the Altar. When Supreme Witch, Calamitas is fully summoned, she will laugh devilishly instead of using the regular boss roar.
After defeating Supreme Witch, Calamitas, a Ceremonial Urn can be crafted, serving as a non-consumable summon item.
If the Brimstone Witch NPC is currently alive in the world, she will disappear when Supreme Witch, Calamitas is summoned.

intro: THE LORDE is a post-Moon Lord joke hidden boss, exclusive to Get fixed boi worlds. It can be considered the most difficult boss in the Calamity Mod.
spawn: On a world with the Get fixed boi seed, THE LORDE has a 1 in 42 chance to spawn upon killing a Bohldohr in the Jungle Temple at any stage of progression.
THE LORDE can also be summoned by using NO, which is dropped by Bohldohrs after Supreme Witch, Calamitas and Exo Mechs have been defeated.

intro: The Town Piggy is a town pet. At night the Town Piggy transforms into the Shady Salesman, providing a consistent way of accessing his wares. The Shady Salesman will then revert back to the Town Piggy in the morning. The Piggy does not count towards the NPCs' "crowded" limit and hence will not affect NPC happiness, although it does count as a regular town NPC for the purpose of the Pylon network.
The Piggy will move into an available NPC house if the following conditions have been met:
There is an empty house.
The Housing Contract has been used.
The Shady Salesman is not currently present.
environment: 유효한 빈 집 (세부 입주 조건 별도)

intro: The Toxic Minnow is an enemy that spawns in the 1st and 2nd layers of the Abyss. It swims in one direction and turns around when it hits a wall, dealing contact damage if the player touches it. It never moves to attack the player or fires projectiles of any kind, even if it is approached or hit.

Once killed, it bursts into roughly 10 toxic green skull clouds, which deals damage and inflicts the Poisoned debuff onto anything they contact, including enemies. These clouds linger for 10 seconds before vanishing.

The Toxicatfish is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea and in the first layer of the Abyss. It swims peacefully until the player comes near or hits it. It attacks by swimming towards the player in an attempt to hurt them.

The Trasher is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Sulphurous Sea. In water, it will remain passive until the player gets close enough or provokes it. It swims quickly towards the player in an attempt to attack them, but it will also always walk slowly towards the player on land. It moves faster as it loses more health. It can spawn in both water and on land.

The Trilobite is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during Tiers 2 and 3 of the Acid Rain event. It swims around before slowly coming to a stop and will attempt to lunge itself at the player to deal contact damage. When it gets hit, it will occasionally release a gravity-affected Trilobite Spike. If it lands on the surface, it will be unable to move.

The Twinkler is a Hardmode critter found within the Astral Infection that acts similarly to a Firefly. Twinklers can be caught with any type of Bug Net and may be used as fishing bait, with a bait power of 40%.

The Viperfish is an enemy that spawns in the 2nd and 3rd layers of the Abyss. It will remain passive, swimming back and forth, until the player gets too close to it or attacks it. Once provoked, it will attack by charging at the player to deal contact damage.

The Viruling is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle after Golem has been defeated. It behaves similar to an Eater of Souls, hovering through the air towards the player in attempt to deal contact damage and inflict the Plague debuff.

The Wulfrum Drone is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface during the day. It is initially stationary when it first spawns, moving to attack only when the player is considerably close and has direct line of sight. It attacks by flying around the player, passing through blocks, and occasionally swooping down to attack them. It will stop attacking if the line of sight is broken. If enough time has passed without the drone detecting a player, it will fly straight up, passing through tiles, and despawn.
It can be supercharged by the Wulfrum Amplifier enemy, causing its lights to turn from green to blue and causing it to fire lasers at the player.

The Wulfrum Gyrator is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface during the day. Initially, it remains in one place, jumping periodically. When it detects a player, it attacks by rolling quickly and jumping towards them.
It can be supercharged by the Wulfrum Amplifier enemy, causing its lights to turn from green to blue and increasing its speed and jump height.

The Wulfrum Hovercraft is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface during the day. It is initially stationary when it first spawns, moving to attack only when the player is considerably close and has direct line of sight. It attacks by hovering above the ground and diving downward before charging the player. It will stop attacking if the line of sight is broken. If enough time has passed without the hovercraft detecting a player, it will fly straight up, passing through tiles, and despawn.
It can be supercharged by the Wulfrum Amplifier enemy, causing its lights to turn from green to blue and making it fly and charge faster.

The Wulfrum Rover is a Pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface during the day. It is initially stationary, but when it detects a player, it attacks by sliding towards them in order to deal contact damage. It is incapable of moving up non-slope blocks.
It can be supercharged by the Wulfrum Amplifier enemy, causing its lights to turn from green to blue and giving it a temporary energy shield which increases its defense.

spawn: Yharon does not spawn on his own and requires the player to summon him by using the Blessed Phoenix Egg.

intro: King Slime is a Pre-Hardmode boss. He is intended to be one of the first bosses fought by the player and is considered to be the weakest of all of the bosses.
While in Revengeance and Death Mode, King Slime gains several changes to his AI such as an additional boost to his mobility and Jewels which attack the player from a distance.
spawn: King Slime spawns when any of the following conditions are met:
Naturally, but rarely, on grass at the far left or far right of the map.
Defeating 150 slimes during a Slime Rain.
Using a Slime Crown anywhere at any time.
